Commercial Operations Manager

The Commercial Operations Manager enables the full commercial engine—Sales, Marketing, and Customer Service—to achieve growth through best-in-class sales operations, CRM excellence, and data-driven execution.

This role owns the commercial operating system, including CRM strategy, data governance, and technology enablement, while leading a team of three and driving process discipline, adoption, and measurable funnel performance improvements.

The role leads the transition to enterprise-grade, best-practice sales management by bridging commercial strategy and system execution—owning the Salesforce ecosystem and optimizing it to deliver pipeline visibility, sales efficiency, and predictable revenue growth.

Core Responsibilities:

Commercial Enablement & Funnel Optimization

  • Align Sales, Marketing, and Customer Service processes across the end-to-end lead-to-revenue lifecycle. You will efficiently structure the CRM systems around Greene Tweed’s go-to-market model.
  • Identify and eliminate friction in lead management and sales funnel progression
  • Standardize, automate and optimize core sales management processes (lead qualification, pipeline management, forecasting, handoffs etc)

Sales Operations Leadership

  • Lead best-practice sales operations, including pipeline governance, support of demand team’s forecasting accuracy, performance tracking, and pricing.
  • Direct experience methodologies of Challenger Sales directly into the CRM interface, supporting sales with best practices.
  • Support predictable revenue growth through scalable processes and clear operating cadences
  • Partner with commercial leadership to translate growth strategy into technology enabled execution

Data Hygiene, Deduplication and Governance

  • Leads Sales Policy and Account Segmentation documentation process

CRM & Technology Strategy

  • Define and execute a technology roadmap focused on automation, efficiency, and data accuracy

Funnel Governance, Reporting & Insights

  • Establish end-to-end funnel visibility and accountability through dashboards and reporting

Team Leadership & Adoption

jobs.description:
The Principal Security Engineer is responsible for defining and governing the organization's technology strategy, architecture standards, and technology roadmaps across cloud platforms, developer ecosystems, AI technologies, security, and infrastructure services. This role serves as a trusted advisor to executive leadership and provides strategic direction for the design, implementation, and operation of enterprise-scale technology solutions.

The Principal Security Engineer will lead architecture initiatives spanning Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), GitHub Enterprise, AI platforms, identity services, developer tooling, and cloud governance frameworks while ensuring alignment with business objectives, security requirements, compliance obligations, and financial management goals.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Architecture & Strategy

  • Develop and maintain enterprise architecture standards, principles, reference architectures, and multi-year technology roadmaps.

  • Guide strategic technology investment decisions and provide architectural leadership to business and technology executives.

  • Lead architecture governance reviews and ensure alignment of technology solutions with enterprise objectives.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies and establish adoption strategies that balance innovation, security, scalability, and cost.

Multi-Cloud Architecture & Governance

  • Own enterprise cloud architecture and governance across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

  • Design and maintain cloud landing zones, network architectures, identity models, security controls, and management frameworks.

  • Establish enterprise standards for Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation), automation, and cloud operations.

  • Lead cloud modernization, migration, platform engineering, and transformation initiatives.

  • Develop and maintain cloud governance, FinOps, and operational excellence programs across all cloud providers.

  • Architect secure environments for regulated workloads, including AWS GovCloud and other compliance-sensitive environments.

GitHub Enterprise & Developer Platform Management

  • Own the architecture, governance, administration, and strategic direction of the organization's GitHub Enterprise platform.

  • Manage GitHub Enterprise licensing, billing structures, organizational hierarchy, repository governance, and platform security.

  • Lead enterprise adoption and governance of GitHub Copilot, AI-assisted development platforms, and modern software engineering capabilities.

  • Establish standards for source code management, CI/CD platforms, developer workflows, and software supply chain security.

  • Partner with engineering leadership to improve developer productivity, platform reliability, and developer experience.

  • Define governance controls for enterprise AI coding assistants and developer tool ecosystems.

AI Platforms, Governance & Innovation

  • Develop enterprise architectures for AI platforms, generative AI services, foundation models, and AI-enabled business capabilities.

  • Establish governance frameworks for responsible AI adoption, security, compliance, and risk management.

  • Partner with business and engineering teams to enable secure adoption of emerging AI technologies.

  • Evaluate and govern enterprise AI platforms including commercial and cloud-native AI services.

Security Architecture

  • Establish enterprise security architecture standards across cloud, infrastructure, applications, AI, and developer platforms.

  • Define patterns and controls for identity and access management, privilege management, secrets management, and DevSecOps.

  • Partner with cybersecurity, product security, and engineering organizations to implement security-by-design practices.

  • Ensure architecture decisions support regulatory, contractual, and industry compliance requirements.

Financial Management & Operational Excellence

  • Lead cloud financial management (FinOps) initiatives across AWS, Azure, GCP, GitHub Enterprise, and AI platforms.

  • Establish governance for consumption, budgeting, licensing, chargeback/showback, and cost optimization.

  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation, standardization, and platform consolidation.

  • Drive continuous improvement programs that reduce technical debt while improving scalability and reliability.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Act as a senior technical advisor to executive leadership and technology teams.

  • Lead cross-functional architecture initiatives involving infrastructure, security, software engineering, product, and operations teams.

  • Mentor architects, engineers, and technical leaders across the enterprise.

  • Build strong partnerships with business stakeholders, vendors, and strategic technology partners.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field.

  • 15+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, cloud architecture, infrastructure engineering, or technology leadership roles.

  • Deep hands-on expertise with AWS, Azure, and GCP architecture, governance, and operations.

  • Experience administering and governing GitHub Enterprise at enterprise scale.

  • Experience with GitHub Copilot, AI tooling, developer platforms, and software delivery ecosystems.

  • Strong knowledge of enterprise security architecture, cloud security, identity and access management, and governance frameworks.

  • Experience leading cloud migration, transformation, and modernization initiatives.

  • Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Proven ability to balance technology innovation, risk management, and business outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • AWS Solutions Architect Certification.

  • Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Certification.

  • Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect Certification.

  • Experience with Terraform, Bicep, PowerShell, Python, automation platforms, and API integration.

  • Implement EMV transaction flows (contact, contactless, NFC, wallet)

  • Troubleshoot device-level issues, EMV kernel interactions, and transaction failures
  • Assist with firmware updates and terminal configuration management

  • Support batch settlement, reconciliation, and reporting processes
  • Participate in production troubleshooting and reliability improvements

  • Assist in validating host message formatting and transaction responses
  • Troubleshoot processor-level declines and edge cases with guidance from senior engineers
  • Support regression testing and re-certification activities
  • Collaborate with internal teams and external processors during certification cycles

Tokenization & Wallet Integration

  • Support implementation of network tokenization flows (Visa, Mastercard, Amex)
  • Assist with token lifecycle management (provisioning, updates, de-tokenization)
  • Support integrations for Apple Pay and Google Pay
  • Ensure payment flows adhere to card network and security requirements

Mobile Payment Integration

  • Integrate payment SDKs and troubleshoot mobile transaction issues
  • Assist with mobile wallet provisioning and transaction flows

  • Experience building RESTful APIs using .NET / ASP.NET core

  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills in production environments
  • Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to EMV Level 3 certification processes
  • Experience integrating with payment processors or gateways
  • Experience with Ingenico devices and SDKs
  • Familiarity with PCI-DSS compliance concepts

•Experience with AWS or Azure

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployments
  • Prior fintech or payment industry experience

•Backend: .NET 6+ / ASP.NET Core

  • Mobile: Android SDK integration (Kotlin)

  • Payments: EMV, Tokenization, Webhooks, Batch Settlement

About the role

  • As a Claims Manager at Reserv, you will be responsible for a team of claims professionals managing claims in multiple LOBs. We want your background and experience to deliver operational effectiveness, particularly in leveraging technology and analytics to drive better efficiencies and performance. You will serve a critical role with the team, the customers, and the client. The high-performing team you will manage will service several clients as part of our Core Team. You will maintain high quality standards, and compliance with regulatory, internal, and external contractual SLAs. This position requires exceptional leadership skills, and foundational understanding of claims ideally with experience handling and/or managing multi lines of business.

Who you are

  • Highly motivated and growth-oriented
  • Subject matter expert. You have deep technical and subject matter experience in the world of commercial transportation claims, including coverage and litigation. Experienced in reviewing and analyzing contracts

  • Creative. You challenge existing assumptions and find ways of leveraging technology and the talents of your team to address problems
  • Curious. You want to know the whole story so you can make the right decisions early and be decisive when it counts.
  • Problem solver. You have the ability to take a ‘deep dive’ into the details of the business while staying focused on the big picture
  • Anti-status quo. You don’t just wish things were done differently, you action on it
  • Communicative. You are comfortable with and understand the importance of phone communications throughout the claims process
  • And did we mention, a sense of humor. Claims are hard enough as it is.

What you'll do

  • Manage a team of team leads and adjusters managing a mix of accounts and lines of business
  • Be consistently dependable in achieving or exceeding goals and overcoming obstacles
  • Implement and maintain best practices for claims handling, including: claim intake, investigation, evaluation, settlement, and recovery

A hands-on Engineering Manager to own and grow the engineering team behind DrayDog — building innovative, technology-first solutions for the logistics industry. You'll code, set architecture direction, own the full people-management cycle, and be the main point of contact between the team and other stakeholders as we scale the team and product's reach.

About the role

You will lead an engineering team and design, architect, build, and evolve backend services that power critical parts of our platform. You’ll set the technical direction, raise the engineering bar, and unblock the team while staying hands-on in the codebase. You should be comfortable turning ideas into reliable software that solves real user needs, and equally comfortable coaching other engineers to do the same. You should care about shipping quickly, making sound technical decisions, measuring results, growing the people around you, and improving over time in a high-ownership, high-autonomy environment.

What you'll do

Leadership & People

  • Own the full people-management cycle: 1:1s, performance reviews, career growth, and hiring as we grow the team.
  • Run engineering rituals like planning, code reviews, design reviews.
  • Be the main point of contact between your team and Product, other EMs, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Build a culture of innovation, ownership, craftsmanship, and direct feedback.

Technical Execution

  • Stay hands-on: write code, review PRs, and weigh in on architecture on a regular basis.
  • Lead backend design using Python, FastAPI, Temporal, and PostgreSQL.
  • Champion unit testing, code quality, and DevOps practices (CI/CD, monitoring, reliability).
  • Leverage AI tooling to improve all aspects of delivery.

Delivery & Operations

  • Own the technical roadmap and delivery for your team, from concept to production.
  • Set SLIs/SLOs; lead postmortems and drive fixes.
  • Drive observability — logging, metrics, and alerting — to catch issues before they impact customers.

Qualifications

General

  • 8+ years in software engineering (or equivalent demonstrated impact), including 2+ years as a formal people manager.
  • Strong cross-functional communicator; comfortable with ambiguity and high ownership.
  • Experience in startup or high-growth SaaS environments.

Technical Skills

  • Expert-level Python and backend API design (FastAPI or similar).
  • Strong database design and query optimization skills.
  • Solid grasp of DevOps: containers, deployment, monitoring, reliability.
  • Track record of driving engineering quality and mentoring engineers.
  • Experience using AI tools to improve delivery — code, testing, docs, and operations.

Our Stack

  • Python,FastAPI, Temporal, Postgres, Azure Cloud
  • Docker, Kubernetes,Pulumi
  • Vue.js frontend

What We Offer:

  • Real ownership of a critical system and a team to build
  • A small, senior team that values quality and continuous improvement
  • Respect for your work-life balance
  • Competitive pay and benefits and equity

Does this role sound like the next step in your career?

We’d love to hear from you! If you don’t meet all of the requirements exactly, we encourage you to use your cover letter to tell us about your unique experience—talent comes from many places, and skills are transferable.

jobs.excerpt: About the teamZillow Rentals is building a best-in-class vertically integrated marketplace that connects renters with property owners and managers — from large-scale multifamily communities to single-family homes.
jobs.description:
About the team

Zillow Rentals is building a best-in-class vertically integrated marketplace that connects renters with property owners and managers — from large-scale multifamily communities to single-family homes. We provide advertising solutions and a complete set of digital tools to help partners market their properties, identify prospective tenants, sign leases, and collect payments. This is a high-growth, high-focus area for Zillow and an opportunity to make an outsized impact. Our team includes applied scientists, engineers, designers, product managers, marketers, and researchers partnering across Zillow to deliver trusted experiences for millions of customers.

About the role

Every renter journey on Zillow starts with inventory. If the underlying listing data isn't complete, accurate, and rich, nothing downstream — messaging, touring, applications, leasing — performs the way it should. This role owns that foundation.

The Principal Product Manager for Listings will set the strategy for what makes Zillow's rental selection the deepest, richest, and most complete on the internet. You'll own how rental inventory is sourced, ingested, enriched, and scored for quality — ensuring consumer-facing teams have the best possible data to work with. This spans listing completeness and content quality, inventory coverage and growth, and the data and content partnerships that differentiate Zillow's selection. You'll partner closely with feed engineering on data quality and platform reliability, and represent listings strategy to senior leadership and external partners alike.

This is a high-visibility, strategic product role — not a narrow pipeline role. Get this right and you create a flywheel: richer inventory drives more renter engagement, which attracts more and better inventory. You're building the marketplace's core advantage.

What you'll tackle:

  • Listing completeness & quality: Raise the depth and quality of listing data across all inventory — pricing transparency, amenities, media richness, and the completeness scores that directly drive renter trust and conversion. You'll define what "great" looks like and build the system that gets inventory there at scale.

  • Coverage & inventory growth: Grow the breadth and depth of rental inventory on Zillow across property types and sourcing channels.

  • Data & content partnerships: Source new content partnerships (media, floor plans, review content) and optimize existing feed and aggregator relationships — negotiating, onboarding, and tuning third-party data sources so Zillow has the most comprehensive, highest-quality rental selection anywhere.

  • Platform reliability & syndication: Partner with engineering to keep the listings pipeline stable, performant, and trustworthy — balancing committed roadmap work against urgent partner escalations, and making disciplined tradeoffs when the two collide.

What success looks like:

  • Measurably better listings: A rising share of inventory delivered complete, accurate, and rich — backed by a completeness standard the whole ecosystem can rally around.

  • Broader, deeper coverage: Meaningful growth in rental inventory across channels and property types.

  • Partnerships that differentiate: New and optimized content partnerships that make Zillow's selection unmistakably the richest on the internet.

  • A reliable, scalable foundation: A listings platform that partners and renters trust — stable, performant, and ready for whatever the marketplace throws at it.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $178,300.00 - $284,700.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $169,300.00 - $270,500.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

You treat listings as a product, not a data feed. You care deeply about the completeness and quality of every listing on the platform — and you understand how upstream inventory decisions drive downstream renter experience and marketplace performance. You bring clarity to ambiguity, influence without authority, and make everyone around you better.

  • 10+ years in a Product Management role, with a focus on building consumer-facing technology products. Marketplace and/or e-commerce experience required.

  • Inventory & marketplace strategy: You think holistically about supply-side strategy — growth, quality, and the flywheel between inventory depth and consumer engagement.

  • Data quality & systems thinking: You're comfortable working with feed engineering on data pipelines, completeness scoring, and quality frameworks. You understand how upstream data decisions ripple into the downstream renter experience.

  • Partnership management: You've managed data and content partnerships at scale — negotiating, onboarding, and optimizing third-party data sources — and you're credible in the room with external partners.

  • Prioritization under pressure: You can hold a committed roadmap while absorbing unplanned work, with disciplined scope management and clear, honest tradeoff communication.

  • AI fluency: You actively use AI tools across the product development lifecycle — research, prototyping, analysis — and can think critically about where and how AI creates value in the product. You're an effective partner to AI/ML teams and comfortable evaluating AI capabilities, build-vs-partner-vs-buy decisions, and the tradeoffs inherent in AI-powered products.

  • Exceptional communication skills (verbal, written, and visual) with the ability to articulate complex ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences and influence at all levels.

  • Consistent record of shipping successful products at scale.

  • Passion for the real estate industry and a commitment to Zillow Group's mission and values.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help customers navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company that's reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the country. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2025, and included on the PEOPLE Companies That Care® 2025list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.

ITC Worldwide is a global leader in delivering high-impact technology training and consultancy services. Overview

Company Overview

Henkels & McCoy West works closely with clients from diverse markets to build enduring partnerships throughout the Western United States. Our team of seasoned professionals designs, builds, manages, and maintains critical and sustainable infrastructure for the power, oil & gas pipeline, gas distribution, and communications industries. Building on a 100-year legacy of performance and service to utility, commercial, industrial, and government clients, H&M West brings together extensive knowledge and innovation to deliver infrastructure construction solutions that meet future energy needs today.

H&M West is a purpose-driven company. Our core values guide our strategy, performance, and culture. We believe in maintaining an environment where team members can make an impact, grow, and thrive. A place where they find meaning and purpose in doing the important work of ensuring communities have the vital energy, light, and communications to prosper. Our culture is inclusive and welcoming. Our teams are empowered with abundant training, tools, and opportunities to follow their curiosity and ambitions. Everyone has an equal chance to advance. Everyone is supported, respected, and challenged to be their best. We’re always looking for talented and dedicated people to join us and love where they work.

Henkels & McCoy West is a proud subsidiary of MasTec (NYSE: MTZ), a Fortune 500 Company ranked by Energy News-Record as one of the leading contractors in the country. H&M West is part of the MasTec Power Delivery segment. We are certified as a minority-controlled company by the National Minority Suppliers Development Council (NMSDC). Our rich diversity of people and ideas makes us a stronger, more innovative organization.

Position Summary:

The Senior Estimator is responsible for developing, preparing, and managing detailed cost estimates and proposals for complex projects in the transmission, substation power sectors. This role provides expert support throughout the bid and pre-construction process, ensuring accuracy, competitiveness, and compliance with client requirements and company standards. The Senior Estimator works cross-functionally with project management, engineering, procurement, and field operations teams to validate scopes of work, identify risk, and create competitive pricing strategies.

This is a remote position that will require travel to the Pacific Northwest (Portland, OR, Vancouver, WA) based on business needs, team meetings, customer engagements, and other key events.

Preference will be given to candidates located in the Western United States, including California, Nevada, Arizona, Washington, Oregon, Colorado, Idaho, Montana to support collaboration and travel requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the development of detailed estimates for transmission, substation power distribution projects, including labor, equipment, material, and subcontractor costs.
  • Interpret design drawings, technical specifications, and bid documents to define project scope and estimate requirements.
  • Conduct quantity take-offs, analyze constructability, and validate design assumptions to ensure realistic project budgets.
  • Collaborate with project managers, engineers, procurement, and construction teams to ensure estimates align with project execution strategies.
  • Identify, quantify, and assess project risks and opportunities; incorporate mitigation strategies into estimates.
  • Prepare and present estimate summaries, bid proposals, and support documentation for executive and client review.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of industry pricing trends, labor agreements, productivity benchmarks, and market conditions.
  • Support contract negotiations by providing cost analysis and value engineering alternatives.
  • Mentor and support junior estimators, providing guidance on industry practices, estimating methods, and company procedures.
  • Ensure all estimates comply with corporate standards, client requirements, and applicable safety and quality protocols.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Business, or related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.
  • 7+ years of estimating experience in power utility construction (transmission, substation, t-line).
  • Experience with transmission lines, substations, and electrical distribution projects.
  • Experience with Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) projects.
  • Experience estimating large $75M+ projects.
  • Proficiency with estimating software (e.g., B2W, HeavyBid, Sage, or similar) and MS Excel.
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and presentation skills.

We're hiring a UI/UX Designer who has fully embraced AI-assisted design tooling — Figma AI, Google Stitch, v0, Galileo, Magic Patterns, Midjourney, and the rapidly evolving stack around them. This isn't a role for someone who occasionally uses AI for inspiration. We want a designer who treats AI tools as a first-class part of their workflow: generating, iterating, prototyping, and shipping at a pace that wasn't possible two years ago.

You'll own the design output across multiple AmorServ initiatives, partnering closely with engineering to move from idea prototype production-ready UI in days, not weeks.

What You'll Do

  • Lead end-to-end UI/UX design for AmorServ web and mobile products — from discovery and wireframes through high-fidelity mockups and interactive prototypes.
  • Use AI design tools (Figma AI, Google Stitch, v0, Magic Patterns, Galileo, Uizard, etc.) as part of your daily workflow to accelerate ideation, generate variations, and produce production-grade UI faster.
  • Translate business requirements and user research into clean, accessible, conversion-focused interfaces.
  • Build and maintain design systems — components, tokens, patterns — that scale across multiple AmorServ products.
  • Prototype real, clickable experiences that engineers can build directly from, with handoff specs that leave no ambiguity.
  • Use generative AI for visual assets, icon systems, illustrations, and marketing creative when appropriate, while maintaining brand consistency.
  • Run lightweight user testing and incorporate feedback rapidly.
  • Stay ahead of the AI design tooling landscape and bring new workflows into the team.

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • Demonstrable fluency with AI design tools. You should be able to walk us through projects where AI tools materially shaped the output, not just decorated it.
  • Strong portfolio showing shipped product work — web, mobile, or both — with clear visual craft.
  • Expert-level Figma skills (auto-layout, components, variants, variables, prototyping).
  • Solid grasp of design systems, accessibility (WCAG basics), and responsive design.
  • Ability to write clear copy for UI — microcopy, empty states, error messages, onboarding.
  • Comfort with ambiguity, fast iteration, and direct feedback.
  • Clear written and visual communication. You can explain why a design works, not just that it does.

Nice to have:

  • Experience designing for B2B / enterprise software, IT services, or technical products.
  • Front-end fluency — enough HTML/CSS/Tailwind/React to read code, tweak prototypes, or hand off cleanly to engineers.
  • Experience with prompt engineering and getting consistent, on-brand output from generative tools.
  • Motion design (Framer, Rive, After Effects, or Lottie).
  • Background designing AI-powered product features (chat interfaces, agent UIs, generative experiences).

How You Work

  • You ship. You'd rather get a v1 in front of users this week than a v3 in a month.
  • You think in systems, not screens. Every component you make is one someone else can reuse.
  • You treat AI tools as leverage, not a crutch. You know when to generate and when to draw.
  • You sweat the details — spacing, type rhythm, color, motion — because they compound.
  • You're opinionated but not precious. You defend good ideas and let go of bad ones quickly.

What We Offer

  • Compensation matched to experience — we're open from mid-level through lead/principal.
  • A modern AI tooling stack, fully paid for. If a new tool ships and it's worth using, you get it.
  • Real ownership over what you design and how it ships.
  • A small, fast team where your work is visible and your judgment matters.
  • Remote-friendly with flexible hours.

How to Apply

Attach the following as one document:

  • Your portfolio (link or PDF). We care about depth on 2–3 projects more than breadth.
  • A short note (no cover letter required) covering: which AI design tools you use weekly, and one example of a project where AI tooling changed how you'd normally approach the work.
  • Your résumé.

We review every application. If your portfolio shows the craft and the AI fluency, you'll hear back.

AmorServ is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on merit and craft

About AssetIntel

AssetIntel is a software company that develops asset management software products for the transportation infrastructure industry. Our clients include state transportation agencies, city governments, toll authorities, transit agencies, the Federal Highway Administration (FHWA), and civil engineering firms. For more information, visit our website.

Job Description

We're looking for a Python developer to own the analytical engines behind our products — the codebases where math meets production software. These systems span a range of problems: long-term deterioration modeling and budget optimization, real-time hazard prediction using live data, probabilistic damage assessment, geospatial analysis, and lifecycle cost forecasting. They are the core of what makes our products work.

You'll work alongside domain experts and researchers to turn mathematical formulations into clean, maintainable, production-grade Python. You'll also progressively improve existing code — better architecture, better patterns, better reliability.

This is not a role where you can treat the math as a black box. You need to be genuinely curious about the models and algorithms you're implementing. You don't need to arrive knowing this domain, but you need to be the kind of person who wants to understand it deeply.

What You'll Do

  • Translate mathematical specifications into production code. You'll receive formulations, equations, and pseudocode from the research side of the team. Your job is to understand the intent and write Python that is correct, readable, testable, and maintainable.
  • Improve existing codebases. The current code works in production but has room for architectural improvement. You'll progressively modernize it — better modularity, type safety, test coverage, error handling, and overall code quality.
  • Build new analytical features end-to-end. As our products evolve, you'll implement new capabilities — taking them from mathematical concept to deployed, production-ready code.
  • Bridge the gap between research and engineering. The ability to communicate across these worlds — asking good questions, translating between math and code, pushing back constructively — will be critical to your success here.

What We're Looking For

    • At least 3 years of professional experience working with Python.
    • Strong Python fundamentals — you write clean, idiomatic Python and care about code quality.
    • Experience with numerical/scientific Python libraries: pandas, NumPy, SciPy.
    • Ability to read and reason about mathematical formulations — comfort with equations, probability distributions, and optimization concepts, or a genuine eagerness to learn.
    • Experience writing and maintaining production Python code, not just scripts or notebooks.
    • Good instincts for software architecture — when to refactor, how to decompose large modules, how to manage dependencies.
    • Clear communication skills, especially the ability to collaborate with researchers and domain experts.
    • Comfort with Git and collaborative development workflows.

Bonus points if you've worked with any of the following: mathematical optimization (LP, MIP), geospatial tools like GeoPandas or Shapely, real-time data pipelines or external APIs, Docker and containerized deployments, or cloud infrastructure (Azure or similar). We also especially value people who've introduced engineering discipline — tests, CI/CD, type hints — into messy research codebases without breaking everything in the process.

Nice-to-haves:

    • Experience with multiprocessing in Python and memory-aware resource management.
    • Familiarity with probabilistic modeling, fragility analysis, or statistical risk assessment.

Benefits and Perks
  • Work remotely - anywhere from India.
  • Market-competitive total compensation package and performance-based bonus.
  • Company-paid medical coverage.
  • Fully equipped home office setup, including a high-spec computer, dual monitors, desk, and chair.
  • Plenty of growth opportunities, working alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry.

Non-Solicitation Policy and Notice to Agencies and Recruiters:

IDEAYA's Non-Solicitation Policy strictly prohibits agencies and recruiters from any contact and communication with IDEAYA employees, managers, and leaders to submit unsolicited candidate resumes and/or to solicit business partnerships. Submission of unsolicited candidate resumes by agencies or recruiters with or without a contract in place with IDEAYA Biosciences Inc. will not create any implied obligation. Failure to comply with this policy will result in disqualification from current and future business opportunities with IDEAYA Biosciences. All recruiting and talent agency decisions are strictly managed by the internal IDEAYA Human Resources function. All communication by external agencies and recruiters must be directed to . We ask that you only email your interest once.

Job Summary

About IDEAYA Biosciences:
IDEAYA is a precision medicine oncology company committed to the discovery, development, and commercialization of transformative therapies for cancer. Our approach integrates expertise in small-molecule drug discovery, structural biology and bioinformatics with robust internal capabilities in identifying and validating translational biomarkers to develop tailored, potentially first-in-class targeted therapies aligned to the genetic drivers of disease. We have built a deep pipeline of product candidates focused on synthetic lethality and antibody-drug conjugates, or ADCs, for molecularly defined solid tumor indications. Our mission is to bring forth the next wave of precision oncology therapies that are more selective, more effective, and deeply personalized with the goal of altering the course of disease and improving clinical outcomes for patients with cancer.

When you're at IDEAYA, you will be in the midst of brilliant minds working on precision medicine therapies to help cancer patients. We are passionate and committed about being on the forefront of oncology medicine, which means we all have a high internal drive that is at the very core of every person at IDEAYA. We are inquisitive, ask deep questions, and are data-driven innovators who like to collaborate and use team work to move science forward. For more information, please see www.ideayabio.com.

Location: Prefer candidates in Miami, Florida, but willing to consider candidates in Orlando, Florida.
*Territory coverage includes geography in the following states: Florida and Puerto Rico*

Position Summary:

IDEAYA is seeking Senior Oncology Account Managers (OAM) to join our Commercial team. The Senior Oncology Account Manager [OAM] serves as a strategic territory leader within a designated geographic region with responsibility for leading the launch and adoption of darovasertib within their assigned geography. The individual will act as a key conduit of clinical, scientific, and market intelligence related to darovasertib in uveal melanoma.

This role blends advanced scientific acumen with sophisticated account leadership to drive appropriate awareness and adoption within complex academic, community, and referral-based ecosystems. The Senior OAM operates with a high degree of autonomy, managing the most strategically important accounts and serving as a trusted partner to multidisciplinary healthcare stakeholders across the treatment landscape.

Through disciplined planning and enterprise collaboration, the Senior OAM builds durable relationships, activates referral pathways, and contributes meaningfully to regional and national commercial strategy. They will effectively balance outstanding execution in targeted, high-volume accounts with the need to ensure every patient can be considered for a new therapeutic option. The Senior OAM consistently adheres to internal policies and regulatory requirements while maintaining deep expertise in disease state management, evolving clinical data, the product package insert, and access considerations.

The Senior Oncology Account Manager reports to the Regional Business Director. This is a field-based role.


Reporting to: Senior Regional Business Director

Job Description

What you’ll do:

  • Demonstrate and maintain advanced knowledge of uveal melanoma, tumor biology, emerging clinical data, the competitive environment, and darovasertib's mechanism of action
  • Independently develop and execute sophisticated territory and ecosystem-level account strategies to drive appropriate product utilization
  • Leverage scientific knowledge and executive presence to cultivate peer-level relationships with leading academic oncologists, ocular specialists, and multidisciplinary stakeholders
  • Translate complex clinical data into clear, compliant, and compelling product education tailored to each stakeholder
  • Execute pre-launch and launch strategies in alignment with national brand objectives
  • Identify, activate, and optimize referral networks across the patient journey
  • Partner strategically with Medical Affairs, Value & Access, and Patient Services to optimally support complex accounts
  • Act as the voice of the customer, delivering actionable insights to key internal stakeholders informing brand strategy, lifecycle planning, and future launch readiness.
  • Effectively utilize multiple sources of analytics and performance data to optimize resource deployment and account prioritization and adapt execution plans accordingly
  • Adherence to all administrative requirements, including budget management, expense report management, CRM call reporting and synchronization, etc., within required timelines and company guidelines
  • Ensure all promotional activities adhere to regulatory and ethical standards
  • Travel: ~80%

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, biological sciences, or related discipline
  • Minimum 10 years pharmaceutical sales related experience; minimum 5+ years oncology sales experience
  • Proven success launching a first-in-class or specialty oncology product in the US
  • Experience in rare disease, orphan oncology, or highly specialized markets strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to engage in high-level scientific dialogue with academic healthcare professionals
  • Possess comprehensive understanding of the reimbursement process and fulfillment pathways for oral oncolytics and ability to partner internally and externally to support patient access to IDEAYA’s therapies.
  • Proven track record managing complex, high-impact academic and community oncology accounts
  • Strong analytic, strategic planning, and organizational skills
  • High degree of autonomy, accountability, and professionalism
  • Patient-centric mindset grounded in integrity and scientific rigor
  • Overnight travel corresponding to territory size and needs, including occasional evening and weekend work for conferences
  • Residence within assigned geographic region

Core Competencies

  • Scientific Credibility: Comfortable discussing complex mechanisms of action, clinical endpoints, and patient needs in an accessible and differentiated way
  • Complex Selling Capability: Skilled at multi-stakeholder engagement in a complex disease state
  • Collaboration: Thrives in cross-functional partnership within a lean organization
  • Analytical Rigor: Uses data to drive prioritization and resource allocation
  • Patient-Centric Mindset: Keeps patient needs at the heart of every decision
  • Execution Excellence: Delivers results with urgency, agility, quality, and compliance

All employees are expected to act with integrity and in full compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and IDEAYA policies, including IDEAYA’s Code of Conduct.

Employees must demonstrate good judgement and ethical behavior in all business activities, maintain patient and product safety as a top priority, and report any suspected violations of law or Company policy through appropriate channels

Total Rewards

Along with our inspiring mission, and highly collaborative and inclusive environment, IDEAYA offers a competitive total rewards package that reflects our pay-for-performance philosophy where employees are eligible to be considered for merit-based salary increases, company discretionary short-term incentive plan participation, and company discretionary stock option awards (based on board approval). Our comprehensive benefits package includes, but is not limited to, medical/dental/vision coverage (100% company paid for employees and 90% company paid for dependents), 401k, ESPP, and wellness programs.

The expected salary range for the role of Senior Oncology Account Manager is $187,000 - $231,000. The final salary offered to a successful candidate will depend on several factors that may include but are not limited to the office location where this open position is located, the final candidates’ experience within their profession, experience in the disease areas we are striving to make an impact in as a company, length of time within the industry, educational background, and performance during the interview process.

• Identify emerging legal issues, gaps, or inconsistencies in requirements, documentation, testing, or system behavior and communicate needed action to stakeholders.

Qualifications and Skills:

• Experience practicing in mortgage, consumer financial services, regulatory compliance, or a related legal field, with advanced knowledge of mortgage regulatory requirements.
• Experience with mortgage fees, disclosures, documents, and related regulatory requirements, preferred.
• Experience supporting implementation or maintenance of loan origination system document logic, disclosure behavior, or document-vendor integrations, preferred.

• Comfortable collaborating across Legal, Compliance, Technology, Operations, and external vendors in a dynamic environment.
• Advanced legal research and analytical skills, including demonstrated skill in interpreting complex federal and state regulatory requirements and applying them to business processes, system functionality, and document outputs.

CrossCountry Mortgage (CCM) is the nation's number one distributed retail mortgage lender with more than 9,000 employees operating over 700 branches and servicing loans across all 50 states, D.C. and Puerto Rico. Our company has been recognized ten times on the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private businesses and has received many awards for our standout culture.

A culture where you can grow! CCM has created an exceptional culture driving employee engagement, exceeding employee expectations, and directly impacting company success. At our core, our entrepreneurial spirit empowers every employee to be who they are to help us move forward together. You’ll get unwavering support from all departments and total transparency from the top down.

CCM offers eligible employees a competitive compensation plan and a robust benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, as well as a 401K. We also offer company-provided short-term disability, an employee assistance program, and a wellness program.

Position Overview:

The Post Closing Specialist is responsible for coordinating the resolution of conditions identified by the investor during purchase review. To resolve conditions, the Post Closing Specialist is expected to research the loan file, clarify any ambiguity or potential concerns with the investor, determine alternative solutions, work with clients, partner with the appropriate departments to obtain additional or corrected documentation, and request investor exceptions as needed to clear loans for purchase in a timely manner. The Post Closing Specialist uses investor sites and the LOS system to obtain daily suspense reports, uploads documentation to the investor for curing and purchasing of loans, monitors daily workload, and documents and provides updates on all conditioned loans in the pipeline.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Obtain daily suspense reports from investor’s sites to identify loans that have be suspended for purchase.

  • Document notification of suspense information in the system, logging the date of the first condition issued on the loan daily upon receipt of the suspense condition and the suspense(s) cure by date.

  • Review and obtain clarity from the investor when needed to determine the suspense item and what the investor is looking for to cure defect.

  • Review the closed loan file to determine if suspense item(s) are already in the loan file.

  • Collaborate with internal and external departments and the clients to obtain documentation needed to cure suspense items timely.

  • Log documentation received and upload all suspense documentation promptly to investor sites for review and purchasing of the loans.

  • Monitor daily condition reports from the investor for updates on suspended loans or new conditions as received.

  • Notify management on any issues of salability at an investor.

  • Monitor time of loans on the warehouse lines and advise Post Closing Manager of those at potential risk for curtailment from the warehouse.

  • Monitor a pipeline to ensure all loans shipped are either conditioned or purchased on time.

  • Maintain knowledge of agency and investor guidelines and overlays.

  • Meet goals for monthly purchased loan as determined by management.

  • Prepare and provide Post Consummation Closing Disclosures and refund checks as needed following regulatory guidelines.

  • Additional duties as assigned.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree and/or equivalent combination of education/experience.

  • Minimum of 3 years’ experience in mortgage closing and/or post-closing activities, with an extensive knowledge of regulatory and investor guidelines for various loan programs.

  • Excellent attention to detail and decision-making skills.

  • Excellent customer service and communication skills.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite.

We believe that every student has unlimited potential, that teachers matter, and that data, instruction, and practice are the keys to success in the classroom and beyond.

Job Overview:

We are seeking an energetic, highly curious Senior Technical Project Manager (TPM) to manage the delivery and strategic evolution of our content authoring platforms. This person acts as a critical point of contact for project delivery, combining a software development management background with deep data literacy. Moving beyond traditional tracking, this role directly contributes to the system roadmap, shapes technical requirements, and drives technical discussions alongside engineering leads. Additionally, this role serves as the primary technical liaison with external vendors and state partners, leading discussions around system integrations, interoperability, and assessment technology standards.

Job Responsibilities:

Roadmap Contribution & Technical Design Leadership

  • Manage roadmap: Work closely with the Technical Directors and engineering leads to actively contribute to the system roadmap, assessing technical feasibility and infrastructure scaling needs of AI and non-AI software projects.
  • Facilitate design discussions: Facilitate and guide technical design discussions, asking critical questions to help developers hash out complex logic blockages.
  • Author technical requirements: Distill high-level business goals into detailed technical specifications and API boundary definitions.
  • Proactively manage roadblocks: Identify structural technical risks early, mitigate system constraints, and drive key technology choices.

External Technical Communications & Interoperability

  • Manage external tech communications: Serve as the primary technical interface for external organizations, state educational agencies, and client integration teams.
  • Lead data interoperability: Own technical discussions surrounding cross-platform data exchange, focusing heavily on secure integrations and standardized data pipelines.
  • Enforce edtech standards: Oversee the implementation of core educational data frameworks and ecosystem standards (e.g., QTI).
  • Align external vendor APIs: Establish clear technical data mappings and interface requirements with third-party vendors to guarantee plug-and-play platform compatibility.

Technical Analysis & Production Triage

  • Certifications: AZ-400, AZ-104 or AZ-305, CKA. Experience with GitHub Actions, Kustomize/advanced Helm, Bicep/ARM, OpenTelemetry, APM tooling (Dynatrace, Datadog, New Relic), service mesh (Istio/Linkerd), Nginx Ingress, cert-manager, external-dns.

From pure line-of-sight to extreme non-line-of-sight, Silvus radios form a self-healing, self-forming mesh network, enabling secure and reliable connectivity, including video and high-bandwidth data.

Job Summary:
As a Director of Innovation Delivery you will build AI-native products. You’ll lead cross-functional Innovation Delivery Squads—owning outcomes end-to-end across web, mobile, AI agents, and streaming backends. You’re a hands-on technical leader who can scope, architect, staff, and ship; then run the product safely at scale.

Responsibilities:

  • Stand up and run squads (Discovery → Prototype → Product → Platform & SRE).
  • Design and ship RAG/agent systems: pick models (e.g., Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google, or open-weights like Llama/Mistral), define tools/functions, and choose retrieval (default Postgres + pgvector, scale to Weaviate/Qdrant/Pinecone when needed).
  • Operate AI safely: evals & guardrails, structured outputs (JSON/Schema), PII redaction, refusal policies, cost/latency budgets, and LLM observability.
  • Own delivery outcomes: SLOs, quality, cost, velocity; release with feature flags and canaries.
  • Be client-facing: discovery, scoping, SoW, roadmap, QBRs.
  • Hire/coach Tech Leads, EMs, and PMs; level up practices.

Requirements

  • 8–12+ yrs engineering; 4+ yrs leading multi-team delivery; shipped production web/mobile systems at scale.
  • Shipped at least one production AI app using Claude/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral, backed by retrieval (pgvector or a vector DB) and a basic eval/guardrail pipeline.
  • Implemented orchestration (LangGraph/DSPy or Temporal for durable workflows), rerankers (e.g., Cohere/Jina/Voyage), and prompt/tool versioning.
  • Built with modern cloud + data: serverless/K8s, Terraform, OpenTelemetry, feature flags/experimentation.
  • Excellent client communication and commercial sense (SoWs, staffing, utilization).

Tech stack (you have hands on experience)

  • Models: Anthropic Claude; OpenAI; Google; open-weights (Llama, Mistral).
  • Orchestration & agents: LangGraph (or DSPy) for graphs; Temporal for durable, long-running tasks and SLAs.
  • Retrieval: Postgres + pgvector (default); Weaviate/Qdrant/Pinecone when scale/ops require; hybrid search with OpenSearch/Typesense.
  • Embeddings / rerankers: OpenAI/Voyage/E5/BGE; Cohere/Jina/Voyage rerank.
  • Guardrails & evals: JSON/Pydantic schemas, red-team sets, promptfoo/Ragas/DeepEval; content/PII filters.
  • Observability: OpenTelemetry traces incl. prompt/tool spans; Langfuse/Arize Phoenix (or equivalent) + Sentry/Grafana.
  • App & data: Next.js 15 (RSC), TypeScript/Go/Python; Postgres; Kafka/Redpanda/NATS; dbt/lakehouse optional.
  • Ops: Cloud Run/ECS/K8s; Terraform/OpenTofu; GitHub Actions; LaunchDarkly/Unleash; Statsig/GrowthBook.

About Teamified

Teamified is a talent partner helping companies build exceptional remote teams across IT, software, product, and digital innovation. We collaborate with leading enterprises and fast-scaling tech businesses worldwide to help them access world class talent and accelerate growth. With operations across the globe our mission is to make building high performing global teams simple, fast, and cost-effective. Teamified has hundreds of clients with more than 200 engineers, testers, product managers, designers, and technology experts delivering impactful solutions every day.

Job Summary:

Our client operates a cloud-hosted payment platform and validates against PCI DSS v4.0.1 as a Level 2 service provider via SAQ D for Service Providers. They are seeking an experienced security engineer on a three-month contract to run the annual compliance cycle to completion.

This is a hands-on engineering role combined with programme ownership. The successful candidate will implement technical control changes, assemble and quality-check the evidence set, complete the self-assessment questionnaire, and prepare the Attestation of Compliance for executive sign-off. They will work alongside the client's existing engineering and operations teams.

The evidence and documentation produced should be built to a standard suitable for external assessment, as the client anticipates moving to QSA-led Level 1 validation in a future cycle.

Responsibilities:

  • Implement and verify technical controls across the cardholder data environment: access management, secure configuration, logging and monitoring, vulnerability management, encryption and key management, and secure development practices.
  • Deliver the logging and monitoring requirements to the standard v4.0.1 expects: centralised collection of audit logs from all in-scope system components, protection of logs against alteration, twelve-month retention with three months immediately available, automated mechanisms for log review rather than manual inspection, time synchronisation, change detection on critical files, and alerting on the failure of critical security control systems.
  • Work alongside the client's DevOps engineer on the rollout of an open-source SIEM and host intrusion detection platform (Wazuh). The DevOps engineer owns the infrastructure build; this role owns the compliance outcome — defining required log sources and coverage, developing and tuning detection and correlation rules, configuring file integrity monitoring and retention to meet the standard, validating that the deployment actually satisfies the requirements, and evidencing it.
  • Define the alert triage and response routine the client team will operate day to day.
  • Complete SAQ D for Service Providers and assemble the supporting evidence set.
  • Maintain compliance documentation: network and cardholder dataflow diagrams, scoping and segmentation documentation, policies and operating procedures.
  • Engage and manage an Approved Scanning Vendor for quarterly external vulnerability scanning; drive remediation to passing scans.
  • Scope and co-ordinate penetration testing with a qualified independent provider; manage remediation and retest.
  • Maintain third-party service provider due diligence, including partner AOC collection and shared responsibility documentation.
  • Own the delivery plan: schedule, dependencies, risk log, and weekly reporting to leadership.
  • Strengthen change management practice so that changes are raised, approved, tested and evidenced consistently.
  • Document repeatable operational routines (log review, access review, scan cadence, change approval) for the client team to run after the engagement ends.

Requirements:

Essential experience

  • Demonstrable experience taking an organisation through PCI DSS compliance, ideally more than once and ideally including v4.x.
  • Working knowledge of PCI DSS v4.0.1, including the changes from v3.2.1 and the requirements mandatory from 31 March 2025.

You

Brand & Positioning Strategy

  • Own brand strategy and positioning across the full Convoy portfolio: elevate its presence in the market and sharpen messaging as we ship new features, including the performance-signal capability and business scorecards

  • Manage the existing Clay outbound contractor through the transition, and as the outbound motion scales beyond its current single-rep scope, evaluate whether a contractor or an in-house hire best fills the role
  • Build and run win-back campaigns targeting churned accounts in partnership with sales

PR & Communications

  • Land press coverage and bylined articles that build Revive's credibility in new verticals, and create PR moments around major feature launches or milestones. This is about earned media placements, not running a full, always-on PR program
  • Source and manage freelance PR support as needed to place stories, rather than retaining a full-service agency

Events

  • Research and deliver a recommended event calendar each year, a shortlist spanning platform-partner events and vertical-specific SMB events, ranked by audience fit, cost, and expected pipeline impact, for leadership to choose from
  • Own event strategy end-to-end on the events selected: vendor selection and contract negotiation, budget, and logistics
  • Represent Revive credibly in vendor negotiations and, where needed, hire and manage an on-site events team to handle floor execution

Website & Brand

  • Reset the tone, positioning, and structure of the website; direct outside development resources to execute the rebuild
  • Set creative direction for the contracted designer, who produces visuals against Revive's existing brand templates
  • Own the standards for collateral, one-sheets, and sales presentations

Content & Social

  • Set strategy and voice for LinkedIn and other channels, grounded in real fluency in Amazon DSP, programmatic, and CTV. Content should reflect informed points of view, not be explained to you article by article
  • Direct AI-assisted content production rather than personally executing every post

Budget Ownership

  • Own and build the marketing budget: propose the initial allocation across demand generation, events, content, and brand, evolve it as the function scales, and provide leadership with the rationale and expected outcomes behind spend and trade-offs
  • Build the business case for new spend, including converting the Clay contractor to an in-house hire and any additional headcount, tools, or vendor investment

Analytics & Forecasting

  • Forecast pipeline contribution from marketing-driven channels and report performance against those forecasts
  • Partner with RevOps/HubSpot to build the reporting infrastructure that ties marketing activity to pipeline, revenue, and churn win-back
  • Present regular performance updates to the CRO, explaining variance and recommending where to double down or pull back

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with RevOps/HubSpot day to day on lead scoring, routing rules, and database hygiene so marketing-sourced leads convert efficiently once they hit the CRM
  • Partner with sales on win-back campaigns, target account selection, and messaging that reflects what's actually landing in the field
  • Partner with customer success and account management to understand churn drivers and inform win-back positioning

Team Building

  • Direct the contracted designer's output. Build the business case for additional marketing headcount if and when the demand generation motion justifies it; no additional headcount is currently budgeted or planned

What Success Looks Like

  • Net-new pipeline and revenue sourced from marketing-driven channels: outbound, paid, organic, events, and content
  • Win-back rate on churned accounts
  • Event-sourced pipeline relative to cost
  • Forecast accuracy on marketing-sourced pipeline
  • Marketing spend efficiency, cost per pipeline dollar, across channels
  • Growth in external visibility: press placements, speaking opportunities, and thought leadership presence
  • A website and brand presence that reflects where Revive is headed, not where it started
  • Speed to market on GTM launches tied to new Convoy features and new verticals

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in B2B marketing with direct ownership of demand generation and pipeline, not just brand or content
  • Fluency in adtech, programmatic, or CTV, ideally from an agency, DSP, or media company background. You should arrive already conversant in the space
  • Experience shaping go-to-market for feature launches, product repositioning, or vertical expansion
  • Experience owning a marketing budget with P&L accountability and running multi-channel demand generation, spanning paid, organic, email, and outbound, not just one or two channels

  • Comfortable negotiating vendor contracts and managing external teams, including event staff, web developers, and designers
  • Experience hiring and managing a lean team

Benefits

jobs.description:
About Kody

Kody is redefining the payments landscape, providing businesses with cutting-edge payment solutions that drive profitability. As we accelerate our expansion across the Asia-Pacific region, we are seeking an experienced, aggressive, and results-driven VP of Commercial & Partnerships.

In this role, you will be the core revenue engine driver, responsible for building and scaling a high-performing sales organization, penetrating key APAC markets, and executing strategic partner alliances to achieve and exceed our ambitious revenue targets.

The Role

This is a senior revenue-generating leadership role requiring a strong sales instinct, strategic vision, and relentless operational execution.

You will lead the end-to-end commercial operations across APAC—focusing heavily on direct merchant acquisition, enterprise sales, and strategic partner networks. We are looking for an inspiring sales leader with a proven track record of managing teams.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • APAC Commercial Strategy: Formulate and execute aggressive market-entry and revenue-growth strategies across key APAC markets, identifying high-growth merchant segments and strategic verticals.
  • Direct Enterprise Deal Closing: Hands-on lead and negotiate high-value, complex payment deals with key merchants, major enterprises, and high-volume platforms.
  • Partnerships & Referral Networks: Drive strategic partner distribution channels, including ISOs, ISVs, payment facilitators, and referral partners to accelerate merchant acquisition.
  • Target & Performance Management: Set clear revenue quotas, pipeline metrics, and KPIs to track, manage, and boost overall sales output.
  • Cross-Functional Execution: Work closely with Product, Operations, and Compliance teams to streamline merchant onboarding, optimize payment conversion rates, and enhance local payment method integrations.
  • Market Insights: Stay close to APAC market trends, regulatory shifts, and competitor movements to refine Kody’s pricing models, value proposition, and product roadmap.

Requirements

  • Track Record in Sales Leadership: 5+ years of experience building, scaling, and managing high-volume B2B/Enterprise sales teams, with documented experience delivering annual TPV.
  • Deep B2B Solution Sales Expertise: Proven track record in complex B2B solution selling, enterprise deal-closing, or value-based selling. Strong knowledge of global/APAC payment ecosystems or financial tech is a major plus, but candidates from high-growth B2B SaaS, Tech, or Financial Services with strong learning agility are highly welcome.
  • Proven Closing Capability: A strong personal reputation for personally driving, negotiating, and closing complex commercial agreements with long sales cycles.
  • Channel & Referral Mastery: Proven expertise in building and leveraging ISO/Referral Partner programs and strategic alliance networks to scale distribution.
  • APAC Market Experience: Deep understanding of commercial dynamics, merchant behavior, and payment preferences across major APAC markets.
  • Leadership & Drive: Exceptional communication, negotiation, and resilience—a proactive leader who thrives under pressure in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive Total Compensation: An attractive base salary coupled with a high-upside, uncapped performance bonus/commission structure tied to revenue and TPV growth.
  • Equity & Ownership: Stock options / equity components that allow you to directly share in the long-term success and value creation of Kody.
  • Career Growth & Global Exposure: High visibility within senior global leadership, with ample room for personal career advancement as Kody continues its rapid global scale-up.

We are looking for Systems Requirements Engineer Jr:

Intermediate System Requirements Engineer – Infotainment Subsystem
Acts as the key liaison between Design & Release Engineers (DREs) and System Architects, ensuring that technical and regulatory needs are translated into clear, specific, and actionable requirements for the design, development, validation, and release of vehicle electrical and electronic components.

Utilizes Requirements Engineering methodologies to elicit, analyze, document, and maintain system requirements. Experienced in specialized tools such as IBM DOORS for requirements management, IBM Engineering Workflow Management (RTC) for workflow control, and JIRA for issue tracking.

Collaborates closely in system design and development, actively participating in the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Applies analytical methods such as DFMEA to ensure the quality and reliability of the infotainment system, including the integration of advanced technologies such as Apple CarPlay and Android Auto.

Activities:

    • Write, update, and maintain technical requirements for the Infotainment subsystem (and Cabin Thermal & Safety, as applicable) throughout production phases.
    • Conduct requirements elicitation through stakeholder interviews and workshops.
    • Utilize IBM DOORS for requirements management and traceability.

2. Systems Analysis & Design

    • Perform system requirements analysis using established engineering methodologies.
    • Collaborate in the design and development of infotainment hardware and software systems.
    • Support system modeling and architecture activities.

3. Technical Coordination & Liaison

    • Act as the key link between Design & Release Engineers (DREs) and System Architects.
    • Work cross-functionally with multidisciplinary engineering teams to ensure correct hardware–software integration.

4. Diagnostics & Troubleshooting

    • Identify, analyze, and resolve hardware and software system failures.
    • Apply diagnostic tools to detect and address technical issues.

5. Project Tracking & Workflow Control

    • Use IBM Engineering Workflow Management (RTC) and JIRA to manage workflows, tasks, and issue tracking.
    • Contribute to the complete Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) for infotainment components.

6. Quality Assurance & Risk Analysis

    • Conduct thorough testing to validate system functionality and reliability.
    • Perform DFMEA to identify and mitigate potential design risks.

7. Technical Documentation

    • Create and maintain detailed records of diagnosed issues, implemented solutions, and established requirements.
    • Prepare and update technical documentation, including specifications and reports.

This is a part-time 1099 independent contractor role, designed to convert to a full-time salaried position as the ACCESS program scales. We expect this transition to occur as the program grows toward 1,000+ patients, contingent on program growth and mutual fit.

Clinical care

Orbit has a strong runway through PCR’s installed base, with a large horizontal opportunity beyond it. Orbit is the starting point, not the finish line. We intend to keep shipping modules and adjacent products over time to address more of the IT workflow in higher ed and the public sector, leveraging PCR’s distribution and Valsoft’s operational strength to move quickly.

The role

This is a hands on operator role. You will be a key bridge between the market and product, turning customer discovery into clear requirements, prioritization, and shipped capabilities that drive adoption and profitable growth. You will also continuously look for ways to grow Orbit and expand the opportunity, both by extending Orbit into adjacent workflows and by identifying new modules or product opportunities beyond Orbit that fit the higher ed and public sector IT workflow where PCR already plays today.

As traction grows, we will add tools and capacity such as marketing support, SDR support, and partners, but early on you will be the person driving momentum.

What you’ll do and own

1) Own revenue end to end, hands on

  • Own new revenue for Orbit and take a hands on approach to closing business
  • Build pipeline through targeted outbound, webinars and events, partnerships, and leveraging PCR’s installed base
  • Run deals end to end from discovery to demo to pilot or proof to proposal to negotiation to close
  • Sell to cross functional stakeholders and buying committees across IT, procurement, finance, and operations

Seeking a detail-oriented and highly analytical Registered Nurse (RN) to join our team in a HEDIS Abstraction role, supporting critical healthcare quality initiatives across Pennsylvania. While the home office is based in Harrisburg, this position is fully virtual and open to candidates located anywhere within the state. This role offers a unique opportunity for experienced RNs who are looking to step away from bedside care and apply their clinical expertise in a focused, data-driven environment that directly influences patient outcomes and healthcare performance.

In this role, you will be responsible for reviewing and abstracting clinical data from medical records in accordance with HEDIS (Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set) measures. You will analyze documentation related to preventive care, chronic disease management, and behavioral health services, ensuring all information is accurately captured and compliant with NCQA guidelines and measure specifications. Collaboration is also a key component of this position. You will work closely with healthcare providers, health plans, and internal quality teams to resolve discrepancies and clarify documentation when needed. Simultaneously, the role offers a high level of independence, allowing you to manage your workflow in a structured remote environment while maintaining performance expectations.

The role will begin with accounting support, data entry, document processing, and transaction review — with the opportunity to grow into Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, job costing, reconciliations, financial reporting support, and broader accounting responsibilities.

We are not looking for a data-entry employee. We are looking for someone who understands accounting principles, asks good questions, identifies discrepancies, takes ownership of their work, and has the ability to grow into a larger accounting role within the company.

  • Enter and maintain accounting transactions accurately and timely
  • Process vendor invoices and supporting documentation
  • Assist with Accounts Payable transaction entry and organization
  • Assist with Accounts Receivable transaction entry and customer account information

  • Accounts Payable management and processing
  • Accounts Receivable management and processing

• Customer account reconciliations

  • Review and classification of expenses

  • Preparing accounting schedules and reports
  • Identifying accounting discrepancies and researching their cause
  • Supporting cash flow and financial reporting processes
  • Assisting with preparation of information needed for quarterly and annual reporting
  • Working directly with company management and outside accounting and tax professionals
  • Developing improved accounting procedures, controls, and workflows
  • Taking increasing ownership of accounting functions as experience with the company grows

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a closely related field
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles
  • Professional accounting experience preferred
  • CPA or equivalent professional accounting designation preferred — not required for an exceptional candidate
  • Experience with Accounts Payable and/or Accounts Receivable
  • Experience performing account reconciliations
  • Strong Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills

  • Construction accounting or job costing/project-based accounting

  • ERP, construction management, or project management systems

• Vendor invoice processing

• Customer billing and collections

  • Bank and credit card reconciliations

• Month-end close support

• Financial reporting support

  • Experience working successfully in a remote environment

  • Comfortable receiving feedback and learning new responsibilities
  • Interested in developing professionally and taking on greater responsibility over time
  • Looking for a long-term opportunity rather than simply completing assigned tasks

Growth Opportunity

This position is designed to grow. The initial priority will be learning the company and becoming highly reliable with transactional accounting and accounting support. As the employee demonstrates accuracy, accounting knowledge, judgment, communication, and ownership, we expect the position to develop into increasingly responsible accounting functions.

A successful employee could eventually progress through:

Accounting Support → Accounts Payable & Receivable → Reconciliations & Job Costing → Month-End Accounting → Financial Reporting Support → Broader Accounting Responsibilities
