jobs.description:
FreedUp is seeking a highly proactive and detail-oriented Executive Assistant Associate (EA) to support the Founder & CEO of a fast-growing, systems-driven organization. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on structure, accountability, and clarity — and who can act as a true extension of the executive by turning complexity into calm, repeatable execution.

We are a high-performance team built around ownership, responsiveness, and continuous improvement. The Executive Assistant will play a critical role in stabilizing and scaling the CEO’s day-to-day operations, acting as his “functioning memory,” improving written communication quality, and ensuring nothing slips through the cracks.

This role goes beyond traditional administrative support. You will own core operational processes, manage communication systems, coordinate recruiting pipelines, and help implement tools and SOPs that reduce cognitive load for the CEO and leadership team.

This is a full-time, remote position requiring exceptional written communication, strong follow-through, comfort with sensitive information, and the ability to proactively manage both professional and limited personal tasks.

Location: Fully Remote- Brazil

Job Type: Full-Time

Salary: $1000 - $1,800 per month (based on experience)

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience supporting senior executives as an EA, Operations Coordinator, or similar role.
  • Exceptional written communication skills — must be a stronger writer than the executive.
  • Proven ability to follow and replicate structured formats
  • Strong organizational and execution skills
  • Comfortable acting as a “memory system” for a fast-moving CEO.
  • Strong organizational instincts and follow-through.
  • Ability to work with systems and SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures)
  • Capability to anticipate needs and provide context-based assistance
  • Able to handle confidential and sensitive information responsibly.
  • Tech-comfortable and adaptable to evolving systems and tools.
  • Thrives in high-accountability, high-clarity environments.
  • Technical Requirements: Reliable high-speed internet and a modern home office setup.

Key Responsibilities

Email & Communication Management

  • Triage and manage Exec's inbox which is overwhelmed with client emails
  • Review emails flagged by Fixer AI and determine which ones actually need Exec's response
  • Filter out false positives from the AI system to prevent inbox clutter
  • Organize emails into four folders: "Action Needed," "Read Later," "If Interested," and "Follow Up"
  • Proofread and edit all outgoing communications to improve clarity and accuracy.

Meeting & Calendar Coordination

  • Act as a gatekeeper for Executive's calendar
  • Manage interview scheduling and coordination
  • Handle ad hoc meeting requests from team members.
  • Coordinate complex multi-timezone scheduling across Brazil, India, and US time zones
  • Enforce calendar boundaries to prevent overboking

CRM Management & Data Integrity

  • Maintain a clean, accurate, and fully up-to-date CRM system
  • Ensure all records include:
    • Complete contact details
    • Proper formatting and structure
    • Correct hyperlinks and notes
  • Continuously improve CRM organization for usability and efficiency

Task Delegation & Tracking:

  • Build and maintain a personal operating system (using Notion) with SOPs and task tracking
  • Organize meeting notes and action items from meetings
  • Track follow-ups and ensure accountability on tasks
  • Consolidate insurance information
  • Proactively identify inefficiencies and propose improvements
  • Manage outstanding personal administrative task
  • Consolidate and back up important digital personal files securely
  • Assist with personal life tasks (travel bookings, appointments, etc.)
  • Help with anything that reduces admin stress and frees up Exec's time

Data & File Management

  • Consolidate and back up important digital personal files securely
  • Organize personal documents (insurance cards, wills, power of attorney, etc.)
  • Maintain organized digital folders for personal records
  • Document and build standard operating procedures (SOPs) from day one

Systems & Tools

  • Communicate daily via Slack with structured updates.
  • Fixer AI, Google workspace, Calendly, HubSpot, ToDoist
  • BuilderTrend (construction software with CRM and sales pipeline features)
  • Help expand Notion usage for SOPs, documentation, and a lightweight CRM.
  • Fireflies (meeting recording and transcription

Benefits

  • International experience
  • Opportunity to work remotely from anywhere
  • Supportive and collaborative team environment
  • Learning and development opportunities
  • Potential Performance Bonuses
  • PTO
  • HMO after 3 months

Salary range: $115,000 - $130,000

tmp helps B2B marketing leaders create coherence in a chaotic world. We’re looking for obsessively curious people to join us.

You'll join 300 B2B experts across strategy, data, creative, media, client services, Sales activation, and shared services. Different skills brought together in integrated teams, centred around our clients: the world’s most impactful tech companies.

So, if you’re interested in what makes the world work, if you find solving complex problems fun, and you love making the answers as simple as possible, then we’d love to hear from you.

What we are looking for

We are looking for an experienced cross-channel media leader who will develop, present, and oversee integrated media strategies for complex global B2B organizations. The Media Director serves as a strategic advisor to clients, leads media planning excellence across a portfolio of accounts, mentors team members, and helps shape the future direction of TMP’s media capabilities.

What you will do:

Media Strategy and Planning  

  • Lead the development of integrated cross-channel media strategies for complex global B2B clients.
  • Provide executive-level recommendations that connect media investment to business outcomes.
  • Oversee optimization of media programs and ensure strategic adjustments are implemented based on performance.
  • Partner with Strategy, Creative, Analytics and Client Services to develop integrated client solutions.
  • Own media measurement frameworks that connect channel performance to pipeline, revenue and business impact.

Client Leadership 

  • Serve as the senior media lead and strategic advisor for assigned clients.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior marketing, revenue, and business stakeholders.
  • Lead executive presentations, performance reviews, and strategic planning discussions.
  • Guide clients through investment decisions, trade-offs, and performance challenges.

Commercial Growth  

  • Identify opportunities for account growth through expanded media solutions and integrated programs.
  • Support new business opportunities, pitches, and strategic media recommendations.
  • Partner with Client Services and leadership on account planning and revenue forecasting.

Media Leadership & Capability Development

  • Mentor and coach Media Supervisors, Planners, and Specialists.
  • Develop planning frameworks, POVs, and best practices for the agency.
  • Help shape the future direction of media capabilities, partnerships, and service offerings.
  • Foster collaboration across media, creative, analytics and strategy teams.

Requirements

Who you are:

  • At least 8 years of experience in the field of media, agency experience preferred.
  • A seasoned professional with demonstrated skill sets for client interaction and communication; able to manage client requests with sound rationale.
  • Proven ability to synthesize data & results, identify trends & key findings, and fuel content strategies.
  • Previous managerial experience with solid ability to lead, inspire and rally a team.
  • Experience working collaboratively with internal and external agency partners to set a clear vision and foster strong collaboration and partnership.
  • Ability to quickly identify and resolve challenges in a client-centric environment.

What you will need:

  • B2B marketing experience, preferably within an agency setting.
  • Strong track record of developing and overseeing cross-channel media strategies.
  • Strong commercial understanding, with experience managing media budgets and making strategic investment and optimization decisions
  • Ability to use data, measurement, and insights to demonstrate media performance and business impact.
  • Confidence presenting media strategies, recommendations, and performance to senior client stakeholders.
  • Evidence of working with cross-discipline teams (strategy, creative, technology, media, and project management).

Benefits

What we offer in return

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance: Health is a priority worth investing in. We empower every employee to take charge of their health by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance so they can perform at their best ability.
  • Pre-tax flexible spending account (FSA) – healthcare, dependent care, and transit available: We are committed to saving you money as we provide high-quality healthcare that is as flexible and diverse as our team.
  • 4% 401(k) contribution with no vesting period: We are invested in our employees' careers. Each individual has the opportunity to build a future for themselves through a 401(k), and we see that as a success for the company as well.
  • Plentiful paid time off: Each employee has the freedom to choose how long they want to be away from work. We recommend at least 20 days of PTO, so employees can fully rest and avoid burnout.
  • Sick leave (15 days annually): Illnesses are taken seriously at tmp. We provide 15 days of sick leave so employees can take their time to make a full recovery before returning to work.
  • Holiday shutdown (December 26th - 29th): As the whole company shuts down for a few days, you can celebrate the holidays with loved ones.
  • Parental leave:
    • Primary caregiver: 12 weeks full pay and then 12 weeks 50% pay
    • Secondary caregiver: 12 weeks full pay
  • Access to Unmind: Our well-being platform, including access to therapists and coaches
  • Employer-funded life, AD&D & disability insurance: tmp offers all employees life and AD&D insurance and makes sure you and your loved ones are protected in times of need.
  • Company getaways: Whether it is a local office holiday party or a full-blown international trip, we believe in bonding through quality time spent together as a team.

We are currently eligible to hire within these US states:

CA, CO, IL, WA, and TX.

A note on applying:

Not sure you tick every box? Apply anyway. Research shows some people hold back unless they meet 100% of the requirements. We do not want that to be you.

At tmp, we hire for potential, mindset, and character as much as experience. If you are excited about the role but your background is not a perfect match, we would still love to hear from you. You might be exactly what we are looking for, either for this role or another.

Diversity equals increased creativity, which equals better results for all. We’re committed to equality of opportunity and applications from all individuals are encouraged. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please don’t hesitate to let us know.

jobs.excerpt: Job SummaryWe are seeking a PEP Data Scientist to pivot and align global Politically Exposed Person (PEP) screening strategies with regional nuances.
jobs.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a PEP Data Scientist to pivot and align global Politically Exposed Person (PEP) screening strategies with regional nuances. This role will design data-driven solutions that harmonize policies across jurisdictions, balancing local regulatory requirements with global compliance standards.

The successful candidate will translate complex datasets into actionable, scalable strategies that optimize PEP detection and minimize false positives. This position requires extensive cross-functional collaboration across engineering, advisory, and regulatory teams to ensure alignment with business objectives and global compliance expectations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive comprehensive initiatives to strengthen PEP screening capabilities across all regions, ensuring detection and risk mitigation objectives align with regulatory expectations while maintaining seamless customer experiences.
  • Collaborate with First Line of Defense, product management, engineering, and business units to develop strategic frameworks and roadmaps for global PEP screening initiatives.
  • Oversee the complete development lifecycle of PEP screening solutions—from concept through implementation—ensuring scalability, performance, and compliance alignment.
  • Analyze and interpret emerging regulatory requirements, working closely with regional MLROs to establish clear Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) and translate guidance into actionable, data-driven solutions.
  • Partner with engineering teams to implement regulatory changes and system enhancements across production environments.
  • Work with advisory and regional policy teams to refine PEP list definitions and classification criteria, ensuring comprehensive risk coverage.
  • Conduct advanced data exploration and statistical analysis to identify inefficiencies in screening workflows, providing actionable recommendations for process improvements.
  • Analyze large-scale datasets to extract meaningful insights, develop recommendations, and present findings that drive business decisions.
  • Provide technical mentorship and business guidance to junior data scientists, fostering team capability and development.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure real-time integration and deployment of analytical solutions, maintaining reliability and performance standards.

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience and a Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree with a minimum of five years’ experience in sanctions transaction screening, PEP and negative news screening, or AML, including at least three years in data analytics or data science.
  • In-depth understanding of PEP screening and sanctions programs administered by regulators such as OFAC, EU, UN, CSSF, and related adjacency risks.
  • Proficiency in SQL (Google Cloud BigQuery), Python (Pandas, Numpy, PySpark), R, Tableau, and Power BI.
  • Strong data manipulation, profiling, and analysis skills; familiarity with Lexis Nexis WorldCompliance+ data source.
  • Experience with Hadoop, Hive, Jupyter Notebooks, and data warehouse environments highly desirable.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of translating analytical insights into actionable business recommendations.
  • Proven ability to design and implement data-driven compliance solutions for complex global operations.
  • Strong intellectual curiosity, strategic thinking, and comfort navigating ambiguity.
  • Advanced research, analytical, and project leadership skills with solid business acumen.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, global environment.
  • Skilled in presenting complex quantitative analyses clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

jobs.description:
Tech Lead (Backend)

🕙 Role details: This is a full time role

💷 Salary: €92,000 - €110,000

🌍 Location: Ireland - Remote

The role

We are looking for a Platform Engineering Lead to own the technical implementation and scalability of our cloud infrastructure. As the technical authority for our backend team, you will be responsible for ensuring our Digital Pathway Platform is architected for seamless scalability across international health systems.

This is a pivotal leadership position where you will drive technical excellence, directly impacting the lives of millions of patients by enabling a new asynchronous and remote operating model for healthcare.

What You’ll Do

    • Own the platform & infrastructure: Lead the architecture, security, and stability of our GCP platform, ensuring it is built for 100% YoY growth.
    • Lead the backend team: Manage and inspire a high-performance team of senior and mid-level backend engineers (3-5 people), fostering a culture of engineering excellence that balances pace with uncompromising quality.
    • Drive platform efficiency: Act as the primary steward for technical cost-optimisation and resource management, ensuring the platform scales efficiently as our user base grows.
    • Architect complex integrations: Design robust systems to handle deep integrations with external partner APIs, managing diverse authentication mechanisms and resilient data patterns.
    • Drive technical strategy: Act as a key partner to the CTO and Director of Engineering (currently also being hired), aligning technical execution with business objectives.
    • Embed operational excellence: Refine best-in-class engineering practices - including IaC via Terraform, CI/CD, and security audit readiness - to prevent major production incidents.
    • Lead AI workflows: Act as an authority to drive agentic workflows forwards across the team

Why This Role is Unique

We are building a new operating model for healthcare in which care is delivered remotely, asynchronously and increasingly personalised. You will be building the infrastructure for how we deliver this shift. This role offers the rare opportunity to exercise true technical ownership over a mission-critical platform.

You will have the autonomy to set the technical pace, drive architectural decisions, and foster a culture of engineering excellence across the backend organisation. If you are a builder who thrives on high-stakes platform stability and wants to lead a team through 100% YoY growth, this role provides a level of agency and impact rarely found in later-stage environments.

Who We Are

Isla Health is a venture-backed healthtech startup, supporting our partners across the UK, EU and internationally beyond this. We have built a new category of healthcare technology which we refer to as the Digital Pathway Platform (DPP). Founded in 2019, we now support 25% of NHS Trusts and see over 2 million submissions on the platform each year.

As a company we are all laser focused on enabling a scalable model of care which empowers healthcare staff and improves patient outcomes. The DPP supports this by setting up digital pathways which are remote-first and asynchronous. As pathways harness sophisticated automation, clinical algorithms and intelligent cohorting, patients always take the optimised route through their pathway, thereby delivering a step change in clinical productivity.

The Team

You will be joining a lean & high performing engineering organisation. We value pace, but also hold really high quality standards for each other.

  • The structure: You will lead the Backend/Platform team. As the lead, you will report directly to our Director of Engineering.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: You’ll work in a tight loop with our Product, Design, and Frontend teams.
  • Our tech & tools:
    • We lean into modern, scalable infrastructure (Node.js, TypeScript, GCP). We prioritise tools that enable velocity - such as Terraform and automated CI/CD.
    • We also lean heavily into AI, and you’ll be able (encouraged) to use whatever tools you need to scale your own and the team’s workflows

Requirements

    • Proven technical leadership: Experience as a Lead or Senior Engineer, ideally having managed scaling challenges in a high-growth startup.
    • Cloud & platform mastery: Deep hands-on experience with a cloud platform and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform).
    • Backend expertise: Expert-level understanding of Node.js and TypeScript.
    • Integration experience: Comfortable architecting platforms that interact with diverse third-party APIs and robust authentication protocols.
    • People management: A passion for mentoring and managing engineers.

Benefits

🏡 Work from home - this is a remote first role

🕜 Flexible working times

🌍 Work abroad for up to 90 days per year

🏖️ 25 days annual leave on top of Irish bank holidays. Plus, take your birthday off and another significant day off of your choice 🎂

🍜 Quarterly meal on us enjoy up to £75 to treat friends or family

🧘‍♀️ Private medical insurance

🎉 Enhanced parental leave to support your family when it matters most

🎳 Quarterly team socials based in London

📚 An annual learning budget to support your growth

💗 Work with purpose - you'll be delivering social impact through improved patient healthcare

🚀 Join at an exciting stage - we're a well-funded, rapidly growing health tech company tackling a global challenge

🌱 Help shape the future of Isla - your ideas won't disappear into layers of management. You'll have real ownership, real impact, and help define how we grow the business

------

What is the hiring process for this role at Isla?

Hiring Process

Interviewing with us for the Lead Backend role will be split into 4 stages (all conducted virtually):

1) A screening interview with one of our People Operations team

2) A take home technical task

3) A technical interview with two of our Engineers. This will be a strategy deep dive: We will run through a scenario to challenge you on your decision making, the speed of your technical understanding, your communication and your out-of-the-box thinking

4) A final interview with our Director of Engineering (Dylan) and CTO/Co-founder (James)

Diversity and Inclusion

Isla is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building an inclusive and diverse team. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply. Isla does not discriminate against anyone on the basis of their race, gender, disability, religion, national origin, age, or any other protected category. We choose to celebrate our team’s differences and see them as one of our most valuable assets.

Recruitment is not one-size-fits-all and we're happy to tailor our hiring process to better meet the needs of individual applicants. Please email with any requests for support.

jobs.title: 4463-Head of Thought Leadership
jobs.excerpt: About the Role Innovaccer is building the AI-native, autonomous operations platform for healthcare — and we need someone to own the story of what that means.
jobs.description:
About the Role

Innovaccer is building the AI-native, autonomous operations platform for healthcare — and we need someone to own the story of what that means. The Head of Thought Leadership owns messaging and positioning at two levels: the company-wide healthcare autonomy narrative that defines what Innovaccer is, and the category-level frame that sits above our four solutions (Gravity, Atlas, Galaxy, and Flow) so they read as one company’s story rather than four separate products.

This is a research-and-influence role, not a command role. Each solution has its own Head of Marketing who owns that solution’s strategy, pipeline, and messaging sign-off directly — senior, strategic peers, not people you manage. You earn alignment by being the best-informed point of view in the building: the person who has done the analyst research, tracked the competitive landscape, and built a category narrative good enough that four GM-level peers choose to work inside it.

A Day in the Life

  • Own the central healthcare autonomy narrative — the company-wide argument for why $1.1T in human-dependent healthcare admin spend is shifting to autonomous software, and why Innovaccer’s Memory / Intelligence / Orchestrated Execution architecture and autonomy maturity path (L1–L5) is the credible way to get there.
  • Keep that narrative current as the market moves — refresh the proof points (workflow counts, model benchmarks, customer results) regularly while keeping the underlying argument stable enough that it doesn’t reset with every update.
  • Own the research base the rest of the role runs on: analyst positioning (KLAS, Gartner, Forrester, and equivalents), competitive messaging and claims, and market and category narrative trends in healthcare AI. Brief analysts directly at the category level.
  • Define the category messaging framework that sits above all four solutions — the shared vocabulary, category claims, and narrative architecture each solution’s messaging should sit inside — built together with each solution’s Head of Marketing, not handed down.
  • Work with each Head of Marketing, through a dotted-line relationship, to catch messaging drift early and keep solution-level narrative aligned with the category framework — through influence and a shared framework, not sign-off authority.
  • Ensure the same central narrative and category framework show up consistently across every channel — PR, LinkedIn, blog, website, and internal communications — regardless of which solution or team originated the content. Partner with PR, Content, and Analyst Relations to keep output aligned, without owning their headcount.
  • Represent Innovaccer’s category point of view externally — bylines, speaking opportunities, and analyst-facing narrative that sits above any single solution — and identify the handful of category-level arguments worth having a strong, consistent public point of view on.
  • Run a regular forum with all four Heads of Marketing to keep the framework current, and escalate directly and collaboratively — peer to peer — when a solution’s messaging has drifted.

What You Need

  • 10+ years of experience in category marketing, communications, or thought leadership, ideally in healthcare technology, healthcare IT, or enterprise AI.
  • A track record of building and defending a category-level narrative — not just a product pitch — including direct experience briefing industry analysts (KLAS, Gartner, Forrester, or equivalents).
  • Strong understanding of healthcare AI, automation, and the operational/administrative cost structure of U.S. healthcare.
  • The judgment and credibility to influence senior, strategic peers without formal authority over them — this role leads through the strength of its research and argument, not through sign-off power.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable representing the company externally (press, analysts, speaking engagements) and building a shared framework internally.
  • Demonstrated ability to think at the category level while staying grounded in what is actually true and defensible for individual products — this role has no authority to override product-level positioning calls.
  • Self-motivated and comfortable operating with real ambiguity in a fast-moving, category-defining company.

Here’s What We Offer

  • Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge and relax with 20 days of fixed time off per year, in addition to company holidays—because we believe work-life balance fuels performance.
  • Best-in-Class Parental Leave: Spend quality time with your growing family. We offer one of the industry’s most generous parental leave policies to support you during life’s most important moments.
  • Recognition & Rewards: We celebrate wins—big and small. Get rewarded with monetary incentives and company-wide recognition for your impact and dedication. Your hard work won’t go unnoticed.
  • Comprehensive Insurance Coverage: Stay covered with medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus 100% company-paid short- and long-term disability and basic life insurance. Optional perks include discounted legal aid and pet insurance.

We offer competitive benefits to set you up for success in and outside of work.

jobs.title: RCM Training & Process Optimization Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Company Overview RethinkFirst was founded in 2007 with a mission to provide scalable, evidence-based autism treatment training tools and caregiver supports to an underserved population.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

RethinkFirst was founded in 2007 with a mission to provide scalable, evidence-based autism treatment training tools and caregiver supports to an underserved population. In 2010, Rethink launched its first solution, a suite of special needs and behavior management offerings, to support K-12 education. Over time, we expanded our offerings to support the entire behavioral health community by adding solutions in the employer (RethinkCare), provider (RethinkBH), and payor (RethinkFutures) industries, and to drive whole child wellness and success in education (RethinkEd).

Today, we’re proud to have almost 500 team members working to support over 2,000 customers worldwide as we work together to support our communities and help every individual reach their potential.

Over the past fifteen years, RethinkFirst’s mission has evolved to transform the behavioral health landscape by inspiring and empowering all individuals with behavioral health challenges and those who support them. We continue to focus on the future of transforming behavioral health through data science, analytics, and enabling value-based care. With patent-pending solutions and the largest published ASD dataset, RethinkFirst can focus on improving outcomes and having a positive impact on the millions of lives it supports.  

Rethink Billing Overview

Our Billing Services Division specializes in Revenue Cycle Management, Enrollment and Credentialing, and Benefit Authorization Management services. We are growing and are looking for new team members that will offer our clients best-in-class billing services. We support mission-oriented companies that impact the lives of thousands of individuals with autism and their families. We are excited to offer the opportunity for professional and collaborative individuals to grow and be part of something exciting.

Job Summary

The RCM Training & Process Optimization Specialist is responsible for developing, standardizing, and delivering training and operational documentation across Revenue Cycle Management (RCM).

This role serves as a subject matter resource for RCM systems, workflows, and processes across functions including Billing, Accounts Receivable, Payment Posting/Cash Reconciliation, and other RCM operational teams. The Specialist will work closely with operational leaders and team members to understand current workflows, learn new systems and functionality, identify opportunities for process improvement, and translate those processes into clear, scalable Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), workflows, job aids, and training materials.

While this position will support onboarding and training of new team members, its primary focus is broader: ensuring RCM teams have well-defined, documented, and optimized processes and are effectively trained when systems, technology, or operational workflows change.

Key Responsibilities

RCM Training & Team Development

  • Develop and deliver structured training for RCM team members across Billing, Accounts Receivable, Payment Posting/Cash Reconciliation, and other revenue cycle functions.

  • Lead training for new team members as hiring and onboarding needs arise.

  • Develop ongoing education and refresher training for existing team members.

  • Create training programs for new systems, system enhancements, automation, and changes to RCM workflows.

  • Translate complex system functionality and RCM processes into clear, practical training that team members can apply in their daily work.

  • Conduct live demonstrations, workflow walkthroughs, and hands-on system training.

  • Assess training effectiveness and identify areas where additional education, documentation, or process clarification is needed.

  • Partner with RCM leadership to identify knowledge gaps and develop targeted training to address them.

SOP & Workflow Development

  • Own the development and maintenance of SOPs across RCM departments.

  • Work directly with operational teams to understand existing workflows from beginning to end.

  • Document standardized workflows, procedures, business rules, escalation paths, and system requirements.

  • Create clear, detailed SOPs that enable team members to consistently execute RCM processes.

  • Develop workflow diagrams, process maps, checklists, job aids, and other supporting documentation where appropriate.

  • Establish consistent standards and templates for RCM SOPs and training documentation.

  • Maintain a centralized library of current RCM SOPs, workflows, training materials, and job aids.

  • Establish a regular review process to ensure documentation remains current as systems and operational requirements change.

Systems & Technology Enablement

  • Develop a strong working knowledge of systems and technology used across RCM operations.

  • Become a subject matter resource for new systems and functionality introduced to the RCM organization.

  • Participate in system implementations, enhancements, and operational changes to understand how new functionality impacts existing workflows.

  • Test and validate workflows from an operational perspective before developing training and documentation.

  • Translate system functionality into practical RCM workflows and step-by-step procedures.

  • Develop and deliver training prior to system or workflow changes being rolled out to operational teams.

  • Serve as a bridge between system functionality and day-to-day RCM operations.

RCM Process Optimization

  • Evaluate existing RCM workflows to identify inefficiencies, unnecessary manual steps, inconsistencies, and opportunities for standardization or automation.

  • Partner with RCM leaders and operational subject matter experts to develop improved future-state workflows.

  • Look beyond documenting the current process and actively identify opportunities to make workflows more efficient, scalable, and consistent.

  • Identify processes that can be simplified, standardized, automated, or supported through improved system utilization.

  • Document both current-state and future-state workflows when significant operational changes are being implemented.

  • Help establish standardized processes across teams where workflows currently vary by individual, client, or department.

  • Support implementation of process improvements through documentation, training, and post-implementation follow-up.

  • Monitor newly implemented workflows and gather feedback to determine whether additional optimization or training is required.

Key Deliverables

The RCM Training & Process Optimization Specialist will be accountable for producing and maintaining:

  • Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

  • End-to-end RCM workflow documentation

  • Process maps and workflow diagrams

  • System training materials

  • New-hire training materials

  • Job aids and quick-reference guides

  • Process and system change training

  • Standardized workflow documentation across RCM departments

  • Training assessments and knowledge checks

  • Documentation supporting new technology and automation initiatives

  • Current-state and future-state process documentation for major workflow changes

Qualifications

  • Strong understanding of Revenue Cycle Management operations and healthcare billing workflows.

  • Experience working within one or more RCM functions such as Billing, Accounts Receivable, Payment Posting, Cash Reconciliation, Claims Management, or related revenue cycle operations.

  • Ability to quickly learn new systems, technology, and operational processes.

  • Strong ability to understand an end-to-end workflow and identify dependencies between teams, systems, and processes.

  • Experience developing SOPs, process documentation, training materials, or operational workflows.

  • Strong written communication skills with the ability to turn complex processes into clear, easy-to-follow instructions.

  • Experience training individuals or groups in systems, processes, or operational procedures.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify workflow inefficiencies and recommend improvements.

  • Comfortable working directly with operational team members and leadership to gather information and validate processes.

  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and documentation standards.

  • Ability to manage multiple documentation, training, and process-improvement initiatives simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting RCM system implementations, migrations, or technology changes.

  • Experience with workflow mapping and process improvement.

  • Experience developing structured training programs or learning materials.

  • Familiarity with RCM automation and technology-enabled workflows.

  • Experience working across multiple RCM departments rather than within a single functional area.

  • Experience supporting distributed or offshore RCM teams is a plus.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means RCM processes are not dependent on tribal knowledge. Team members have clear, current documentation showing how work should be performed, new systems and workflow changes are supported by structured training, and operational processes are continuously evaluated for opportunities to improve efficiency and consistency.

The RCM Training & Process Optimization Specialist should become a trusted resource who can enter an unfamiliar RCM workflow or system, learn how it works, understand how it connects to the broader revenue cycle, identify opportunities to improve the process, document the optimal workflow, and effectively train the team to execute it.

Location: Remote opportunities are available to candidates who reside in the following states: AL, AZ, AR, CA, CO, FL, GA, ID, IL, IN, IO, MO, NE, NC, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA

Our commitment to an inclusive workplace

RethinkFirst is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing a workplace free from harassment and discrimination. We celebrate the unique differences of our employees because that is what drives curiosity, innovation, and the success of our business. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws. Accommodations are available for applicants with disabilities.

jobs.excerpt: If you are looking for a career at a dynamic company with a people-first mindset and a deep culture of growth and autonomy, ACV is the right place for you!
jobs.description:
If you are looking for a career at a dynamic company with a people-first mindset and a deep culture of growth and autonomy, ACV is the right place for you! Competitive compensation packages and learning and development opportunities, ACV has what you need to advance to the next level in your career. We will continue to raise the bar every day by investing in our people and technology to help our customers succeed. We hire people who share our passion, bring innovative ideas to the table, and enjoy a collaborative atmosphere.

Who we are:

ACV is a technology company that has revolutionized how dealers buy and sell cars online. We are transforming the automotive industry. ACV Auctions Inc. (ACV), has applied innovation and user-designed, data driven applications and solutions. We are building the most trusted and efficient digital marketplace with data solutions for sourcing, selling and managing used vehicles with transparency and comprehensive insights that were once unimaginable. We are disruptors of the industry and we want you to join us on our journey.

At ACV we focus on the Health, Physical, Financial, Social and Emotional Wellness of our Teammates and, to support this, we offer:

  • Multiple medical plans including a high deductible, low cost health plan
  • Company-sponsored (paid) Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, and Life Insurance
  • Comprehensive optional benefits such as Dental, Vision, Supplemental Life/AD&D, Legal/ID Protection, and Accident and Critical Illness Insurance
  • Generous paid time off options, including uncapped vacation days, the greater of 3 paid sick days or in accordance with the applicable state or local paid sick leave law, 6 paid company holidays, 2 floating holidays, parental leave, bereavement leave, jury duty leave, voting leave, and other forms of paid leave as required by applicable law or regulation
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program with additional opportunities to earn stock in the Company
  • Retirement planning through the Company’s 401(k)

What you will do:

The Analytics Engineer III on the ACV Assurance team is a skilled practitioner who transforms raw data into trusted, decision-ready models and reports that drive the business forward. Sitting at the intersection of data engineering and business intelligence, this role contributes across the full analytics stack - from dbt model design and data quality to Omni BI dashboards - and partners with the Assurance Business to surface insights on arbitration risk and product initiatives. A key objective of this role is reducing ad-hoc analytical bottlenecks over time. You will be expected to answer urgent business questions quickly and directly, while systematically building the underlying dbt models, metric definitions, and BI layer in a way that enables self-serve analytics - including AI-assisted querying - so that business stakeholders can answer common questions themselves. Analytics Modeling & Data Quality

  • Design, build, and maintain dbt models (staging, intermediate, production layers) that serve as the single source of truth for Assurance KPIs, with machine-readability in mind
  • Enforce data quality through dbt tests, source freshness checks, and documentation so downstream consumers can trust what they see
  • Write complex SQL transformations on large datasets; optimize for cost and performance

Reporting & BI

  • Translate business questions into well-scoped analytical requirements; define metrics in collaboration with Assurance stakeholders and keep definitions governed in our semantic layer
  • Build upon our Omni BI semantic layer, enabling self-serve chat and dealer-facing embedded reporting
  • Balance responsiveness to ad-hoc requests while optimizing via building: triage what should be answered once vs. what should be codified so stakeholders or AI tools can self-serve it in the future
  • Deliver clear, compelling data narratives to non-technical stakeholders; support follow-on questions and iterate quickly

Assurance Business Domains

  • Risk: support the business in developing data, predictive, and forecasting models that identify high-risk dealer and vehicle populations to support program management strategy
  • Product: develop dealer-facing dashboards that illustrate their arbitration trends over time

Project Ownership & Stakeholder Partnership

  • Execute scoped projects with general guidance: define approach and timelines with input from a manager or senior team member, and drive day-to-day execution independently
  • Deliver data-driven recommendations
  • Navigate competing priorities across multiple stakeholder groups; propose win-win solutions when technical requirements conflict

What you will need:

Education

  • BA/BS in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Operations Research, or related
  • Master's or Ph.D. a plus, but offset by demonstrated experience and a deep toolbox

Experience

  • 3+ years of professional experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI
  • Hands-on production experience with dbt (model design, testing, documentation, incremental strategies)
  • Expert-level SQL; comfortable with window functions, complex joins, and query optimization in BigQuery or a comparable cloud warehouse
  • Experience delivering analytical initiatives independently, from scoping through stakeholder presentation

A DAY IN THE LIFE

As a Senior Electrical Engineer, you'll play a key role in delivering safe, reliable, and innovative engineering solutions across utility-scale renewable energy projects. Depending on your background and interests, you'll support projects during either the preconstruction/estimating phase or project execution phase, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to deliver high-quality engineering solutions from concept through construction.

A typical day may involve developing electrical designs, reviewing engineering packages, supporting utility interconnections, coordinating with Owners and Engineers of Record (EOR), evaluating constructability, and solving complex technical challenges across multiple concurrent projects. You'll work closely with Engineering, Estimating, Integrated Supply Chain, Construction, and Project Management to ensure designs are safe, economical, constructible, and aligned with client requirements.

Whether you're supporting Solar Project Engineering, Wind Estimating Engineering, or Battery Energy Storage Estimating Engineering, you'll contribute to projects that include underground collection systems, substations, transmission interconnections, protection and control systems, power quality studies, SCADA and communications, and utility-scale renewable energy infrastructure.

STEP INTO THE ROLE

  • Develop electrical engineering solutions supporting utility-scale renewable energy projects through either estimating or project execution.
  • Lead electrical design development, Basis of Design (BOD) documentation, engineering reviews, RFIs, and technical deliverables throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Review electrical one-line diagrams, protection and control systems, grounding plans, cable routing, equipment layouts, and third-party engineering packages to ensure quality and compliance.
  • Collaborate with Owners, Engineers of Record (EOR), Estimating, Project Engineering, Integrated Supply Chain, and Construction teams to deliver safe, reliable, and cost-effective designs.
  • Support utility interconnections, electrical equipment selection, procurement strategies, and technical submittal reviews.
  • Perform quantity takeoffs, constructability reviews, value engineering, and technical risk assessments that improve project execution and proposal competitiveness.
  • Mentor Engineer I, Engineer II, and CAD Designers through technical guidance, coaching, and engineering best practices.
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects while maintaining engineering quality, schedule commitments, and client expectations.
  • Support continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to strengthen engineering standards, workflows, and design quality.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering from an ABET-accredited college.
  • Engineer-in-Training (EIT) or Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) certification required, or ability to obtain within one year of hire.
  • Four or more years of progressive electrical engineering experience supporting utility-scale power generation, renewable energy, industrial, EPC, or heavy infrastructure projects.
  • Experience managing multiple engineering priorities while collaborating across multidisciplinary teams.

WHAT SETS YOU APART

  • Experience supporting utility-scale solar, wind, or battery energy storage (BESS) projects.
  • Strong knowledge of underground collection systems, substations, transmission interconnections, protection and control systems, SCADA, power quality, load flow analysis, and electrical equipment sizing.
  • Experience in either Estimating Engineering (preconstruction) or Project Engineering (project execution), or a combination of both.
  • Experience collaborating with Owners, Engineers of Record (EOR), utilities, EPC partners, and construction teams throughout the engineering lifecycle.

We’re looking for a Product Manager who is curious, customer-focused, and energized by turning real-world problems into meaningful product solutions.

In this role, you’ll own a product or key product area, working closely with customers, Engineering, UX, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and other stakeholders to identify opportunities, set priorities, and bring solutions to market.

    • Translate customer problems and business opportunities into clear product requirements and outcomes.

What we're looking for

    • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

    • Experience collaborating across Engineering, UX, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Support, or similar functions.

Preferred Qualifications

    • Experience with SaaS, cloud-based, enterprise software, payments, retail technology, data, or platform products.

    • Experience using product analytics to measure adoption and inform roadmap decisions.

    • Exposure to APIs, integrations, data platforms, or other technical product concepts.

    • Experience participating in product launches and go-to-market activities

    You’ll be successful in this role when you understand the customer problem behind the request, not just the requested feature. You’ll bring clarity to competing priorities, build strong partnerships across teams, use data and customer insight to make thoughtful decisions, and consistently move products from idea to measurable customer and business value.

  • Predictable income, every pay period: a fixed base salary plus a monthly performance incentive, not variable, per-session pay that swings with cancellations, no-shows, or slow weeks.
  • Protected non-billable time, built into your schedule: 10.5 hours per week of paid,protected time for documentation, supervision, case consultation, and lunch — all part of your paid day, not unpaid work you fit in around billable hours.
  • Manageable, capped caseloads: we cap caseload size to protect quality of care and your wellbeing, growth in your caseload is planned and supported, not something you're expected to sustain indefinitely to keep your income up.
  • Administrative burden handled for you: in-house billing, AI-assisted documentation support, and MA/LPN and Peer Recovery Specialist support mean your time goes to patients, not paperwork or chasing reimbursement.

  • Time Off: 29 days off a year to start (PTO, floating holidays, paid volunteer days), increasing on your anniversary — plus 4 Re-Fuel Days annually for mental health, rest, or CEU activities.
  • Continuing Education: annual CEU stipend and ongoing paid training.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP): free, confidential access to therapy, legal, financial, and wellness resources.
  • Protected Time: built into your day for recharging, clinical supervision, huddles, care planning, and admin work.

  • Utilize evidence-based therapeutic modalities, such as Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Motivational Interviewing (MI), and Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT), to support patient recovery.
  • Collaborate with all clinic-level team members to formulate and execute patient care plans, including Advanced Practice Providers, Medical Assistants, and Peer Recovery Specialists, ensuring integrated treatment approaches.
  • Support patients in crisis intervention situations and coordinate higher levels of care when necessary.

  • Pioneer innovative ways of improving access and overall care for disadvantaged, marginalized populations.
  • Champion the company’s mission by modeling compassion and fostering trust and strong relationships with patients and communities.
  • Educate patients and families on SUD, co-occurring disorders, and available resources to support sustained recovery and overall health.

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience providing therapy to individuals with substance use disorders.
  • Minimum of 1 year of experience providing therapy in an IOP, PHP, or comparable treatment setting.

  • Experience with telehealth platforms and virtual care delivery is a plus.
  • Strong knowledge of SUD diagnoses, medications, and treatment modalities.
  • Ability to effectively interact with diverse staff, patients, and community members.

  • Passionate about Steadfast Health’s mission to provide low-barrier, non-punitive, harm-reductionist SUD care.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to sit, stand, and walk for extended periods during patient sessions and team meetings.

  • Ability to quickly respond to emergencies, including assisting patients in distress or crisis situations.
  • Visual and auditory acuity to assess patient needs, read documentation, and communicate effectively.
  • Potential exposure to high-stress situations requiring emotional resilience and de-escalation skills.

Investors & Partners

Steadfast Health is proudly funded by Google Ventures (GV) and launched out of Triple Aim Partners. Strategic Regional Originator – Independent Commercial Partner

Organisation: The CFO HQ
Location: UK-wide, with particular interest in the Midlands, North of England and other strategically important regions
Working arrangement: Remote and regionally focused
Engagement type: Independent commercial partnership
Time commitment: Flexible, typically 5–50 hours per week
Indicative earning potential: £300,000+ per annum, depending on activity, successful introductions and commercial outcomes

About The CFO HQ

The CFO HQ is a specialist finance leadership, transformation, deals, talent and managed-services firm. We support organisations with access to experienced CFOs, finance directors, transformation professionals and specialist advisory capabilities.

Our ambition is to build a distinctive, internationally connected finance advisory platform—combining senior expertise, regional relationships and practical execution to help clients address their most important financial and strategic priorities.

As we expand our presence across the UK, we are appointing a select group of Strategic Regional Originators to help identify opportunities, build senior relationships and extend The CFO HQ's reach within key regional business communities.

The opportunity

This is an entrepreneurial, relationship-led opportunity for an established professional with strong regional networks and the credibility to engage business owners, CEOs, CFOs, investors, professional advisers and other senior decision-makers.

Strategic Regional Originators act as trusted commercial ambassadors for The CFO HQ. You will identify organisations that could benefit from our services, initiate high-quality conversations and connect prospective clients with the appropriate specialists within our team.

This is not a conventional salaried sales position. It is a flexible, independent commercial partnership suited to senior professionals who want to use their experience and networks to create valuable introductions while remaining engaged in other executive, advisory or portfolio activities.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain senior relationships across your regional business community.
  • Identify organisations facing finance leadership, growth, transformation, transaction, talent or compliance challenges.
  • Originate qualified opportunities for The CFO HQ's advisory, fractional CFO, finance transformation, deals, managed services and talent solutions.
  • Introduce prospective clients and strategic partners to the appropriate members of The CFO HQ team.
  • Represent The CFO HQ professionally at relevant business, investment and professional-networking events.
  • Build relationships with accountants, lawyers, banks, investors, private equity firms, corporate-finance advisers and other referral partners.
  • Provide informed regional market intelligence and identify emerging commercial opportunities.
  • Support introductory discussions, propositions and relationship development where appropriate.
  • Maintain accurate and timely records of introductions, opportunities and agreed next steps.
  • Operate in accordance with The CFO HQ's ethical, confidentiality, data-protection and professional standards.

About you

You are likely to be an experienced:

  • CFO, finance director or senior finance professional;
  • Partner, director or senior adviser within a professional-services firm;
  • Business development, corporate finance or commercial leader;
  • Banker, investor, intermediary or professional-networking specialist;
  • Portfolio executive, consultant, non-executive director or entrepreneur; or
  • Well-connected regional business leader with trusted senior relationships.

What we are looking for

  • A strong and credible network of senior business relationships within your region or specialist market.
  • The confidence to engage business owners, boards, C-suite executives and professional advisers.
  • A consultative, relationship-led approach to originating opportunities.
  • Strong commercial judgement and the ability to recognise genuine client needs.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and stakeholder-management skills.
  • High standards of integrity, discretion and professionalism.
  • The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a wider specialist team.
  • An established understanding of regional business dynamics and professional networks.
  • Relevant finance, advisory, investment, legal, banking or commercial experience is advantageous.

What The CFO HQ provides

  • Access to a broad portfolio of CFO, finance, transformation, deals, talent and managed-service capabilities.
  • Support from experienced finance leaders and specialist advisers.
  • A recognised platform through which to develop valuable regional and national relationships.
  • Professional marketing, proposition and business-development materials.
  • Flexible participation that can complement an existing portfolio career or advisory practice.
  • Commercial rewards linked to successful introductions and agreed outcomes.
  • The opportunity to contribute to the growth of a distinctive finance leadership and advisory business.

Important engagement information

This opportunity is offered on an independent, non-exclusive commercial-partnership basis. It does not create an employment relationship, guaranteed working hours or guaranteed income. Any remuneration arrangements, eligibility conditions and payment terms will be documented separately and agreed before appointment.

Applicants should disclose any existing contractual, regulatory, fiduciary or commercial commitments that could create an actual or perceived conflict of interest.

How to apply

Please complete our dedicated Strategic Originator application form:

Please include a summary of your professional background, regional or sector networks, current portfolio commitments and the contribution you believe you could make to The CFO HQ.

Applications submitted through the dedicated form will be reviewed confidentially by our leadership team.

Inclusion

The CFO HQ welcomes applications from experienced professionals of all backgrounds. Appointments are based on relevant experience, professional credibility, commercial alignment and the ability to contribute meaningfully to our clients and regional growth.

Role Summary

The Product Strategy Senior Advisor – Identity Strategy & Innovation provides strategic counsel and

product leadership for the enterprise Identity platform, helping shape its strategy, roadmap, and

innovation agenda across identity modernization, secure access, authentication, fraud prevention,

identity proofing, delegation, and emerging AI-aware identity capabilities.

Acting as a product-minded translator between business and technical teams, the advisor develops

product definitions, roadmap recommendations, and executive-ready narratives that accelerate

adoption and business value. The role works in close partnership with the enterprise Personalization

technology stack and Customer 360 data foundations, ensuring identity operates as a shared,

reusable layer that powers trusted, personalized digital experiences.

Key Responsibilities

Identity Product Strategy & Portfolio Counsel

  • Advise senior leadership on identity platform strategy and modernization priorities.
  • Develop and recommend the identity roadmap and capability prioritization across

authentication, access, registration, identity proofing, trusted devices, fraud posture, and

delegation.

  • Shape funding proposals, prioritization recommendations, and executive reporting that

inform enterprise investment decisions.

  • Evaluate platform gaps, technology trends, and emerging threats to help evolve the identity

investment portfolio.

Platform Modernization, Trusted Access & Ecosystem Partnership

  • Advance and advise on adoption of modern authentication and trusted access—passkeys,

adaptive MFA, alternate MFA, and streamlined account recovery.

  • Shape fraud prevention and identity proofing strategy, reducing reliance on passwords and

SMS OTP while improving login success and reducing support demand.

  • Partner with the Personalization technology stack, Customer 360/profile, analytics, and

enablement teams so identity signals are reusable and support personalized, governed

experiences.

  • Collaborate with architecture, engineering, security, and digital product teams to keep

solutions scalable, resilient, and aligned to enterprise standards; support ongoing federation

and SSO modernization and scalable access governance.AI-Aware Identity, Delegation & Innovation

  • Develop identity strategy recommendations for AI-agent access, agent identity, human-to-

agent delegation, credentialing, and human approval workflows.

  • Define requirements for digital delegation and caregiver use cases (proxy, authorized

representatives, minor age-out, family access) as reusable services.

  • Lead pilots, value-proposition development, and measurement of success for identity

capabilities supporting future-state care, pharmacy, and agentic engagement—surfacing

governance, consent, and policy decisions that require leadership alignment.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence

  • Lead highly visible, cross-functional identity initiatives spanning business, technology,

security, architecture, and digital product teams.

  • Influence stakeholders at all levels to drive alignment, prioritization, and adoption.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor and identity subject matter expert to business stakeholders,

platform consumers, architecture partners, and senior leadership.

  • Translate complex business, security, and technical needs into clear product strategies,

roadmap recommendations, and executive narratives.

Scope & Impact

  • Provides enterprise-level strategic counsel across identity, secure access, authentication,

fraud prevention, proofing, delegation, and AI-agent trust.

  • Informs enterprise investment and governance decisions and adoption approaches through

recommendations, partnering across the personalization and customer-data ecosystem.

  • Contributes to measurable outcomes: improved login success, reduced support demand,

lower authentication operating cost, reduced fraud risk, faster onboarding, and broader

adoption of reusable identity services.

  • Recognized internally as a go-to expert for the most complex identity, digital trust, and

identity-enabled AI initiatives.

Required Experience

  • 7+ years in Product Strategy/Management, Identity & Access Management, digital platforms,

security technology, or related fields.

  • Track record developing enterprise product strategies, roadmaps, investment narratives, and

executive recommendations.

  • Hands-on familiarity with identity capabilities (registration, login, MFA, passkeys, account

recovery, proofing, fraud controls, federation, SSO, delegated access).

  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence senior stakeholders in a highly

matrixed organization without direct authority, translating business, security, and technical

needs into measurable outcomes.Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare, pharmacy, benefits, or regulated ecosystems where identity,

consent, privacy, and access governance are critical.

  • Familiarity with modern federation, OAuth/OIDC, SAML, token security, identity orchestration,

adaptive authentication, or passwordless/passkey capabilities.

  • Exposure to AI-agent governance, delegated authority, and lifecycle/traceability concepts,

and to caregiver/proxy/authorized-representative access models.

  • Experience partnering with personalization, customer-data, or content platforms to deliver

reusable, shared-service capabilities.

About Kinaxis

As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. Location

This is a remote position. You can work from home and be located anywhere in the US

About the team

The Application Solution Architect is a senior role within Kinaxis’s Professional Services, Innovation and Data Science Services team. You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across Product, R&D, Data Services, and Professional Services to deliver end-to-end customer projects for Enterprise Scheduling and other advanced planning capabilities.

In this role, you will help customers solve complex supply chain challenges by designing scalable, high-quality solution architectures. This role requires deep supply chain domain expertise, including a strong understanding of how supply planning and detailed scheduling interact across the broader supply chain landscape. The architect must ensure these processes are designed cohesively so planning logic, material feasibility, capacity assumptions, and shop-floor scheduling work together seamlessly to support feasible and efficient operational execution.

What you will do

  • Define and own the ES solution architecture—including functional design, data structures, constraint models, integrations, and system behavior—working in close partnership with the Solution Architect, where present, to ensure alignment with the overall end‑to‑end solution architecture. In ES‑only implementations, serve as the primary solution architect for the engagement.
  • Facilitate detailed scheduling blueprint sessions that translate manufacturing requirements into scalable configurations, defining heuristics, dispatch rules, look-ahead behavior, changeover logic, and constraint-resolution strategies for complex production environments.
  • Identify risks throughout the project lifecycle and develop mitigation strategies to ensure successful deployments.
  • Troubleshoot complex scheduling behavior and resolve data configuration issues, providing root-cause analysis and recommending appropriate configuration patterns.
  • Provide functional leadership and help to solve complex supply chain challenges and implementation support
  • Provide mentorship and technical oversight to consultants and partners on solution quality, scheduling implementation methods, repeatable architecture patterns, and deployment best practices, while overseeing delegation of configuration tasks.
  • Collaborate with Product teams on feature gaps, capability extensions, and areas requiring architectural guidance while influencing roadmap discussions through customer insights and solution best practices.
  • Support services sales opportunities by articulating solution approaches and value to stakeholders.

What we are looking for

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in industrial engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Research, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Statistics, Information Technology or related field.
  • Minimum 8 years of broad experience in software implementation consulting in the supply chain planning or supply chain execution space, including 3+ years as a solution architect or lead functional consultant for enterprise-scale supply chain transformation projects.
  • Excellent facilitation and communication skills; able to guide customer discussions across planners, schedulers, project teams, and stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to work in fast-paced, matrixed environments with strong initiative and leadership capabilities.
  • Advanced problem-solving and critical thinking skills with the ability to synthesize complex information and guide teams toward deploying high-quality solutions that align with the intended architectural design.
  • Proven interpersonal, leadership, and mentoring skills within cross-functional teams.

Role Specific Skills and experience

  • Subject matter expert in supply chain concepts and best practices coupled with in-depth experience with supply chain solutions and scheduling applications (such as OMP, SAP PPDS, Blue Yonder, or o9 Production Scheduling).
  • Experience producing detailed blueprints that translate scheduling requirements into technical specifications during software implementations.
  • Technical leadership experience in data integration, data management, system configuration and system deployment for supply chain software implementations.
  • Proficiency with SQL, JavaScript, or scripting languages used in solution configuration.
  • Willing and able to travel between 50% to 75% annually

Work With Impact: Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.
