jobs.title: Staff Enterprise Platform Engineer, ServiceNow
jobs.excerpt: Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.
jobs.description:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.


At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.


Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.


Staff Enterprise Platform Engineer, ServiceNow

Brazil

Role Overview:
Shape the technical direction of ServiceNow at enterprise scale, building a secure, resilient platform that improves how global teams deliver services, resolve issues, automate work, and support customers and employees. As a Staff ServiceNow Engineer, you will own complex platform engineering decisions and turn ServiceNow architecture and strategy into scalable solutions across ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, CSM, CMDB, workflow automation, integrations, and AI-enabled capabilities.

Operate as a hands-on technical authority across strategic initiatives, partnering with ServiceNow Architects, Engineering Managers, Product Owners, security teams, and business stakeholders. You will influence platform strategy, establish engineering standards, guide design trade-offs, and drive alignment across multiple engineering teams while remaining close to implementation and the most complex technical challenges.

Advance the practical adoption of Now Assist, AI Agents, generative AI, intelligent automation, and other emerging ServiceNow capabilities. Your work will focus on tangible outcomes, including faster incident resolution, more effective knowledge experiences, improved engineering productivity, stronger service operations, and scalable employee and customer workflows, with appropriate security, privacy, governance, and responsible AI controls.

This role provides visibility across enterprise initiatives and senior stakeholders while creating opportunities to expand your influence across platform architecture, AI-enabled automation, engineering practices, and technical leadership. At Genesys, collaboration, empathy for the people who use our technology, and ambitious thinking guide how we build solutions that help organizations create better customer and employee experiences.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the end-to-end technical design and engineering of complex ServiceNow solutions across ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, CSM, CMDB, Workflow and Flow Designer, and related platform capabilities, ensuring solutions scale securely across the enterprise
  • Lead technical delivery across strategic, multi-stream ServiceNow initiatives, driving alignment among engineers, administrators, automation engineers, QA teams, architects, Product Owners, and other contributors
  • Influence platform strategy by providing authoritative guidance on engineering decisions, architectural trade-offs, technical risks, implementation approaches, and long-term maintainability
  • Partner with ServiceNow Architects to translate reference architectures, platform principles, and enterprise standards into executable engineering solutions and reusable implementation patterns
  • Establish engineering standards, coding guidelines, integration patterns, reusable components, automation practices, and development guardrails that improve consistency, quality, and delivery efficiency across teams
  • Lead technical design reviews, code reviews, and engineering quality assessments that strengthen platform security, scalability, reliability, supportability, and performance
  • Design and govern complex enterprise integrations using ServiceNow Integration Hub, REST APIs, web services, MID Servers, event-driven patterns, and enterprise integration technologies
  • Drive the adoption of Now Assist, AI Agents, generative AI, and intelligent automation to improve service operations, incident resolution, knowledge management, engineering productivity, and employee and customer experiences
  • Partner with architecture, security, governance, compliance, and business teams to implement AI-enabled solutions with appropriate data quality, privacy, access controls, testing, monitoring, and responsible AI practices
  • Evaluate ServiceNow platform releases, AI capabilities, and emerging technologies, recommending adoption strategies based on business value, technical dependencies, platform readiness, security, and scalability
  • Drive platform performance and reliability through proactive optimization, technical debt reduction, resilient engineering patterns, and disciplined platform governance
  • Lead technical response for critical incidents and production escalations, accelerating root cause analysis and durable resolution of complex platform issues
  • Mentor Senior Engineers and Engineers through technical coaching, design guidance, and code reviews, raising engineering maturity and expanding technical leadership capability across the organization
  • Advance ServiceNow SDLC and DevOps practices using GitHub, source control, CI/CD, Automated Test Framework (ATF), automated quality controls, and disciplined release management
  • Communicate complex technical decisions, risks, dependencies, and recommendations clearly to engineering teams, business stakeholders, and senior leaders to enable informed decision making

Required Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of hands-on ServiceNow engineering experience, including deep technical implementation experience across multiple modules and enterprise-scale environments
  • Proven experience serving as a senior technical authority for complex ServiceNow implementations, with accountability for technical design, engineering decisions, code quality, and delivery guidance
  • Demonstrated success leading large, complex, multi-stream ServiceNow initiatives involving multiple engineering teams and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Expert-level knowledge of ServiceNow architecture, data models, CMDB, ACLs and security models, scripting, integrations, automation, and platform performance
  • Advanced ServiceNow development expertise with JavaScript, Script Includes, Business Rules, Flow Designer, Integration Hub, APIs, and related platform development capabilities
  • Strong background designing enterprise integrations using REST APIs, Integration Hub, MID Servers, web services, and enterprise integration patterns
  • Hands-on experience or strong working knowledge of ServiceNow Now Assist, AI Agents, generative AI, or related ServiceNow AI capabilities
  • Strong understanding of AI implementation considerations, including data quality, security, access controls, governance, testing, monitoring, and responsible AI practices
  • Deep knowledge of ITIL processes and their implementation and optimization within ServiceNow
  • Strong experience with ServiceNow SDLC and DevOps practices, including GitHub or source control, automated testing, ATF, CI/CD pipelines, and release management
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, conduct technical and code reviews, establish engineering standards, and influence technical decisions across teams
  • Exceptional analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capability, including experience resolving ambiguous and highly complex technical challenges
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence engineering teams, cross-functional partners, and senior business stakeholders
  • Fluent English communication skills for daily collaboration with global engineering teams and senior stakeholders
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) and ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) credentials
  • ServiceNow integration-focused certification or equivalent demonstrated expertise, plus one or more relevant ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist certifications

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience providing technical leadership across large-scale, global ServiceNow environments and multiple concurrent engineering workstreams
  • Production experience implementing Now Assist, AI Agents, generative AI, intelligent automation, or other AI-driven ServiceNow capabilities
  • Experience defining enterprise engineering standards and implementation patterns for AI, automation, integrations, and ServiceNow platform development
  • Strong background with advanced automation, AIOps, observability, Predictive Intelligence, analytics, or related capabilities integrated with ServiceNow
  • Experience with ServiceNow CMDB, Common Service Data Model (CSDM), Discovery, Service Mapping, and enterprise data governance
  • Experience implementing GitHub-based development models, CI/CD pipelines, ATF, automated quality gates, and enterprise release management
  • Experience operating as a Technical Lead in scaled Agile environments and partnering with Product Owners, Architects, Scrum Masters, QA Engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders
  • ServiceNow AI or Now Assist accreditation or certification, where applicable
  • ITIL v3 or ITIL 4 Foundation certification

Working at Genesys

  • AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year.
  • A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work.
  • Growth in the AI era – Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support.
  • Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families.
  • Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work®certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys.

Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report.


What Happens After You Apply

After you apply, here's what you can typically expect:

  • Our Talent Acquisition team reviews your application with the hiring team.
  • A Talent Acquisition Partner will review your application and, if your background is aligned, schedule a Zoom interview.

  • After interviews are complete, our team will follow up with the final steps.

Every application is reviewed by a person. Response times may vary by role and location, but our team will keep you informed throughout the process.


Stay Connected

Stay connected to learn more about how we're applying AI to customer and employee experience challenges and get notified when relevant opportunities become available.

Get notified about relevant opportunities.


Be the one building what's next - where AI, experience and impact come together.


Employee Referral

If a Genesys employee referred you, please apply using the link they shared so we can connect your application to their referral.

Genesys® empowers more than 8,000 organizations worldwide to create the best customer and employee experiences. With agentic AI at its core, Genesys Cloud™ is the AI-Powered Experience Orchestration platform that connects people, systems, data and AI across the enterprise. As a result, organizations can drive customer loyalty, growth and retention while increasing operational efficiency and teamwork across human and AI workforces. To learn more, visit .

jobs.description:
As a Windows System Administrator, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the reliability, security, and optimal performance of our IT infrastructure. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, implement, and maintain systems, applications, and services across both virtual and physical environments. Your expertise in Windows-based technologies will be crucial in managing our internal systems, including SCOM, Active Directory and Office365, to support the daily operations of the organization.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Assist in the design, implementation, configuration, and ongoing maintenance of systems, applications, and services in virtual and physical environments.
  • Manage and maintain critical internal and hosting infrastructure
  • Active Directory and Group Policy management
  • Conduct capacity planning and management for hosting, office, and networking infrastructure to ensure optimal performance.
  • Adhere to security best practices at all times and ensure that security measures are operational and effective.
  • Monitor system logs, analyze performance data, and troubleshoot and resolve system-related issues.
  • Provide training and third-level support to support departments, assisting them in resolving complex technical issues.
  • Participate in incident response and problem management to minimize downtime and maintain system availability.
  • Apply operating system updates, patches, and configuration changes to enhance system security and performance.
  • Introduce and integrate new technologies into the existing environment to improve efficiency and functionality.
  • Document all changes made to the environment and adhere to change control processes to maintain a clear record of system modifications.
  • Perform system performance tuning and provide recommendations to enhance overall system efficiency.
  • Make security recommendations and implement best practices for hardening systems to safeguard company data.
  • Backup Management: Ensure that backups are up to date and recoverable
  • Designing and implementing systems and tools
  • Troubleshooting issues with a company's systems and networks
  • Automating tasks for production environments
  • Installing new hardware and software
  • Performing system upgrades
  • Managing backup and recovery
  • Monitoring and capacity planning for servers
  • Conducting version management
  • Developing system security standards
  • Assessing resources to meet organizational needs

Qualifications and Experience:

  • 5+ years' experience as a Windows Systems Administrator or similar position
  • M365 Administration
  • Microsoft Systems Centre Suite (VMM, ORCH, SCOM)
  • Scripting and automation (PowerShell)
  • Windows Server 2012 through 2022 with a solid understanding of Windows security fundamentals.
  • Active Directory architecture and replication in a multi domain environment
  • Strong understanding of IIS, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy.
  • Database configurations and administration of MSSQL & MySQL
  • Experience administrating Hyper-V Virtual infrastructure

jobs.title: Manager, Risk Management - AI Transformation
jobs.excerpt: Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure.
jobs.description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at .

What you’ll be part of:

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What you’ll be responsible for:

As Manager, GRM AI Transformation, you will help lead the reinvention of how Circle’s Global Risk Management (GRM) organization operates — moving it from today’s manually intensive processes to an AI-native operating model in which intelligent agents run core workflows end to end, and people focus on judgment, oversight, and the highest-stakes decisions. Reporting to the leader of GRM’s AI transformation, you will partner with process owners across compliance, financial crime, security, financial risk, and enterprise risk to define an ambitious vision for every process, challenge long-held assumptions about how the work must be done, and translate that vision into a portfolio of AI applications and reusable capabilities that scale across the organization. This role sits at the intersection of business process transformation, risk management, and applied AI: you will drive change management and the mindset shifts it requires, stand up the shared building blocks and guardrails that make AI safe and responsible, and coordinate closely with Circle’s central AI team and AI leaders across the company to advance an enterprise-wide transformation. Success means a GRM that decouples business growth from headcount, moves at machine speed, and preserves the risk-management discipline and controls that Circle’s customers, regulators, and markets rely on.

What you’ll work on:

  • Lead workshops and working sessions with GRM process owners to reimagine their processes from first principles and define an ambitious AI-native “future state” vision for each one.

  • Challenge long-held assumptions and drive the mindset shift from “today’s processes with AI added on” to processes designed natively around intelligent agents — bringing rigorous business-process-optimization and transformation discipline to the effort.

  • Help build GRM into an AI-native organization whose core processes are led by agents, with people focused on judgment, exceptions, and oversight.

  • Champion consistent execution of Circle's AI Risk Management framework across all GRM AI developments — ensuring every AI-native process is risk-assessed, appropriately controlled, and shipped with the guardrails and human-in-the-loop oversight needed to keep AI safe, responsible, explainable, and auditable.

  • Help shape GRM’s AI-native vision and target architecture, including a foundation of reusable “primitives” — modular capabilities that provide common functionality once and are leveraged by many different business processes rather than rebuilt for each.

  • Champion a “build once, reuse everywhere” model, prioritizing and sequencing these foundational building blocks so they unlock and accelerate the broader portfolio of process-level AI initiatives.

  • Drive the development of the AI applications most pivotal to GRM’s transformation — from scoping and requirements through build, testing, launch, adoption, and measurable impact.

  • Translate risk and compliance domain needs into clear solution designs, success criteria, and outcomes, partnering closely with process owners, builders, and engineering to keep initiatives moving.

  • Partner with Circle’s central AI team and with AI leaders across other (non-GRM) organizations to align on shared platforms, standards, and best practices and to advance enterprise-wide AI transformation.

  • Coordinate and enable GRM’s community of AI drivers and hands-on builders, and represent GRM’s priorities in enterprise AI forums — feeding GRM use cases into shared infrastructure and bringing enterprise capabilities back into GRM.

  • Own and continuously improve GRM-level reporting on the AI transformation — maintaining a clear view of initiatives in flight, progress against roadmap, measurable impact, blockers, and dependencies.

  • Prepare updates and materials for GRM leadership, executive reviews, and risk committees, and keep GRM’s roadmap aligned with the central AI team’s programs and cadence.

What you’ll bring to Circle:

Core Requirements:

  • 7+ years of experience in business process transformation, operational excellence, management consulting, product/program management, or a related discipline, including leading process redesign or automation initiatives that changed how work gets done.

  • A demonstrated ability to reimagine and optimize complex business processes — mapping current state, designing a bold future state, and driving the organizational change and mindset shifts required to get there.

  • Strong working fluency with modern AI, including generative AI and agentic / AI-native concepts, and a track record of applying it to real business problems. You do not need to be an ML engineer, but you must be able to think in terms of what AI can do and design processes around it.

  • Experience driving cross-functional initiatives end to end — from vision and scoping through delivery, adoption, and measurable outcomes.

  • Excellent facilitation and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to lead workshops, constructively challenge senior process owners, and build alignment across diverse teams.

  • Exposure to risk management, compliance, financial crime, security, or another regulated, control-oriented domain — or the ability to quickly build credibility with risk and compliance stakeholders.

  • Strong program and portfolio management skills, including tracking multiple concurrent initiatives, reporting to leadership, and managing dependencies, roadblocks, and roadmaps.

  • A builder’s mindset and comfort operating in ambiguity, with high autonomy and a bias for action.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to distill complex, technical, and cross-functional work into clear narratives for executives and committees.

  • A strong sense of responsibility for doing things the right way — building AI solutions with appropriate governance, controls, and guardrails from day one.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Experience in financial services, fintech, crypto / digital assets, or another regulated environment.

  • Hands-on experience building or configuring AI solutions (e.g., agents, LLM workflows, automations) using modern low-code / no-code or AI development tools.

  • Experience partnering with central or shared AI, data, or platform teams and contributing to reusable, enterprise-scale capabilities.

  • Familiarity with AI governance and responsible-AI frameworks (risk-based oversight, human-in-the-loop, explainability, auditability).

  • Background in management consulting, transformation, or operational excellence (e.g., Lean / Six Sigma), at a top firm or on an in-house transformation team.

  • Certification or formal training in project / program management, change management, or process improvement.

The Senior Business Solutions Lead will enable the platform strategy across the Americas technology ecosystem supporting Sales, Marketing, Service, and broader Customer Experience capabilities. This individual will bring a consultative mindset, strong business partnership, and the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders in support of regional and global platform priorities. This role will help create clearer direction across customer experience platforms, improve prioritization and execution discipline, evaluate the use of embedded and external AI capabilities, and support front-office planning related to acquisitions and evolving business needs.

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:

À propos d’Abbott

Abbott est un chef de file mondial des soins de santé, créant des avancées scientifiques majeures pour améliorer la santé de tous. Nous sommes en permanence tournés vers l’avenir et anticipons les évolutions de la science et des technologies médicales.

Être à l’emploi d’Abbott

En étant à l’emploi d’Abbott, vous pourrez faire un travail qui compte, vous perfectionner et apprendre, prendre soin de vous et des membres de votre famille, rester fidèle à ce que vous êtes et vivre pleinement. Vous pourrez :

  • profiter de possibilités d’avancement professionnel au sein d’une entreprise internationale qui vous permettra de bâtir la carrière dont vous rêvez;

  • travailler pour une entreprise reconnue dans des douzaines de pays partout dans le monde comme étant un excellent milieu de travail et figurant parmi les entreprises les plus admirées dans le monde dans le classement Fortune;

  • travailler pour une grande entreprise reconnue comme étant l’une des meilleures où travailler, notamment pour ce qui a trait à la diversité du personnel, à la conciliation travail-famille ainsi qu’à la place des femmes dans les postes de cadres et les postes scientifiques.

L’occasion à saisir

Ce poste est basé au Québec au sein de la division Diagnostic au point de service (Point of Care). Chez Abbott, nous contribuons à améliorer la prise de décisions cliniques et économiques afin de transformer les soins de santé à chaque étape de la vie. Notre gamme de solutions diagnostiques au point de service couvre plusieurs secteurs clés des soins de santé, notamment la chimie clinique, les électrolytes, l'hématologie, les gaz sanguins, la coagulation, l'endocrinologie, les marqueurs cardiaques, la neurologie ainsi que les solutions informatiques destinées aux laboratoires et aux établissements de santé.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Agir à titre de représentant(e) principal(e) des ventes en assurant le maintien et la croissance des ventes du portefeuille de produits auprès de la clientèle existante, tout en développant de nouvelles occasions d'affaires dans le territoire et les marchés assignés.

  • Collaborer avec les clients et les équipes internes afin d'optimiser les processus cliniques et opérationnels dans le but d'améliorer les soins aux patients grâce aux solutions de l'entreprise.

  • Respecter les politiques et procédures de l'entreprise et de la division.

  • Atteindre les objectifs de vente grâce à une gestion efficace du cycle de vente, du territoire et des comptes clients.

  • Maintenir le volume d'affaires existant tout en développant de nouvelles relations commerciales auprès de clients actuels et potentiels.

  • Effectuer avec exactitude et dans les délais requis toutes les tâches administratives, notamment les formations obligatoires, les rapports de dépenses, les prévisions de ventes et les plans d'affaires.

  • Développer et entretenir des relations solides avec les principaux décideurs au sein des comptes stratégiques.

  • Élaborer et déployer des stratégies de vente efficaces en utilisant les ressources disponibles et en collaborant au sein d'équipes multidisciplinaires.

  • Effectuer des déplacements pouvant représenter jusqu'à 50 % du temps, au Canada et occasionnellement à l'international, afin de soutenir les objectifs d'affaires.

  • Comprendre et respecter les politiques, procédures et exigences en matière de santé, sécurité et environnement (SSE).

Compétences requises

  • Baccalauréat dans un domaine pertinent.

  • De six à dix années d'expérience pertinente.

  • Capacité démontrée à gérer plusieurs produits et cycles de vente simultanément.

  • Excellentes habiletés de communication, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit.

  • Aptitude à développer et maintenir des relations professionnelles solides.

  • Capacité d'influencer et de mobiliser des intervenants sans autorité hiérarchique directe.

  • Autonomie, initiative et excellente capacité à travailler en équipe.

  • Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes, en analyse et en pensée critique.

  • Excellentes aptitudes en planification, organisation et gestion des priorités.

  • Capacité à évaluer différentes options et à recommander des solutions adaptées, incluant des plans de contingence au besoin.

  • Aisance à faire des présentations devant divers auditoires, y compris auprès de la haute direction.

  • Bonne maîtrise de la suite Microsoft Office et des plateformes de gestion de la relation client (CRM).

  • Disponibilité pour des déplacements représentant environ 50 % du temps.

  • Territoire : certaines régions du Québec ainsi que la côte Est du Canada.

Rémunération

Le salaire annuel de base pour ce poste se situe entre 99 750.00 $ et $146,300.00​ $ CA. Cette échelle salariale s'applique uniquement aux postes situés au Canada.

Suivez vos aspirations professionnelles chez Abbott pour diverses opportunités dans une entreprise qui peut vous aider à construire votre avenir et à vivre votre meilleure vie. Abbott est un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances et engagé en faveur de la diversité des employés.

Visitez notre site www.abbott.com ou suivez-nous sur Facebook, à www.facebook.com/Abbott, et Twitter @AbbottNews et @AbbottGlobal.

About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You will have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.

  • A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.

  • A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity

This position will be in Quebec in the Point of Care, Diagnostics division. We’re empowering smarter medical and economic decision making to help transform the way people manage their health at all stages of life. Our Point of Care diagnostic portfolio spans key health and therapeutic areas, including Chemistry, Electrolytes, Hematology, Blood Gases, Coagulation, Endocrinology, Cardiac Markers, Neurology, and Informatics. As the Regional Sales Executive, you will have the chance to maintain and expand sales of the company’s portfolio of products in existing accounts and developing new business within an assigned region and market segment. You will also engage with key personnel to restructure customer processes to better facilitate patient care using the company’s products.

What You’ll Do

  • Responsible for compliance with applicable Corporate and Divisional policies and procedures. Achieve sales targets through efficient and effective sales cycle, region and market segment management; maintain sales base while also closing new business in both new and existing accounts.

  • Ensure all administrative tasks (i.e. training modules, expense reports, sales forecasts, business plans, etc.) are completed promptly and accurately.

  • Build relationships with key stakeholders within accounts.

  • Develop and execute sales strategies; utilize available resources effectively; lead and or participate in cross-functional teams.

  • Travel up to 50% of the time both domestically and internationally to support business goals.

  • Understand and comply with all applicable EH&S policies, procedures and guidelines.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required.

  • Six to ten years of relevant experience.

  • Ability to maintain consistent momentum with multiple products and across multiple sales cycles.

  • Ability to clearly, concisely and accurately convey communications.

  • Ability to work independently and as a team member.

  • Demonstrated initiative and problem-solving skills; analytical and critical-thinking skills.

  • Ability to prioritize and strong organizational skills.

  • Ability to provide solutions and contingency plans through the comprehensive review of alternatives.

  • Ability to speak confidently in public and present material to Executive-level management.

  • Knowledge of MS-Office Software and CRM Databases.

  • Travel is approximately 50%.

  • Territory, part of Quebec and East Coast.

  • The incumbent must be able to communicate well in English (50% of the time), as his or her duties require interaction with stakeholders and colleagues outside Quebec and Canada.

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $99,750.00 to $146,300.00 CAD. The salary range provided applies to Canada only and does not apply to any other locations outside of Canada.

jobs.excerpt: Scope of PositionAbout Us:At EDF power solutions North America, the Distribution-Scale Power team is a leading provider of customized PV, BESS, and Substations in the United States, with a proven track record of developing over 1,600 MW of renewable energy capacity.
jobs.description:
Scope of Position

About Us:

At EDF power solutions North America, the Distribution-Scale Power team is a leading provider of customized PV, BESS, and Substations in the United States, with a proven track record of developing over 1,600 MW of renewable energy capacity. We specialize in delivering efficient and cost-effective development, engineering, construction, and operations tailored for utilities, cooperatives, landowners, communities, and institutions, anywhere from 2-200MW+. With more than 20 years of industry experience, our collaborative team provides value at every phase of the project lifecycle, utilizing expertise in permitting, development, EPC, financing, QA/QC, and SCADA systems to offer comprehensive turnkey solutions.

Joining the DSP team means working on impactful projects in a fast-paced and efficient environment while contributing to the advancement of renewable energy in a diverse setting.

Be a part of an innovative and collaborative team environment that fosters our goal of delivering renewable solutions to lead the transition to a sustainable energy future.

Benefits & Perks:

EDF power solutions offers best-in-class employee benefits, including the following:

  • Competitive bonus incentives. This position is eligible for our annual bonus program.
  • Comprehensive health coverage. We provide low-cost health & wellness coverage for employees and their eligible dependents.
  • Rewarding 401k. We provide a generous matching contribution.

We are also proud to offer:

  • Favorable paid time off programs, including paid parental leave after one year of service.
  • Rewarding learning & career development and advancement opportunities.
  • Supportive mentorship & buddy programs.

Salary Range: The full pay range for this role is $107,200 to $178,600 annually, and the good faith estimated starting pay for this position upon hire is $128,00 to $150,00 annually. We generally base our salary decisions on factors including but not limited to, relevant work and leadership experience, education, demonstrated performance, internal equity, and in some cases, geographic location.

Scope of Job:

We are seeking an experienced, highly self-directed Senior Solar Design Engineer with a strong technical background in solar PV and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) who can take ownership of engineering deliverables and operate effectively with a high degree of autonomy.

This position requires a high level of working knowledge of the National Electrical Code (NEC), renewable energy electrical design, and industry design best practices. The successful candidate should be able to independently evaluate engineering problems, make sound technical decisions, identify design and constructability issues, and drive projects forward without requiring extensive day-to-day direction.

Our company operates in a fast-moving, deadline-driven environment with high expectations for technical quality, accuracy, responsiveness, and accountability. Project schedules can be aggressive and priorities may change quickly. The successful candidate must be comfortable managing multiple projects and competing priorities while maintaining the quality and attention to detail expected of professional engineering work.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare engineering deliverables, including plan and elevation drawings, schematics, calculations, POs, and schedules in support of PV (photovoltaic) energy generation system design, for commercial and utility projects in the 500 kW to 20 MW scale. Review and revise engineering deliverables prepared by others. Develop designs in consideration of company safety program and OSHA safety requirements for construction and system operation.
  • Conduct site assessments, prepare energy models and conceptual design deliverables in support of business development and new product/vendor integration.
  • Communications with Project Managers, who coordinate scheduling and permitting for project execution.
  • Create, organize, and maintain documents associated with projects’ basis of design throughout the project life cycle; assist the business development team in identifying key project design risks and enabling effective decisions.
  • Implement strategies for integration of new tools, new products, new vendors, code changes, and best practices, and disseminate to internal departments as needed.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Working Conditions: Most work time will be spent in an office environment, but occasional site visits may be performed. Significant time spent on the phone and working on computer.

Qualifications

Education/Experience

  • Bachelor of Science degree in mechanical or electrical engineering required.
  • Minimum of ten years’ relevant design experience, particularly including experience in designing mechanical or electrical systems or electrical systems for construction; commercial PV design preferred.
  • Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) certificate.
  • Registered Professional Engineer (PRE) preferred
  • NABCEP certified
  • Experience with industry standard PV systems and energy modeling tools.
  • Application and interpretation of the NEC, applicable to PV, energy storage, interconnected power production sources, grounding and bonding, overcurrent protection, conductor sizing, and electrical equipment preferred.
  • Experience with:
  • Solar PV and BESS electrical system design, including DC and AC collection systems, inverter and PCS selection, transformers, switchgear, switchboards, and associated balance-of-system equipment.
  • Medium-voltage electrical systems, including MV collection systems, feeder design, conductor and cable sizing, voltage drop, equipment selection, and system configuration.
  • Development and review of single-line diagrams, electrical plans, equipment layouts, wiring and interconnection details, specifications, calculations, and construction/IFC drawing packages.
  • Equipment ratings, available fault current, protection requirements, grounding, and coordination with system studies.
  • Utility interconnection requirements and coordination with utilities, AHJs, equipment manufacturers, and other project stakeholders.
  • Designing systems with consideration for constructability, equipment availability, cost, schedule, commissioning, and long-term operation and maintenance, rather than approaching engineering solely as a code-compliance exercise.
  • Substation engineering experience is highly desirable, particularly experience with renewable-energy collector substations, MV/HV equipment, transformers, breakers, protection and control systems, grounding, relaying, and utility interconnection facilities.

Skills/Knowledge/Abilities –

Requires knowledge of:

  • National Electric Code and other model codes
  • Project management experience
  • Computer-based drafting experience (AutoCAD)

This position is particularly well suited for an engineer who:

  • Takes ownership of their projects and engineering deliverables.
  • Can independently manage their workload, priorities, and deadlines.
  • Has strong knowledge of the NEC and understands how to apply it to real-world solar and BESS installations.
  • Has strong electrical engineering fundamentals and exercises sound engineering judgment.
  • Is comfortable working with medium-voltage systems and complex renewable-energy electrical infrastructure.
  • Has substation experience or is capable of effectively coordinating with substation and utility engineers.
  • Can identify technical, constructability, and coordination issues before they become field problems.
  • Understands that a successful design must work not only on paper, but also during procurement, construction, commissioning, and operation.
  • Communicates proactively and does not wait for others to identify problems or determine the next step.
  • Can communicate technical concepts to non-technical people effectively.
  • Can manage multiple simultaneous projects in an environment with tight deadlines and high expectations for performance.
  • Works effectively with engineers as well as project managers, construction personnel, vendors, utilities, and other stakeholders.
  • Is comfortable being accountable for the quality and completeness of their engineering work.
  • Combination of technical knowledge with practical engineering judgment, ownership, and execution.

Physical Requirements:

Ability to lift up to 50 lbs. on occasion.

Working Conditions: Most work time will be spent in an office environment, but occasional site visits may be performed. Significant time spent on the phone and working on computer.

jobs.title: Director, Revenue Operations (India)
jobs.excerpt: About FlosumFlosum is the only end-to-end platform purpose-built for Salesforce — trusted by Fortune 1000 enterprises, federal agencies, and high-growth organizations around the world.
jobs.description:
About Flosum

Flosum is the only end-to-end platform purpose-built for Salesforce — trusted by Fortune 1000 enterprises, federal agencies, and high-growth organizations around the world. Our five integrated products — DevOps, Security Orchestration, CodeScan, Backup & Archive, and Data Migrator — give enterprises the confidence to accelerate delivery, simplify compliance, and scale Salesforce with precision.

Founded in Silicon Valley and proudly self-funded, Flosum operates on a single guiding principle: your success is our success. We’re not optimizing for investor optics. We move fast, build with conviction, and put our customers at the center of every decision. The result is a 4.97-star rating on the Salesforce AppExchange and a customer roster that includes Cargill, Hilton, Cushman & Wakefield, and some of the largest federal agencies in the country. We serve enterprise IT leaders, Salesforce architects, DevOps teams, compliance officers, and government agencies — anyone whose organization depends on Salesforce operating securely, efficiently, and at scale.

The Opportunity

Flosum is at an inflection point. We have multiple product lines gaining traction across enterprise and mid-market segments, four active go-to-market motions — outbound sales, inbound/marketing-led, channel/partners, and product-led growth — and a lean, high-performing team that moves with urgency. What we need now is the operating infrastructure to match our

ambition. We’re hiring a Director of Revenue Operations to be the architect of our revenue engine: the person who transforms disconnected GTM motions into a single, data-driven, capital-efficient machine. This is a builder role — not a maintainer role. You will design systems that don’t yet exist, enforce standards that currently aren’t enforced, and build the reporting infrastructure that makes every decision at Flosum smarter. This role reports directly to the CEO and is the highest-leverage operations hire we will make. You will touch every dollar of pipeline, every GTM motion, and every customer-facing team.

What You’ll Own

1. Data, Reporting & Forecasting — Your Primary Mandate

Your first 90 days are about establishing truth. Flosum runs on Salesforce, Marketo, and Gong.io. You will audit each, identify where data integrity breaks down, and rebuild the foundation:

Design and own the forecasting architecture: weighted pipeline using actual historical conversion rates, forecast categories (Commit, Best Case, Upside), and a weekly cadence that drives ±10% accuracy within two quarters

Build a standardized reporting hierarchy from the CEO’s decision-making needs down to frontline dashboards — eliminating the proliferation of reports nobody trusts Implement Salesforce data governance: mandatory stage-exit criteria, validation rules,

controlled picklists, and loss-reason capture on every Closed Lost opportunity Segment reporting and forecasting by GTM motion — PLG self-serve revenue behaves differently from enterprise outbound and must be modeled and tracked separately

Build and maintain the unit economics dashboard: CAC by motion, CAC payback period, LTV:CAC ratio, Magic Number, NRR/GRR, and S&M efficiency trends

2. Marketing Performance & Marketo Operations

You don’t run campaigns — you govern the infrastructure that makes marketing measurable and accountable:

Own the full lead lifecycle in Marketo: definitions, entry/exit criteria, and scoring model governance (with separate demographic and behavioral scores calibrated monthly against SQL conversion rates)

Own Marketo-Salesforce sync governance: field mapping audits, sync log review, and API consumption monitoring

Own multi-touch attribution: first-touch, last-touch, and influence models consistently applied across all four GTM motions

Build and enforce speed-to-lead SLAs and SAL acceptance standards; build recycle plays for disqualified leads

Monitor and report marketing funnel performance — lead volume, MQL-to-SQL conversion, channel efficiency, and marketing-sourced vs. marketing-influenced pipeline — and escalate anomalies before they show up in quarterly misses

3. Sales Process Governance

You are the steward of how Flosum’s revenue actually gets created — not a gatekeeper, but the person who builds the standards:

Design and enforce stage definitions with mandatory exit criteria; build deal desk processes for non-standard pricing and terms

Own territory design, quota allocation methodology, and annual capacity planning — including ramp rates, hiring timelines, and coverage ratio targets by segment

Run the weekly pipeline review cadence with sales leadership: stage conversion anomalies, stale deals, and forecast accuracy

Design compensation plans that drive the right behaviors across all four GTM motions — with clear rules of engagement for multi-touch deals where outbound, inbound, PLG, and partner motions converge on the same account

4. Enablement Execution Through Gong.io

At Flosum, enablement has historically been about delivery — training sessions, playbooks, messaging. You will own the other half: measurement and execution. After any messaging launch or methodology change, you will:

Create Gong AI Trackers for the specific language, frameworks, and discovery questions reps should be using — and build adoption dashboards segmented by rep, team, and region

Surface the gap between what was trained and what is actually happening on calls, and work with sales managers to close it with specific, Gong-sourced coaching examples

Use Gong deal boards for pipeline inspection: multi-threading health, next-steps coverage, competitor mentions, and conversation-based risk signals layered onto CRM data

Build the feedback loop: Enablement trains → Gong measures → RevOps reports gaps → Managers coach with specific call evidence → Enablement iterates. Without this loop, enablement is a cost center. With it, it’s a growth driver.

5. GTM Alignment Across All Four Motions

Running outbound, inbound, channel, and PLG simultaneously creates real operational complexity. You will design the systems that prevent chaos:

Build account-level ownership rules and real-time routing logic to prevent motion collisions (e.g., SDRs prospecting into accounts already working inbound MQLs, AEs working accounts with active PLG users)

Design PQL routing logic with product usage trigger thresholds, account-level checks, and comp plan rules for sales-assisted PLG conversions

Build deal registration governance and conflict resolution SLAs for the partner channel

Own separate Opportunity Record Types per motion in Salesforce with unified roll-up reporting

Run a monthly cross-functional GTM alignment meeting with sales, marketing, CS, and partner leadership — reviewing funnel health per motion and resolving ownership disputes before they fester

What This Role Is Not

We want to be honest about scope. A great RevOps leader at Flosum will push back when the role is being misused:

You will implement an intake process, maintain a visible quarterly roadmap of four to five initiatives, and force trade-off conversations when new requests arrive. You say “not now” to good ideas that aren’t the most important idea.

This is not sales operations with a rebrand. You serve the company, not any single department leader. Your loyalty is to revenue truth — even when the forecast is uncomfortable to present.

Metrics You’ll Own

Pipeline & Forecasting

Forecast accuracy (±10% target within two quarters)

Pipeline coverage by segment (3× SMB, 4× mid-market, 5× enterprise)

Pipeline velocity: (Opportunities × Deal Size × Win Rate) ÷ Cycle Length, targeting +10% improvement QoQ

Stage-to-stage conversion rates trended over time

Marketing (Marketo)

Lead-to-MQL, MQL-to-SQL, SQL-to-Opportunity, and Opportunity-to-Close rates by motion and channel

Marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline (targets: 30–50% sourced, 50–70% influenced)

Lead velocity rate (month-over-month qualified lead growth)

Speed-to-lead SLA compliance and SAL acceptance rate

Sales (Salesforce + Gong)

Win rates by segment and motion

Quota attainment distribution across the team (healthy target: 70–75% of reps at quota)

Average selling price trends and discounting rate

Sales cycle length by segment

Enablement (Gong)

Gong tracker adoption rates for key messaging and methodology by rep, team, and region

Talk-to-listen ratios and topic coverage by deal stage

Multi-threading indicators per deal stage

Unit Economics

CAC and CAC payback period by GTM motion

LTV:CAC ratio by customer segment (target ≥3:1)

Magic Number (Net New ARR × 4 ÷ prior quarter S&M spend; target >1.0)

Net Revenue Retention and Gross Revenue Retention

S&M as % of revenue (tracking toward 35% as we scale)

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

5–10+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM Operations in a B2B SaaS environment

Direct experience operating across multiple GTM motions simultaneously (outbound, inbound, channel, and/or PLG)

Hands-on Salesforce configuration experience — you can build Flows, design the data model, and implement validation rules without delegating everything to a developer

Marketo (or equivalent marketing automation) operational experience: lifecycle architecture, lead scoring, and Marketo-Salesforce sync governance

Gong.io (or equivalent conversation intelligence tool) experience: tracker creation, coaching dashboards, and deal inspection

Demonstrated experience building a forecasting methodology from scratch — not just inheriting one

Financial modeling comfort: unit economics, capacity planning, quota modeling, and comp plan design

Experience at a company with $15M–$75M in ARR; you have built things with your hands, not just directed others to build them

Strongly Preferred

Experience in the Salesforce ecosystem (ISV, SI, or AppExchange partner) — you understand our buyers, our competitive landscape, and our channel dynamics

Experience designing and governing partner/channel ops within a multi-motion GTMmodel

SQL proficiency or experience with a BI tool (Tableau, Looker, Sigma, or equivalent)

Prior experience designing and administering sales compensation plans

The Mindset We’re Hiring For

You Are a Builder

You ask “Why does this exist, and should we rebuild it?” before touching a tool. You ship minimum viable systems and iterate

relentlessly rather than designing perfect architectures that never launch.

You Are Company-First

Your loyalty is to revenue truth, not to any individual department leader. You present the forecast even when it’s uncomfortable. You push back when requests don’t serve the company’s priorities.

You Are a Systems Thinker

You see the revenue engine as an interconnected system. Changing lead scoring

You Are Cost-Conscious

You evaluate every tool, hire, and program through a unit economics lens. You resist “just thresholds ripples into pipeline coverage. Changing stage definitions changes forecast accuracy. You trace causes, not just symptoms add a tool” thinking. Flosum is self-funded and profitable — efficiency isn’t a constraint, it’s a competitive advantage.

Benefits

Build the Operating System for Flosum’s Next Phase of Growth

🏠 Remote-First 📈 B2B SaaS / ISV 🛠 Salesforce Ecosystem

What You'll Get

The authority and executive visibility to actually build — reporting directly to the CEO.

Competitive base salary + performance-based variable compensation + equity

A fully remote-first, global team that moves fast and operates with high trust

The chance to build the GTM operating infrastructure of a profitable, self-funded

Salesforce ISV with a category-leading product and enterprise customer base

Daily exposure to top leaders in Salesforce DevOps and B2B SaaS operations

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to shape the digital strategy at a high-growth Salesforce ISV.
  • Collaborative, innovative, and mission-driven culture.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits.
  • Career growth in a fast-scaling company serving global enterprises.

Extras (Benefits & Perks)

  • Competitive compensation, incentive structure, and company equity
  • Daily coaching, mentorship, and growth opportunity
  • Be part of a global, mission-driven team
  • Learn from top leaders in Salesforce DevOps and SaaS sales
  • Work on exciting challenges in a rapidly growing industry

Property Maintenance Coordinator (Yardi / AppFolio / Buildium) – Remote | U.S. Hours

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours (with flexibility for urgent maintenance issues)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Property Maintenance Coordinator to manage the end-to-end maintenance lifecycle across a portfolio of residential properties.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused property operations role. You’ll serve as the central point of coordination between tenants, vendors, property managers, and owners, ensuring maintenance requests are properly documented, prioritized, dispatched, tracked, and resolved.

You’ll be responsible for keeping a high volume of maintenance requests moving while maintaining accurate records in Yardi, AppFolio, Buildium, or similar property management software.

This role is ideal for someone with strong property management or maintenance coordination experience who is highly organized, responsive, and known for following through until every issue is fully resolved.

What You’ll Own

Maintenance Request Intake & Triage

  • Handle approximately 10–20 maintenance requests per day through phone, email, and tenant portals.
  • Log complete and accurate maintenance requests in Yardi, AppFolio, Buildium, or similar systems.
  • Assess urgency and prioritize requests appropriately.
  • Identify emergency issues requiring immediate escalation or dispatch.
  • Communicate expected next steps clearly to tenants.
  • Maintain fast response times across incoming requests.

Urgent issues may include:

  • Plumbing leaks
  • HVAC failures
  • Electrical problems
  • Safety concerns
  • Other time-sensitive property issues

Work Order Management

Own maintenance work orders from initial request through confirmed completion.

You’ll:

  • Create, assign, and track work orders.
  • Document repair scope, property information, and tenant details.
  • Monitor tickets through open, scheduled, in-progress, and completed stages.
  • Follow up consistently with vendors on outstanding work.
  • Escalate delayed or unresolved maintenance issues.
  • Maintain accurate notes and supporting documentation.
  • Confirm completion with tenants before closing tickets.
  • Ensure maintenance requests remain within established SLA timelines.

Vendor Coordination & Dispatch

  • Schedule and dispatch vendors for repairs, maintenance, and inspections.
  • Match vendors to jobs based on availability, expertise, location, and urgency.
  • Coordinate access and scheduling between tenants and vendors.
  • Verify vendor licensing and insurance requirements where applicable.
  • Monitor repair progress and follow up on delays.
  • Hold vendors accountable for timelines and service quality.
  • Review invoices against completed work before routing them for approval.
  • Maintain organized vendor records and communication histories.

Tenant Communication & Customer Service

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for maintenance-related communication.
  • Acknowledge maintenance requests promptly.
  • Provide scheduling and repair updates.
  • Communicate vendor delays or appointment changes.
  • Handle frustrated tenants calmly and professionally.
  • Follow up after repairs.
  • Confirm tenant satisfaction and issue resolution.
  • Ensure tenants remain informed throughout the maintenance lifecycle.

Preventive Maintenance Coordination

Coordinate recurring preventive maintenance programs such as:

  • HVAC servicing
  • Pest control
  • Safety inspections
  • Landscaping
  • Routine property inspections
  • Other scheduled property maintenance

Maintain preventive maintenance calendars and service records to ensure recurring work is completed on schedule and reduce avoidable emergency repairs.

Property Management Software & Documentation

Maintain accurate and current records inside platforms such as:

  • Yardi

As an AI Tutor specialized in multilingual audio capabilities, you will contribute to SpaceXAI's mission by training and refining Grok to excel in voice interactions, speech recognition, and auditory experiences across diverse languages, accents, and cultural contexts. Your work will focus on curating and annotating high-quality audio data to enhance Grok's global accessibility, enabling natural spoken interactions for users worldwide, bridging language barriers through accurate speech processing, and improving the AI's handling of multilingual audio nuances.

  • Work with technical staff to improve annotation tools for efficient audio workflows.

  • Strong comprehension skills and the ability to make independent judgments on ambiguous or varied audio material, including noisy or accented speech.

Company Overview:

Our client is a global technology services and consulting organization that combines industry expertise, digital engineering, cloud, data, enterprise platforms and business AI. The company operates across approximately 40 countries, employs more than 80,000 professionals and serves hundreds of major global enterprises. Its Healthcare and Life Sciences business is entering a deliberate scale phase built on strong domain capabilities, global delivery and established relationships across regulated industries.

The platform currently includes dedicated leaders for Life Sciences, Healthcare and Medical Devices. This newly created role will sit between those leaders and the Chief Business Officer, providing integrated commercial direction across the portfolio while keeping Life Sciences as the primary growth engine.

The mandate

  • Create and execute a unified growth strategy across Life Sciences, Healthcare and Medical Devices, with the majority of market attention, leadership energy and pipeline creation centered on Life Sciences.
  • Build a repeatable new logo engine and originate large, strategic opportunities. This is primarily a growth and sales leadership position, not a traditional account management role.
  • Help scale an existing combined business of approximately 9 figures multi-million dollar sales quota platform through organic growth, stronger market coverage, larger pursuits and sharper sector positioning.
  • Provide commercial leadership across three established sector businesses, align their go to market priorities and create one coherent executive story for clients, partners and the market.
  • Translate deep industry knowledge into board and C suite conversations, differentiated propositions and complex transformation programs that combine consulting, technology, engineering and managed services.

Sector priorities

Life Sciences, the primary focus

The successful executive will bring current, credible and commercially useful knowledge across pharma and biotech, CROs and CDMOs, consumer health and the broader life sciences value chain. Relevant areas include discovery and development, clinical trials, regulatory and quality, manufacturing and supply chain, commercial launch, patient services, data and AI, cloud modernization, enterprise applications and digital operating models.

Medical Devices and MedTech

The role will also support growth with device and diagnostics companies through connected products, software and platform engineering, product lifecycle services, intelligent validation, quality and regulatory assurance, smart manufacturing, supply chain transformation and digital health.

Healthcare

Relevant healthcare experience may span payers, providers, pharmacy benefit managers and HealthTech. Priority themes include patient and member experience, core platform modernization, interoperability, data and analytics, responsible AI, value based care, operational optimization and secure cloud native transformation.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the growth agenda. Set the commercial strategy, priority markets, target account architecture and investment choices required to achieve the portfolio ambition.
  • Win new logos. Personally lead executive access, pursuit strategy and closing for major new clients, while building a disciplined team based origination engine.
  • Shape large deals. Work with consulting, delivery, engineering, alliances and solution teams to convert industry problems into differentiated, outcome based propositions and multiyear programs.
  • Build market credibility. Represent the organization with senior industry executives, boards, partners and ecosystem leaders. Strengthen the external point of view on AI, digital engineering and regulated transformation.
  • Integrate three businesses. Align Life Sciences, Healthcare and Medical Devices leadership around a common growth plan without losing the specialist depth of each sector.
  • Run a rigorous pipeline. Establish clear qualification, account prioritization, forecasting, deal governance and conversion disciplines. Maintain visibility into revenue, margin, risk and resource needs.
  • Develop leadership capacity. Coach senior sales and sector leaders, raise standards for consultative selling and create a collaborative culture that connects front end growth with delivery excellence.
  • Expand selectively. Use existing relationships when they can unlock substantial new programs, but keep the role centered on new revenue rather than routine farming or account administration.

Required experience

  • Approximately 15 or more years of progressive enterprise sales, business leadership or market development experience, including significant responsibility in global technology services, digital engineering, consulting or a highly relevant enterprise product organization.
  • Predominantly Life Sciences experience, with current or recent responsibility for selling into pharmaceutical, biotech or adjacent life sciences clients.
  • Meaningful exposure to Healthcare and Medical Devices, whether through current responsibility or earlier leadership assignments.
  • A documented record of opening major new logos and building large new revenue streams. Candidates whose experience is primarily account farming will not match the central mandate.
  • Experience carrying or influencing a nine figure portfolio, or leading a comparably complex scale up involving multiple industry segments, large pursuits and global delivery teams.

jobs.excerpt: Knak is a mission-driven companyWhy?  Because our time is limited, our competition is fierce, and our margin for error is small.
jobs.description:
Knak is a mission-driven company

Why? Because our time is limited, our competition is fierce, and our margin for error is small. For us to have the greatest impact on the world, we need to be laser focused on our core mission, which is...

Empowering people to be creative.

That’s why Knak exists.

We are a world-class enterprise email and landing page creation platform with a focus on making successful and happy customers by providing them with an incredibly powerful, yet easy to use creation platform.

Our industry leading SaaS solution is built by Marketers, for Marketers. We know that it’s the small things that make the biggest impact and that emails and landing pages are where the rubber hits the road when it comes to Marketing Automation. We change the way Marketers work by making them more efficient, while improving conversion rate of their campaigns and helping them stay on brand.

Oh, and we have a bit of fun while doing it, too!

About the Role

Knak is hiring a Go-To-Market Analyst to support decision-making across go-to-market functions: marketing, revenue operations, sales, and finance. This is not a narrow campaign-reporting role. The person in this seat will be trusted with questions that span the full funnel, from lead generation and performance marketing through pipeline and revenue outcomes.

We are looking for someone who understands the marketing domain (lead generation, campaign performance, attribution, funnel metrics) as well as someone who can operate as a business analyst across departments. Candidates should be comfortable moving between "why did this campaign underperform" and "how does this connect to sales pipeline and finance targets."

What You'll Do

  • Analyze marketing performance across channels and campaigns, including lead generation and performance marketing metrics
  • Build and maintain reporting that connects marketing activity to sales pipeline, revenue, and finance outcomes
  • Partner with Revenue Operations and Sales to understand funnel conversion, attribution, and forecasting questions
  • Support Finance with GTM-related budget and spend analysis
  • Translate ad hoc questions from stakeholders across departments into clear, well-scoped analysis
  • Identify gaps or inconsistencies in GTM data and help improve data quality and definitions over time
  • Present findings in a way that is useful to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Work with AI team on building out data agents that serve marketing purposes
  • Work with Data Engineering on structuring data architecture and source tables for marketing purposes
  • Work with Finance on annual planning and setting targets

What You'll Bring

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in an analyst role, ideally with exposure to marketing, sales, or revenue operations data
  • Working knowledge of marketing concepts: lead generation, performance marketing, campaign attribution, funnel and conversion metrics
  • Strong SQL skills and comfort working directly with data rather than only pre-built dashboards
  • Working knowledge of CRM (Salesforce preferred) schema and objects
  • Familiarity with paid ad platform data such as Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads
  • Experience with Tableau or an equivalent BI tool (Looker, Power BI, or similar)
  • Ability to work across departments and communicate with stakeholders who have different priorities and levels of technical fluency
  • Comfort with ambiguity. Not every question will come pre-defined

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse
  • Familiarity with marketing automation or CRM platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, or similar)
  • Prior experience in a B2B SaaS environment

What Success Looks Like

Within the first few months, this person should be a trusted point of contact for GTM analytics questions, someone Sales, Marketing, and Finance all know to go to for clear, reliable answers, not just a dashboard builder.

Base Salary: The anticipated base salary range for this position is $120,000 - 150,000. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and internal equity. This range reflects base salary only and does not include other forms of compensation that may be available as part of the total rewards package.

What We Offer

At Knak we have four foundational pillars. Culture, customers, product and growth. Culture is our number one pillar because we know that is at the core of building a strong company that can build amazing products and delight our customers. We do this with a laser focus on hiring the right people who are smart, positive and who want more than the typical nine-to-five offers.

We offer an extremely rewarding, second to none work environment as acknowledged by Ottawa’s Best Places to Work 2025! We show our investment in our people through our competitive salaries, equity in the company, great benefits, paid vacation, Life leave days (because life happens), team lunches and off-sites, and most importantly our commitment to YOUR career growth.

If this sounds like something you’re looking for, then we’d love to hear from you!

If you don’t see yourself fully reflected in every job requirement listed on the posting above, we still encourage you to reach out and apply. Research has shown that women and underrepresented groups often only apply when they feel 100% qualified. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientations, and life experiences to apply. Knak believes in creating an inclusive, barrier-free working environment. If you require ANY accommodation to the interview process please contact
Knak, our recruitment process includes AI screening for keywords and minimum qualifications as well as video interviews which are transcribed with AI. Humans are still at the core of our decision making! Please note that this job post is for an existing vacancy.

jobs.description:
CORRELATION ONEについて

Correlation Oneは、人工知能（AI）やデータ分野の人材育成プログラムを世界中で提供する企業です。これまで11カ国で、50万人以上が当社のプログラムを受講しています。

Amazonの従業員向け教育支援制度「Amazon Career Choice（アマゾン・キャリア・チョイス）」の最大規模のトレーニング提供企業として、また米国の州政府と連携した職業訓練プログラムの構築などを通じて、企業の人材育成を支援しています。

米国経済誌『Fortune』が毎年発表する全米企業ランキング「Fortune 500」に選出された企業や、米国連邦・州政府機関、その他さまざまな企業・組織と協力し、AI、データ分析、サイバーセキュリティ、オペレーションリーダーシップなどの分野で、企業が求めるスキルと人材をつなぐ役割を担っています。当社では、受講者がプログラム修了後に現場で力を発揮できるよう、実践的な人材育成を重視しています。

職務概要

データセンター技術講師（リードインストラクター）は、ライブ形式のオンライン授業を担当し、社内スタッフと連携しながら受講者の学習を支援するポジションです。

主な業務は、データセンター技術に関するオンライン授業の実施です。本プログラムでは、さまざまな学習経験、職務経験、技術経験を持つ約100名の受講者を対象に、ライブ形式のオンライン授業を担当していただきます。

授業の準備・実施に加え、社内のプログラム運営チームとの連携を通じて、プログラム全体の円滑な実施と学習成果の向上に貢献していただきます。

プログラム詳細情報

  • 実施期間：2026年9月7日〜2027年4月16日
  • 日時：毎週火・木曜日 19:00〜21:30（日本時間）

オンライン授業の運営について

  • さまざまな学習経験、職務経験、技術経験を有する受講者を対象としたオンライン授業の準備および実施
  • 授業中の質疑応答の進行、チャットの確認および対応
  • クラス全体の雰囲気や受講者の参加状況を把握し、受講者の積極的な参加を促す

プログラム運営チームとの連携

  • Correlation Oneの運営スタッフと密に連携し、スケジュールに沿った円滑なプログラム運営を支援する
  • 必要に応じて、授業や教材の設計、開発、改善に協力する
  • 教材に関する修正内容、提案、変更点などを記録し、カリキュラム改善に貢献する

求める人物像

上記の主な業務に加え、リードインストラクターには以下の姿勢や対応が求められます。

プロフェッショナルな対応

  • 受講者、Correlation Oneスタッフ、その他のスタッフ、ゲストスピーカーなどに対し、常に相手を尊重したプロフェッショナルな対応を行う

授業準備

  • 質の高い授業を提供できるよう、事前に学習内容を十分に確認・準備する

受講者への対応力と共感

  • 受講者からの質問や相談に丁寧かつ迅速に対応し、学習をサポートする
  • さまざまな学習経験、職務経験、技術経験を有する受講者の理解度に応じて、説明の方法や授業のペースを調整する。同時に、予定された講義内容を時間内に適切に進める

オンライン授業の進行力

  • 適切なテンポで授業を進め、複雑な技術内容も分かりやすく伝えながら、受講者が積極的に参加できる授業づくりを行う

コミュニケーション

  • オンラインやテキストでのコミュニケーションでは、トーンやニュアンスが伝わりにくいことを意識し、相手を尊重したコミュニケーションを行う
  • Correlation Oneのスタッフとこまめに連絡・情報共有を行う

学習環境づくり

  • 前向きな姿勢で、受講者が安心して学べる雰囲気づくりに貢献する

授業内容の改善

  • 授業や教材について、具体的かつ率直なフィードバックをCorrelation Oneチームへ共有し、授業内容の継続的な改善に協力する

求める経験・スキル

  • EPI認定 CDCP®（Certified Data Center Professional）資格をお持ちの方
  • 日本語で流暢に授業ができ、英語で社内スタッフと問題なくコミュニケーションできる方（授業は日本語で行われます）
  • データセンター施設、またはそれに類する環境での実務経験をお持ちの方
  • 講師、研修、ファシリテーション、コーチング、新人教育・業務習得支援などの経験があり、技術分野の経験や知識が限られている初心者にも、技術的な内容を分かりやすく説明できる方
  • 優れたコミュニケーション能力を持ち、さまざまな学習経験、職務経験、技術経験を持つ成人学習者をサポートできる方
  • 技術チームの指導、監督、またはリーダーシップ経験。正式なオンライン授業や講義の経験が少ない方でも、こうしたチーム育成・指導経験をお持ちの方は歓迎します
  • データセンター運用やインフラ分野でのキャリアを目指す受講者の学習支援に強い関心・意欲をお持ちの方
  • 受講者の立場に立って考え、柔軟かつ忍耐強く対応できる方
  • CompTIA A+、Network+などの基礎IT資格をお持ちの方は歓迎します

勤務地

本ポジションは完全リモート勤務です。日本時間の授業および業務に対応可能な方であれば、応募していただけます。

報酬

報酬額は、地域、経験、学歴、スキルなどを考慮して決定します。報酬対象となる業務には、1回2時間30分の授業、授業準備、Correlation Oneスタッフとの週1回のミーティングが含まれます。

Correlation One’s Commitment

Correlation One is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to providing equal opportunity for all employees and applicants. Correlation One provides a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Employment decisions at Correlation One are based solely on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national, social or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. jobs.description:
About Welocalize

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com

Job Reference:

Job Description Summary

In this exciting position, the Multimedia Content Reviewer will be writing and reviewing linguistic content in a language which they have a native level proficiency to ensure the highest quality of accuracy for customers using the world's foremost multimedia platforms. With time the Multimedia Content Reviewer will become the cultural ambassador for their language market and will be expected to produce fully localized content and flag potential cultural issues with content types, wording and articulate suggestions to make all content appropriate and relevant for the target markets. 

The ideal candidate possesses a background in journalism or similar, has proven creative writing skills, and a keen attention to detail. In addition to that, we’re seeking candidates that are passionate about music, film, marketing, digital marketing, but also technical background and have a knack for iOS and Mac OS devices.

Position: Greek Multimedia Content Reviewer
Location: Greece
Contract type: Part-time
Pay: 12K-13K EUR Annual
Workweek: 4 hours a days, (Total 20 hours a week)
Start Date: ASAP
MAIN DUTIES-

The following is a non-exhaustive list of responsibilities and areas of ownership of the Multimedia Content Reviewer:

    • Localize, translate and adapt content of various categories (i.e. multimedia, music marketing, legal, technical, marketing etc.) while adhering to writing style guide and guidelines

    • Write new copy for a range of multimedia products such as music, TV and app store apps, video on-demand and game subscriptions services, with a focus on music.

    • Perform regular linguistic review of their own work as well as the work performed by other members of the localization team for all content types. 

    • Copy-edit and fact check content to ensure accuracy of content

    • Perform LQA (Localization QA) testing of any content published on live platforms (music and app descriptions, marketing material and marketing campaigns).

    • Conducts market-specific research on local content treatment, content, product and terminology trends and best localization practices for the target audience in their market. 

    • Report on data and/or assets across a broad scope of media and content types.

    • Review linguistic assessments, create training material and documents for new projects and ensure that other counterparts of the localization team are fully trained on terminology, style and best practices 

    • Collaborate with global language team via virtual meetings, emails on content review tasks to ensure calibrating terminology and style, understanding trends and market specific insights, translations based on the market team's needs.  

REQUIREMENTS-

    • BS/BA and 2+ years of work experience in the field of journalism, copywriting, or copyediting media content such as music, TV and applications with proof of writing samples

    • Experience in translation and localization of multimedia content

    • Ability to quickly detect issues and inconsistencies from a massive sea of content and make sound judgement calls based on information at hand

    • Is in tune and has a wide range of knowledge music artists, TV and cinema, gaming and pop culture

    • Has ability to own language market and make confident linguistic decisions

    • Must be highly detail-oriented with ability to multitask, prioritize and meet deadlines

    • Fluency in written and verbal English

    • Strong computer literacy, knowledge of iOS/ macOS systems a plus 

    • Well capable of typing in their native level language using a local (English) keyboard 

    • Ability to work independently and remotely

    • Collaborative; enjoys teamwork in a multicultural environment.
