TFS HealthScience is a leading global mid-size Contract Research Organization (CRO) that partners with biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies throughout their entire clinical development journey. Our expertise includes full service-capabilities, resourcing and Functional Service (FSP) solutions.

Join Our Team as a Freelance Senior Clinical Research Associate (0.1 FTE) - home based in Denmark.

Interested in future opportunities with TFS HealthScience?

We are currently building a network of experienced Freelance Senior Clinical Research Associates for an anticipated ophthalmology project. While this position is not yet actively open for immediate recruitment / onboarding, we encourage interested candidates to apply and join our talent community. Once sponsor requirements are confirmed, our Talent Acquisition Team we will reach out to candidates whose experience best aligns with the project needs.

About this role

As part of our Ophthalmology team you will be working alongside passionate and innovative professionals to ensure our customers achieve their goals.

The Freelance Senior Clinical Research Associate is part of Clinical Development Services (CDS) within TFS HealthScience, will function operationally as a member of a Project Team and is responsible for the initiation, on-site and/or remote monitoring and close out of study sites during study conduct, according to company policies, SOPs and regulatory requirements.

The Freelance Senior Clinical Research Associate will provide Unmasked Clinical Research Associate support for assigned clinical studies, including management of investigational product accountability, oversight of unblinded site activities, and monitoring of protocol compliance in accordance with study requirements and applicable regulations. The Freelance Senior Clinical Research Associate will collaborate with study teams, investigative sites and sponsors to ensure timely execution of study deliverables while maintaining the integrity of study blinding and data quality.

Key Responsibilities:

Monitor on-site and remotely clinical trials in accordance with TFS and/or sponsor Standard Operating Procedures GCP and ICH guidelines and applicable regulatory regulations. Perform all required monitoring activities at the study sites to assess and ensure subjects safety, data integrity and quality.

Verify the protection of study participants by informed consent procedures and protocol requirements that follow appropriate regulations.

Review CRFs (electronic or paper) and subject source documentation for validity and accuracy

Verify proper management and accountability of Investigational Product

Timely reporting of actions taken during monitoring visits in Monitoring Visit Report including findings, corrective and preventive actions already taken and update applicable tracking systems, as required; escalate observed deficiencies and issues as appropriate.

Providing site with the listing of issues identified during monitoring visit and action items which will need to be addressed in a timely manner.

Timely delivering site documents to eTMF or paper TMF.

Verify that the Investigator's Site File (ISF) is maintained in accordance with GCP and ICH guidelines and local regulatory requirements.

Update CTMS and all other required by projects systems with accurate site level information

Participate in audit and/or inspection, it’s preparation and follow-up activities, as needed.

Order, ship, and reconcile clinical investigative supplies for study sites, if applicable.

May assist the Clinical Research Manager or Project Manager in certain aspects of project activities which may include:

project tracking,

monitoring plans,

Review of monitoring reports

CRA resources management within the project

May perform Assessment Site Visits (ASV) when requested.

May act as a mentor to CRAs.

May develop and implement therapeutic area training for other CRAs and project team members.

May participate in capabilities presentations.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s Degree, preferably in life science or nursing; or equivalent

  • 5 years of independent on-site monitoring experience and at least 1 year experience as an unmasked monitor is required.

At least 1 year Ophthalmology, ideally within a retina indication (i.e. Age-related Macular Degeneration, Diabetic Macular Edema, Geographic Atrophy, RVO, BRVO, CRVO, etc.), experience is preferred.

Able to work in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.

Understand basic medical terminology and science associated with the assigned drugs and therapeutic areas.

Possess the understanding of Good Clinical Practice regulations, ICH guidelines.

Ability to work independently as well as in a team matrix organization.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Fluent in English and local language

Excellent organizational skills

Technology savvy and good software and computer skills

Soft skills requirements: Self-awareness, resolute, flexibility, collaborative mindset, proactivity, analytic approach, and attention to detail, coach ability, motivated to take on new challenges, facilitation of discussion, diplomacy in difficult situations.

Ability to take the ownership of the assigned tasks.

Ability to manage complex or early phases studies.

Ability and willingness to travel up to 60-80%, overnight and abroad, if applicable.

What We Offer

We provide a competitive compensation package, comprehensive benefits, and the opportunity for personal and professional growth in a rewarding environment. You’ll be joining a team that values collaboration, innovation, and making a difference in the lives of patients

A Bit More About Us

Our journey began over 25 years ago in Sweden, in the city of Lund. As a global CRO with the ultimate goal of ensuring patients’ safety and well-being, we provide biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies with tailored clinical development solutions. We currently operate in 17 countries across Europe, North America, Asia Pacific and the Middle East.

Our core values of Trust, Quality, Flexibility and Passion are what make TFS Healthscience the successful company it is today. Our values shape our culture and work ethic. They reflect what we stand for and guide our organization.

#Together we make a difference

jobs.excerpt: Our StoryTopDog Law is not your typical law firm.
jobs.description:
Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.

We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

The Opportunity

TopDog Law is scaling quickly, and Intake sits at the center of that growth. We are looking for a Director of Intake Operations who can build the leadership, operating discipline, and execution needed to turn demand into qualified opportunities, signed clients, and an exceptional first experience with our firm.

This is a build-and-lead role, not a maintenance role. You will lead a multi-function organization spanning Intake, In-House Signing, White Glove, and Reception/Client Success and create the structure, accountability, and operating rhythm that allow each team to perform at a high level as we continue to grow.

You will be accountable for execution against the KPIs that matter most to Intake, including true-to-routed rate, sign rate, speed to lead, answer rate, contact rate, intake quality, and agent productivity. The VP of Contact Strategy will set the direction, priorities, and target outcomes; your job is to turn that direction into clear operating plans, develop the leaders responsible for delivery, remove barriers, and make sure improvements stick. The Manager of Intake owns the day-to-day operation of Intake and

In-House Signing, while White Glove and Reception/Client Success leadership report directly to the Director until those functions require additional manager-level structure.

What You Will Own

Turn Strategy Into Execution

  • Take Contact Strategy priorities, KPI targets, and major firm initiatives and turn them into clear operating plans with owners, timelines, and measurable outcomes.
  • Build a consistent operating cadence across Intake, In-House Signing, White Glove, and Reception/Client Success so leaders know what matters, where performance stands, and what needs action.
  • Create alignment across specialized teams without forcing a one-size-fits-all approach to workflows, skills, or client handling.
  • Make change stick by ensuring new processes are communicated clearly, trained effectively, measured, and reinforced by leaders.

Know the Numbers and Drive Performance

  • Own execution against established Intake KPIs, including true-to-routed rate, sign rate, speed to lead, answer rate, contact rate, intake quality, and agent productivity.
  • Run disciplined business reviews that move beyond reporting the numbers to identifying root causes, assigning actions, and following through to results.
  • Translate department goals into clear expectations for managers, supervisors, teams, and individual contributors so every level understands how it contributes to the outcome.
  • Partner with Analytics to build trusted, actionable reporting and use the data to spot trends early, test solutions, and measure impact.

Build Leaders Who Build High-Performing Teams

  • Lead and develop the Manager of Intake and other functional leaders, giving them clear ownership, decision rights, expectations, and coaching.
  • Hold direct reports accountable for the day-to-day performance of Intake and In-House Signing, including supervisor effectiveness, productivity, coaching, quality, and process adherence.
  • Directly lead White Glove and Reception/Client Success leadership and determine when growth, complexity, or span of control warrants additional manager-level structure.
  • Build leadership bench strength and succession plans so the organization can continue to scale without creating single points of dependency.

Keep Intake Ready for What Comes Next

  • Make sure Intake is ready to execute new law firm initiatives, state launches, policy changes, case-evaluation updates, and new workflows from day one.
  • Partner with Learning & Development, Quality Assurance, and Legal to ensure training is accurate, practical, timely, and reinforced in the operation.
  • Use QA findings, conversion trends, decline patterns, and performance data to identify where the team needs stronger knowledge, coaching, or retraining.
  • Set a high bar for decision accuracy, routing quality, documentation, client communication, and process compliance across every Intake function.

Improve Conversion and Prospective Client Experience

  • Drive initiatives that make it easier and faster for prospective clients to reach us, complete Intake, understand next steps, and move toward the right outcome.
  • Find and eliminate friction, unnecessary handoffs, inconsistent processes, and missed opportunities throughout the prospective-client journey.
  • Raise the bar on follow-up execution, objection handling, intake decision quality, case routing, and signing readiness.
  • Standardize the fundamentals while preserving the specialized approach required for catastrophic, high-value, sensitive, or complex client interactions.

Stay Ahead of Demand

  • Partner with Workforce Management to connect lead volume and marketing investment to forecasting, staffing, schedules, hiring plans, and capacity decisions.
  • Keep staffing and leadership capacity ahead of anticipated demand so growth does not come at the expense of speed, conversion, quality, or client experience.
  • Use productivity, adherence, shrinkage, overtime, coverage, and capacity trends to identify where operating changes are needed before they become performance problems.
  • Make balanced operating decisions that consider service, conversion, employee experience, quality, and cost together.

Connect Intake to the Rest of the Business

  • Serve as the senior Intake partner to Contact Strategy Platforms, Workforce Management, Quality Assurance, Learning & Development, Analytics, Marketing, Legal, and other operational teams.
  • Turn business problems into clear requirements for Genesys, Salesforce, Filevine, reporting, automation, AI, and other tools that support Intake.
  • Own operational readiness for technology and workflow changes by making sure testing, training, communication, and adoption are complete before and after launch.
  • Drive cross-functional issues to resolution when they are affecting conversion, client experience, quality, productivity, or employee performance.

Protect the Business and Communicate Clearly

  • Ensure Intake consistently follows approved legal, compliance, calling, recording, documentation, data-handling, and client-communication requirements.
  • Surface material operational, client, compliance, staffing, or capacity risks early and bring forward clear recommendations, owners, and next steps.
  • Give the VP of Contact Strategy a concise, transparent view of performance, risks, priorities, execution progress, and resource needs.
  • Build a culture where leaders move with urgency, own their results, solve problems at the right level, and keep the client at the center of decisions.

What You Bring

Required:

  • 7+ years of progressive leadership experience in legal intake, contact center operations, sales, customer acquisition, or another high-volume, performance- driven service environment, including 5+ years leading managers, supervisors, or multiple layers of frontline leadership.
  • Demonstrated success improving conversion, contact rate, speed to lead, service, quality, productivity, or comparable operating metrics.
  • Experience leading multiple operational functions, teams, shifts, or locations with different workflows, customer needs, and performance expectations.
  • Strong working knowledge of performance management, workforce planning, quality, training, and operational analytics, with the ability to diagnose root causes and turn data into action.
  • Strong executive communication and cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to create clarity, influence decisions, and move work forward in a fast-changing environment.
  • High ownership, strong judgment, and the ability to balance growth, client experience, employee development, compliance, operational discipline, and financial performance.

Preferred (Nice to Have):

  • Experience with Salesforce, Genesys Cloud CX, Filevine, or comparable CRM and contact center platforms.
  • Experience leading teams across multiple locations, countries, or time zones and driving large-scale operational change, automation, or AI-enabled workflows.

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

  • Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"
  • Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.
  • No-Ego Energy: Positive, professional, and solutions-oriented. Drama stays at the door.
  • Ownership: You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.
  • Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

What We Offer

  • Base Salary: [Min} and [Max], commensurate with experience
  • Eligible for performance-based bonus
  • Our job postings reflect the compensation range for the specific market and location of each role. Ranges vary by geography based on local market rates and cost of labor.
  • Benefits include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, HSA, life insurance, disability coverage, paid time off, and parental leave.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an equal opportunity employer. Employment selection and related decisions are made without regard to age, race, color, national origin, religion, sex, disability, sexual orientation, gender identification, or being a qualified disabled veteran or qualified veteran of the Vietnam era or any other category protected by Federal or State law.

Job Title

Director, Data Science

Job Description

About The Position | Major Goals and Objectives and Location Requirements:

People Inc. is America’s largest print and digital publisher, reaching tens of millions of readers every day. We’re hiring a Director of Data Science to lead customer intelligence and personalization for our entertainment brands, helping shape products and experiences that inform, engage, and inspire our audiences.

In this role, you’ll build a deeper understanding of our customers across product engagement, marketing response, and lifecycle behavior. You’ll partner closely with Product, Marketing, and Editorial teams to turn data into actionable insights that drive growth, while working with Data Operations and Engineering to ensure our models, measurement systems, and insights can scale effectively.

You’ll apply statistical modeling and machine learning to product and marketing challenges across customer segmentation, acquisition, engagement, retention, and lifetime value, with a particular focus on mobile app experiences. You’ll own models and analyses that support personalization, automated marketing, attribution, experimentation, and lifecycle optimization across apps, newsletters, and other customer touchpoints, translating complex audience behavior into clear recommendations and measurable business impact.

Schedule Requirements:

In-office Expectations:

This position is fully remote with no in-office requirements, (might require coming into an office periodically for team meetings, etc.)

About The Team | The Team and/or Brand:

People Inc. is the largest premium publisher in the world. Every day, tens of millions of people come to us for help and inspiration. Our library of hundreds of thousands of articles helps our users understand how to deal with day-to-day challenges. You will work with a team of data scientists, collaborating with cross-functional groups to leverage this incredible dataset to understand both our content and our users' needs. This knowledge will be used to identify and build out new products that leverage the behavioral information within our extensive data.

About The Position’s Contributions:

Weight % Accountabilities, Actions, and Expected Measurable Results

  • Lead and grow a data science team to develop predictive models that estimate customer lifetime value using advanced statistical and machine learning techniques.

  • Analyze and understand customer interactions across app, web, social media, and email touchpoints to identify and optimize engagement opportunities.

  • Own product funnel and engagement analysis, including onboarding completion, feature adoption, feature stickiness, and session behavior, as distinct from marketing-funnel metrics such as acquisition and retention.

  • Leverage data-driven insights to build customer segmentation models, identifying high-value users and informing content and product recommendations.

  • Partner with Product and Editorial teams to translate user understanding into differentiated experiences across the app, newsletters, and other customer interactions, feeding insights directly into the product development cycle. This includes the sizing of opportunities and assessment of product success.

  • Design online A/B testing experiments to measure the impact of product changes, personalization, and full-funnel marketing interventions.

  • Ensure effective collaboration between data science teams and other departments.

  • Advocate for resources and tools to advance data capabilities.

  • Align data initiatives with company objectives.

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Education:

PhD or advanced degree in Data Science, Economics, Business Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, or similar quantitative field, or equivalent experience.

Experience:

  • 7+ years of experience in data science and machine learning with a strong focus in the area of customer behavior, product analytics, and marketing-focused problems.

  • 5+ years of experience leading a team of data scientists.

  • Ability to lead product and funnel analytics on web and mobile platforms with a focus on providing actionable insights, not just data outputs.

  • Solid foundation in causal inference, survival analysis, and time series analysis, especially as applied to marketing and customer behavior.

  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL for data analysis and model development.

  • Familiarity with Claude Code/Codex and how they can be used reliably (and where they fail) in a data science workflow.

  • Strong strategic and operational capabilities.

  • Excellent leadership and communication skills.

  • Ability to communicate complex analyses clearly to non-technical marketing and business stakeholders.

  • Drives adoption of new data science methods and technologies to continually expand what the product can do.

Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:

  • Experience with large-scale search and recommendation systems in media, e-commerce, or advertising space.

  • Experience working with large-scale analytics platforms (e.g., BigQuery).

  • Exposure to reinforcement learning or bandit approaches for personalization or offer optimization.

  • Advanced experimentation techniques, including multivariate testing, factorial designs, and CUPED.

  • Experience with Bayesian statistical methods for inference and decision-making under uncertainty.

  • Experience with forecasting models and advanced lifecycle or retention modeling.

  • Applied NLP experience for content classification, semantic search, or audience understanding.

  • Track record of leading end-to-end data science projects from problem framing through deployment and impact measurement.

  • Confidence and pride in representing Data Science as a strategic partner to Marketing and other business teams.

% Travel Required (Approximate): ~5%, ability to travel periodically/quarterly for team meetings/events preferred but flexible based on candidate needs

It is the policy of People Inc. to provide equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, the Company will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. Accommodation requests can be made by .

The Company participates in the federal E-Verify program to confirm the identity and employment authorization of all newly hired employees. For further information about the E-Verify program, please click here:

Actual pay may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors including but not limited to work location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of People Inc's total compensation package for employees. Other compensation may include annual bonuses, and short- and long-term incentives.In addition, People Inc. provides to employees (and their eligible family members) a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, prescription drug coverage, unlimited paid time off (PTO), adoption or surrogate assistance, donation matching, tuition reimbursement, basic life insurance, basic accidental death & dismemberment, supplemental life insurance, supplemental accident insurance, commuter benefits, short term and long term disability, health savings and flexible spending accounts, family care benefits, a generous 401K savings plan with a company match program, 10-12 paid holidays annually, and generous paid parental leave (birthing and non-birthing parents), all of which may vary depending on the specific nature of your employment with People Inc. and your work location. Job Description

Job titleSenior Software EngineerDepartmentEngineeringReports toDirector of EngineeringLocationRemote (US); ClassificationFull-timeExperience level8+ years professional software engineering

Position summary

The Senior Software Engineer builds, maintains, and improves the backend services, APIs, and third-party integrations that power SureCost’s pharmacy purchasing and inventory platform, which over 1,600 pharmacies use every day. The role writes production software with fully agentic AI development workflows. AI agents (Claude Code or equivalent) are the main environment for writing, testing, and running code. The work is backend focused and centered on .NET, within a full-stack ownership model. The engineer owns features end to end: the API contract, the service logic, the data layer, any external integrations, the supporting UI where needed, deployment, and production support. They work in a cross-functional pod with other senior engineers and QA.

Essential duties and responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend services and RESTful APIs in C# / .NET ( Core) on the company’s current and next-generation platforms.
  • Build and maintain integrations with third-party systems, such as accounting platforms, ERP, EDI, and vendor APIs. This covers authentication (OAuth 2.0), data mapping and sync, webhooks, rate limiting, retries, idempotency, and error reconciliation.
  • Design data models and write efficient, well-tested data access against relational databases (SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL), including schema migrations and query performance tuning.
  • Direct agentic AI development workflows to write, test, refactor, and document code. Review agent output and confirm it passes the company’s blocking quality gates before release.
  • Own delivered work end-to-end: design, implementation, automated tests, deployment, monitoring, and fixing production issues that arise from that work.
  • Build and maintain automated test coverage (unit, integration, and contract tests), including AI-authored test suites, as a condition of feature completion.
  • Work with the pod on API contracts. Build or modify React / TypeScript front-end code when needed to finish a feature without handoffs at team boundaries.
  • Take part in sprint planning, estimation, code review, and the pod’s operational cadence. Report status and blockers clearly and early.
  • Contribute to shared libraries, integration patterns, and platform foundations.

Required qualifications

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with substantial production backend work in C# / .NET.
  • Hands-on experience building and supporting production integrations with third-party platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience shipping production code through fully agentic AI development tools (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor agent mode, or equivalent). This means using agents to write, test, and operate substantial production code, not only code completion.
  • Strong proficiency in Core, RESTful API design, asynchronous programming, and dependency injection, plus an ORM such as Entity Framework Core and/or Dapper.
  • Solid relational database skills (SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL): schema design, query optimization, and migrations.
  • Working proficiency in React and TypeScript, enough to build and modify front-end features as part of full-stack delivery.
  • Strong problem-solving skills: able to read unfamiliar codebases quickly, debug across layers (API, data, external systems, UI), and make sound technical decisions under time pressure.
  • Working fluency in at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; GCP or Azure acceptable), including messaging and queuing (e.g., SQS/SNS), and the ability to learn new stacks quickly.
  • Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of production software, including post-release support.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with additional accounting, ERP, or financial integrations (e.g., Xero, NetSuite, Sage) or EDI (X12 850/855/810).
  • Event-driven and asynchronous architectures: background workers, message queues, and reliable sync / reconciliation patterns.
  • Containerized deployment (Docker, ECS, or Kubernetes) and infrastructure as code (Terraform).
  • Observability tooling (e.g., Datadog) for tracing, logging, and alerting on integration health.
  • React PWA, React Native / React Native Web, or design-system experience.
  • Data-dense B2B application experience (purchasing, invoicing, ERP-style workflows).

Success measures (first 6 months)

  • Independently delivers the pod’s committed backend and integration work through the release gate, sprint over sprint.
  • Uses the team’s agentic development pipelines fluently, and agent-authored test coverage ships with every feature.
  • Owns at least one production service or integration surface with no unresolved escaped defects attributable to delivered work.

Working relationships

Reports to the Director of Engineering (career line) and takes technical direction from the pod lead. Works daily with pod engineers, QA, the product owner, and contractor teammates.

As a key member of Grantek’s Engineering team, you will be developing real-time automation solutions from the manufacturing plant floor to the enterprise level, using a variety of programming, configuration, and design tools: PLC and PAC Programming, Operator Interface and HMI application design, SCADA design, Network design, Database design, Vision system design, Machine Safety system design, Servo motion control, Information Solution design, MES design, ERP connector development, High-level software solution design (involving C#, HTML5, .NET, SQL, VB, VBA, and more). All junior team members will enter our mentoring program, where they will work directly beside our Senior Engineer professionals.

Key-skills and interests: machine and process control, high-level programming, information solutions, database development, operational efficiency, mechatronics.

Primary Job Responsibilities:

  • Engineering and implementing real-time automation controls and information solutions
  • Conceptualizing during the design phase of the project life cycle
  • System programming, debugging, and testing
  • Creating documentation, including project engineering notes, project proposals, project design traceability documentation, case studies, and more
  • Commissioning new solutions at client sites; finding opportunities for improvements
  • Creating methodologies and complex problem-solving
  • Learning new technologies
  • Mentoring colleagues on your expertise and knowledge base
  • Having fun and being challenged

Technologies Used

  • PLC Programming Platforms: Rockwell / Allen-Bradley, Siemens, Omron, Modicon, GE, etc.
  • System Networking: Ethernet, Routing and Switching, EthernetIP, DeviceNet, ControlNet, Profibus, DH+, Remote IO, Modbus, etc.
  • HMI Platforms: Rockwell / Allen-Bradley, Wonderware, Schneider Electric, etc.
  • SCADA Platforms: Rockwell / Allen-Bradley, Inductive Automation, Wonderware, GE, Siemens, etc.
  • Servo Motion Control: Rockwell / Allen-Bradley, Emerson, Omron, etc.
  • Vision Platforms: Cognex, Datalogic, Keyence, etc.
  • MES Platforms: Rockwell / Allen-Bradley, Sepasoft, Wonderware, etc.
  • High-level Programming: C#, HTML5, .NET, Cloud, SQL, VB, VBA, etc.
  • Database Platforms: Microsoft, Oracle, etc.
  • Operating Systems: Microsoft (current and legacy to NT), Unix, Linux, etc.
  • Project Documentation: Microsoft Office
  • Successful or upcoming completion of a B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Science, or related Engineering Technology discipline.
  • 6–8+ years of practical experience with PLCs, SCADA/HMI, networking, databases, motion, safety, or high-level programming (as outlined in the Technologies Used section).
  • Academic or industry experience with Ignition (Vision & Perspective), Allen-Bradley, and/or Beckhoff TwinCAT strongly preferred.
  • Meticulous, conscientious, analytical, focused, and able to learn complex systems quickly.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to interface with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in fast-paced environments.
  • Flexibility for local travel with occasional day trips, and the opportunity for additional travel within India.

We are committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to provide Grantekians with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment.

From concept to design to execution, be part of the team that gets everyday products to people.

Do you want to have an impact on creating products from today’s top brands? Does having a company care about your career today and into the future motivate you? Does an environment where your opinions matter excite you? Are you a natural born tinkerer? If so, you have found your next calling!!

Grantek is a recognized leading provider of integrated automation, smart manufacturing and industrial information solutions in the global marketplace. Our clients are some of the worlds most respected Fortune 100 companies and recognized consumer brands: Mondelez, Brita, Molson Coors, Coca-Cola, Kraft-Heinz, to name a few.

We offer an atmosphere where you can express your creative ideas and talents by working on a variety of projects and technologies. Using today’s leading edge technology, you will partner with clients to solve their most complex manufacturing and industrial information problems.

We offer a competitive and comprehensive compensation package, retirement matching, company paid benefits, flexible work hours, and an education/career development program. For more information on what Grantek offers, visit:

We are committed to providing a positive and healthy corporate culture, one that empowers employees, promotes knowledge-sharing, and encourages strong friendships and social connections amongst all team members. We are a team of dedicated Engineers and Designers with an average of 7 years’ tenure at Grantek. The vast majority of our employees have started off their careers at Grantek and have grown into successful senior team members who are integral to our client's manufacturing processes.

Experience Required: 6+ years

We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Software Engineer – .NET to design, build, and maintain enterprise-grade web applications and distributed systems built on Microsoft technology stacks. This role spans the full engineering lifecycle — requirements analysis, architectural design, hands-on implementation, code review, deployment, and post-release support — with particular emphasis on building scalable APIs, responsive front-end applications, and cloud-integrated services. jobs.description:
About LaunchDarkly Engineering

LaunchDarkly helps engineering organizations ship software and AI with speed, safety, and control. Our platform gives teams the confidence to release gradually, target experiences to the right audiences, learn through experimentation, understand what is happening in production, and respond quickly when risk appears.

Our engineers build the systems, services, SDKs, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, and product experiences that make this possible. The work spans high-scale distributed systems, reliable data and event pipelines, intuitive enterprise workflows, and AI-powered capabilities that help teams manage the next generation of software delivery.

LaunchDarkly’s SDKs are used in systems that perform trillions of feature flag evaluations each day, giving our engineering work a direct connection to the reliability and customer experience of software around the world. As the company grows, we are expanding beyond traditional feature management into experimentation, observability, and AgentControl—helping customers control more of the software and AI lifecycle. That creates an unusually broad set of technical challenges, visible customer impact, and room for engineers to shape what comes next.

We believe in the power of teams. We work with humility, openness, curiosity, and care; we value clear communication, thoughtful technical judgment, inclusive collaboration, and a strong sense of ownership. We encourage people to apply even when they do not meet every qualification listed below. We are interested in the experience, perspective, and potential you would bring to the role.

About the Job

As a Software Engineer on LaunchDarkly’s SDK team, you will build the primary touchpoint that our customers interact with on a daily basis. You’ll work with multiple technologies across our 35+ SDKs while enabling customers of all kinds to feature flag their code. When working on our SDKs, you’d be contributing to much more than thin client wrappers. Our SDKs are feature-rich agents with strong emphases on performance, concurrency, and resiliency -- all while following idiomatic practices for their tech stack.

LaunchDarkly serves trillions of feature flags daily to customers all around the globe, and every flag is handled by our SDKs. This team has a major impact not only on our company, but on our customers (and their customers). We are growing fast and we need your help writing the next chapter in our story.

Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to development for SDKs in supported platforms:

    • Implement new features and improvements to meet customer performance and resiliency requirements

    • Keep up to date with the latest development practices

  • Collaborate with our engineering and product teams to drive the implementation and release of major features

  • Actively maintain our open-source repositories

  • Identify areas of improvement and advocate for best practices

  • Have an active voice in shaping both technology and product decisions

Basic Qualifications:

  • Demonstrable experience building libraries and packages used by other developers

  • Polyglot background with an ability to context switch between languages quickly

  • 5+ years experience with at least two of the following: .NET/Go/Ruby/Python/NodeJS/Java

  • Experience with the following is a plus:

    • C++/Erlang/Haskell/Lua

    • AI SDKs

    • Observability SDKs

    • Mobile development

  • Strong computer science fundamentals

  • Committed to working in a communicative, collaborative environment

  • Self‐starter and problem solver, willing to solve difficult problems and work independently when necessary

  • Strong testing background: experience building unit, integration, load tests, and benchmarks

  • Experience writing production-ready code with emphasis on quality and maintainability

  • Experience contributing to open-source software

Logistics:

  • This is a remote role, with opportunities to visit the office in the Bay Area, California, for team offsites

  • The SDK team is spread between Eastern and Pacific time zones

Highlights:

  • You will work collaboratively with a team of highly experienced engineers who are amazing at the craft of engineering and building SDKs

  • Your contributions will be publicly visible as the SDK team develops LaunchDarkly’s open-source SDKs in public

  • LaunchDarkly uses our own SDKs. You will have opportunities working with the other teams within LaunchDarkly

  • In this role, you can learn about many programming languages and frameworks

  • You will have opportunities to strongly influence roadmap and prioritization

Pay:

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level 3:

  • Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $171,200 - $235,400**
  • Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $154,100 - $211,860 **
  • Zone 3: All other US locations - $145,500 - $200,090 **

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

  • Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages
  • Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts
  • Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize
  • Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types
  • Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability

HungerRush is a leading provider of integrated restaurant technology solutions. From independent owners to large multi-unit brands, we provide one of the most complete systems to digitally enable fast-growing brands of any size. Learn more at Menufy.com.

Overview

The position is to lead a team of engineers building our e-commerce, growth marketing, and consumer apps. Leading includes coordinating, growing, and empowering their direct reports and others within their respective team. It also includes direct participation in those same activities.  

This role requires close partnership with product managers to shape priorities, plan initiatives, and align technical execution with business goals. Engineering Managers should also communicate regularly with customers and stakeholders to gather feedback, provide updates, and ensure the team’s work delivers meaningful value. 

At times, this leader will need to focus on unblocking the team through both direct and indirect contribution. They are expected to develop a broad understanding of the business to provide context for the team’s efforts and to identify opportunities where the team’s expertise can make a greater impact.

Our focus is on embedding AI into our internal processes to streamline development, improve decision-making, and accelerate the delivery of business value. We’re looking for engineers who are excited to be part of this transformation and who want to innovate, adapt quickly, and help us build a culture that thrives on intelligent automation and efficiency.

  • Guide the development of engineers with mentoring, training, and performance management  
  • Build high scale systems with a focus on reliability, scalability, and solving business needs  
  • Contribute to software development with an emphasis on architecture, design, quality, implementation, and culture  
  • Utilize the latest advances in AI software development to improve effectiveness of delivering business value 
  • Collaborate with stakeholders including product managers and operations teams  
  • Responsible for continuous improvement in processes and standards 
  • Contribute directly to the codebase as needed  

Qualifications 

  • Experience as a technical leader and people manager for at least 2+ years  
  • Extensive professional experience, recommended 10+ years

  • Experience with React, Bootstrap, Vue.js, and other front-end frameworks 
  • Experience with Queues, Caches, CDN’s, and other technologies used for building scalable web applications 
  • Experience with SQL Azure, Azure Service Bus Queues, and Redis Cache

This position is open to candidates who are authorized to work in the United States, without sponsorship, either now or in the future. At this time, and in the foreseeable future, HungerRush is not able to support assistance with additional visa sponsorship, regarding this specific position.

jobs.description:
About Definitive Healthcare:

At Definitive Healthcare (NASDAQ: DH), we’re passionate about turning data, analytics, and expertise into meaningful intelligence that helps our customers achieve success and shape the future of healthcare. We empower them to uncover the right markets, opportunities, and people—paving the way for smarter decisions and greater impact.

Headquartered just outside of Boston, Massachusetts, Definitive Healthcare operates across North America, Europe, and India, supporting a growing global client base of more than 2,400 customers since our founding in 2011.

We’re also a great place to work. In 2024 and 2025, we earned multiple workplace honors, including Built In’s 100 Best Places to Work in Boston (both years), a Stevie Bronze Award for Great Employers, and recognition as a Great Place to Work in India.

We foster a collaborative, inclusive culture where diverse perspectives drive innovation. Through programs like DefinitiveCares and our employee-led affinity groups we strive to promote connection, education, and inclusion.

About the Role

Definitive Healthcare is seeking a Data Engineer to build, maintain, and support reliable data pipelines and transformations that power critical healthcare data products and customer-facing solutions.

This role is accountable for the quality, reliability, and timely delivery of assigned pipeline components and data changes. Working with engineering and domain experts, the Data Engineer develops moderate-complexity solutions, troubleshoots pipeline and data quality issues, and supports production operations across Claims and Consumer data domains.

Success in this role requires hands-on experience with Python, SQL, Spark/PySpark, cloud data platforms, workflow orchestration, and modern engineering practices. The Data Engineer works with growing independence, follows established standards, communicates progress and blockers, and collaborates with engineers, analysts, Product, Support, and data consumers.

What You’ll Do

Pipeline Engineering & Component Ownership

  • Build, maintain, test, and support moderate-complexity ETL/ELT pipelines, transformations, and data components using Python, SQL, Spark/PySpark, and related technologies.
  • Own defined pipeline components from implementation through testing, deployment, documentation, and production support with technical guidance as needed.
  • Troubleshoot pipeline failures, data quality issues, and performance problems; identify root causes with support and implement practical, maintainable fixes.

Design, Quality & Operational Reliability

  • Contribute to component-level technical designs, estimates, and implementation plans while following established architecture and engineering standards.
  • Apply team practices for data modeling, testing, code review, observability, security, source control, CI/CD, and operational support.
  • Monitor pipeline performance and reliability, surface risks and blockers early, and identify opportunities to improve quality, efficiency, and maintainability.

Domain & Stakeholder Partnership

  • Develop working knowledge of Claims and Consumer data structures, source-to-target transformations, pipeline dependencies, and expected data quality standards.
  • Collaborate with engineers, QA, analysts, Product, Support, and data consumers to clarify requirements, resolve issues, and deliver reliable data changes.
  • Assess downstream impacts of data and schema changes, communicate technical status clearly, and support vendor-delivered data sources and customer issues.

Collaboration, Growth & Engineering Practices

  • Participate actively in code reviews, pairing, sprint activities, technical discussions, documentation, and team knowledge sharing.
  • Support peers and less-experienced engineers by sharing knowledge, providing constructive review feedback, and modeling effective engineering practices.
  • Use approved AI-assisted development tools responsibly to improve productivity, documentation, test coverage, and code quality while following team review standards.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2+ years of Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or related experience building and supporting production data solutions.
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL, with hands-on experience developing and maintaining production data pipelines.
  • Experience with Apache Spark/PySpark or equivalent distributed data processing technologies.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Delta Lake, or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience with workflow orchestration technologies such as Airflow, Argo, or equivalent platforms.
  • Working knowledge of relational databases, data modeling, testing, code review, observability, source control, CI/CD, and production support practices.
  • Ability to own defined technical work, troubleshoot issues, collaborate effectively, and communicate progress, risks, and blockers.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Healthcare data experience, including claims, pharmacy, eligibility, consumer, provider, or reference data.
  • Experience processing large datasets using lakehouse or medallion architecture patterns.
  • Experience deploying, operating, or supporting Spark workloads in Kubernetes or similar containerized environments.
  • Experience supporting enterprise data products, analytics platforms, or business-critical data services in regulated environments.
  • Experience onboarding or supporting vendor-delivered datasets and evaluating schema or downstream consumer impacts.
  • Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve development productivity, testing, documentation, and code quality.

Compensation and Benefits

The salary range for this position is $93,000 – $141,000 per year, which represents the base pay the company reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this role. Actual pay within this range will be determined based on factors such as relevant experience, skills, and qualifications.

Depending on the position, employees may also be eligible to participate in a company bonus or commission plan. All employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, unlimited paid time off, and participation in the company’s 401(k) plan with employer contribution.

Why we love Definitive, and why you will too!

  • Industry leading products
  • Work hard, and have fun doing it
  • Incredibly fast growth means limitless opportunity
  • Flexible and dynamic culture
  • Work alongside some of the most talented and dedicated teammates
  • Definitive Cares, our community service group, gives all of us a chance to give back
  • Competitive benefits package including great healthcare benefits and a 401(k) match

-Business Development Manager

“I have waited 36 years to work at a dream job for a dream company and I am so happy to have finally got there.”

If you are a California, Colorado, New York City or Washington resident and this role is a remote role, you can receive additional information about the compensation and benefits for this role, which we will provide upon request.

Definitive Hiring Philosophy

Definitive Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer that celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace with equal opportunity for all applicants and teammates. Our goal is to recruit the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool regardless of race, color, religion, age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other status. jobs.title: Senior Director, US Decision Science & AI Innovation
jobs.excerpt: Business Introduction GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future.
jobs.description:
Business Introduction
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

Position Summary
Are you a senior analytics leader who wants to set the scientific standard for how a major pharmaceutical business makes its commercial decisions — while staying hands-on in the methods themselves? If yes, this Senior Director, US Decision Science & AI Innovation role could be an ideal opportunity to explore.


This role owns the analytic and AI methods that turn data into commercial decisions across US Commercial — marketing mix and investment optimization, next-best-action and dynamic targeting, patient predictive triggering, and causal measurement — and their deployment into the business through enterprise capabilities. Success in this role requires strong partnership across GSK, including brand teams, Insights & Analytics, data engineering, the Digital & Technology organization, and data management.


The role sets what constitutes a defensible method, decides what is certified enterprise method versus brand configuration, and is accountable for the scientific quality, reproducibility and explainability of results used in brand and portfolio decisions. Accountability does not stop at the model: the role owns the decision engines, embedded field and omnichannel triggers, and planning and measurement tools through which methods reach users, and their adoption. A method or solution that is not used has not delivered.


As the organization moves to enterprise supply with brand-driven priorities, both the method and the capability carrying it must be built once, certified and reused rather than rebuilt brand by brand. This is a player-coach role, not an analytics oversight role — the post holder sets standards and develops the organization while working directly in the analytics, setting the technical bar by example. The role leads the applied AI agenda across agentic AI, generative AI and synthetic data, with a prototyping pipeline that graduates or retires techniques on evidence, and directs offshore GCC analytic capacity on methodology and development. Brand teams and Insights & Analytics retain ownership of interpretation and commercial action.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own the certified method portfolio — marketing mix and investment optimization, next-best-action and dynamic targeting, patient predictive triggering, and causal measurement — driving reuse across brands and eliminating duplicate bespoke builds.
  • Own deployment of those methods through enterprise capabilities — decision engines and simulators, embedded field and omnichannel triggers, planning and measurement tools — and be accountable for adoption and sustained use.
  • Operate as a player-coach: personally design, review and build, setting the technical bar through direct involvement rather than oversight alone.
  • Set and enforce method standards — validation, versioning, documentation, reproducibility and explainability — and define what is certified enterprise method versus brand configuration.
  • Lead the applied AI agenda across agentic AI, generative AI and synthetic data — including multi-agent orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation and evaluation pipelines — with a prototyping pipeline whose explicit criteria either graduate techniques into production or retire them.
  • Ensure methods, capabilities and AI applications meet GSK Responsible AI, privacy and data-use requirements, including model risk assessment, human oversight of automated recommendations, and permitted-use compliance for patient-level data, with a model registry and ongoing monitoring in place before anything scales.
  • Partner with data engineering and the Digital & Technology organization for the platform and engineering these capabilities run on, and with data management for certified inputs.
  • Own build-versus-buy decisions, biased toward building quickly and efficiently in-house; buy where it accelerates delivery and the capability can be absorbed into the GSK ecosystem. Hold vendors to internal standards.
  • Act as method authority for brand teams and Insights & Analytics, translating demand into a prioritized roadmap sequenced against published capacity and communicating uncertainty and limitations to executive audiences.

Why You?

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree; Masters and PhD preferred.
  • 12+ years of experience with hands on modeling.
  • Experience deploying predictive analytics machine learning algorithms, deep learning algorithms and/or information retrieval at scale.
  • End to end model exploration, development, deployment and management.
  • Experience developing insights and storylines through translation of analysis and modeling
  • Depth in commercial pharmaceutical methods — marketing mix modeling, next-best-action, patient-level predictive modeling or causal measurement — with accountability for results used in business decisions
  • Production generative or agentic AI experience in commercial pharma, under enterprise governance — shipped and in use

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Build and deploy tools and methodologies to create solutions enabling analytics and measurement of sales and marketing activities (e.g., market-mix modeling, cross-channel attribution, omni-channel segmentation and customer targeting, patient pathways, omni-channel customer journey analysis and optimization etc.)
  • End to end experience in retrieving data and developing an executive-level analysis through advanced analytics techniques
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work effectively across boundaries – both cultural and functional. This role requires partnership across business areas and with offshore teams, meaning a flexible communication style and astute cultural awareness are highly valued.
  • Leadership capability is critical; You’ll work in a matrix, inspiring change rather than commanding action. As a leader within the organization, we need an agile, confident decision maker – someone able to solve sophisticated problems with effective solutions.
  • Experience setting agentic AI vision and governance across an organization rather than a single team
  • Working command of current GenAI tooling — LLM APIs, prompting and context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (vector stores, chunking, retrieval evaluation) and LLMOps evaluation pipelines
  • Familiarity with multimodal data — structured claims alongside unstructured clinical notes and lab signals — and with US commercial data assets such as IQVIA, Komodo, Symphony and Veeva

#GSK-LI


Skills

AI Frameworks, Algorithm Optimization, Artificial Neural Networks (ANNS), Computer Programming, Deep Learning, Feature Engineering, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) for Machine Learning, Machine Learning Algorithms, Machine Learning Operations, Microsoft Azure Data and AI, ML Frameworks, Model Evaluation, Model Training, Model Validation, Performance Optimizations, Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)The US annual base salary for new hires in this position ranges from $186,750 to $311,250. The US salary ranges take into account a number of factors including work location within the US market, the candidate’s skills, experience, education level and the market rate for the role. In addition, this position offers an annual bonus and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program which is dependent on the level of the role. Available benefits include health care and other insurance benefits (for employee and family), retirement benefits, paid holidays, vacation, and paid caregiver/parental and medical leave. If salary ranges are not displayed in the job posting for a specific country, the relevant compensation will be discussed during the recruitment process.

Please visit GSK US Benefits Summary to learn more about the comprehensive benefits program GSK offers US employees.

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

jobs.excerpt: Leidos seeks a Senior Multi-Cloud Architect to provide hands-on technical leadership for secure, resilient, cost-effective applications and cloud services supporting the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), including Medicare, Medicaid, and Marketplace applications.
jobs.description:
Leidos seeks a Senior Multi-Cloud Architect to provide hands-on technical leadership for secure, resilient, cost-effective applications and cloud services supporting the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), including Medicare, Medicaid, and Marketplace applications. Working across AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), you will translate mission, security, and operational needs into implementable architectures and lead their adoption with application and platform teams.

As a senior technical individual contributor, you will own the quality of assigned architecture deliverables and recommendations within program governance. You will partner with CMS Application Development Organizations (ADOs), CMS Hybrid Cloud product teams, and Enterprise Shared Service teams to modernize applications, resolve complex cross-platform problems, and deliver measurable improvements in reliability, security, performance, delivery efficiency, and cost.


Primary responsibilities

  • Architecture leadership. Assess current-state architectures and define target-state designs, transition roadmaps, architecture decision records, and reusable reference patterns. Lead design reviews and document trade-offs, dependencies, risks, and exceptions within established CMS and program governance.
  • Multi-cloud design. Select cloud services and workload placement based on mission fit, security, reliability, data needs, cost, and operating complexity. Design hybrid and cross-cloud integration, identity, networking, and shared services without imposing unnecessary provider parity.
  • Application partnership. Serve as a trusted technical advisor to ADOs; translate application requirements into prioritized modernization plans with clear ownership and acceptance criteria. Coordinate implementation across cloud, application, security, testing, and operations teams.
  • Hands-on implementation. Build and review reusable infrastructure-as-code modules, automation, and reference implementations. Define secure CI/CD patterns with automated testing, policy checks, artifact controls, and rollback; validate critical designs through prototypes and production delivery.
  • Security and compliance. Embed least privilege, identity federation, segmentation, encryption, secrets management, and auditability into designs. Partner with security stakeholders on applicable FISMA, NIST SP 800-53, CMS ARS, and FedRAMP requirements, including control responsibilities and authorization evidence.
  • Reliability and operations. Define service-level objectives and recovery time and recovery point objectives with application owners. Design observability, failure isolation, backup, recovery, and safe change practices; validate resilience through testing and operational-readiness reviews.
  • Cost and lifecycle management. Evaluate total cost of ownership, utilization, performance, and lifecycle risks. Prioritize remediation, upgrades, technical-debt reduction, and cost optimization with measurable results and explicit security and reliability trade-offs.
  • Technical leadership. Mentor engineers and provide technical direction across vendors and teams. Lead complex troubleshooting and post-incident improvements; establish documentation, runbooks, and support transitions that enable sustainable operations and clear accountability.

Please be advised that if you are moved to the interview stage, during the interview you will be required to keep your camera on, and your interviewer will be taking your picture for identification purposes if an offer letter is extended to you


Education and experience

  • Bachelor's degree and 12 or more years of relevant experience, or a master's degree and 10 or more years of relevant experience. Additional years of experience may be substituted in lieu of degree.

Eligibility and background investigation

  • Candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust determination and meet the program's stated requirement to have resided in the United States for at least three of the previous five years.

Required qualifications

  • Architecture delivery. Demonstrated ownership of complex production cloud architectures from requirements and design through implementation and operational validation, with evidence of outcomes, constraints, and trade-offs.
  • Multi-cloud depth. Deep production architecture and implementation experience in at least two of AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, with the ability to evaluate services and architecture trade-offs across all three. OCI experience is preferred.
  • Core architecture. Ability to design hybrid/cloud networking, identity and access controls, compute, storage and data services, integration, resilience, and observability; select appropriately among containers, serverless, virtual machines, and managed services.
  • Hands-on engineering. Hands-on experience developing and reviewing production-quality infrastructure as code using Terraform or equivalent; engineering Kubernetes and managed container platforms; and implementing secure CI/CD. Proficiency in at least one general-purpose programming language and shell scripting.
  • Security and compliance. Experience designing or modernizing FISMA-regulated systems and translating security requirements into implemented, testable controls and evidence. Working knowledge of NIST SP 800-53, shared responsibility, and cloud authorization boundaries.
  • Operational and economic judgment. Experience validating recovery and performance, diagnosing complex production failures, and making quantified cost, reliability, security, and maintainability trade-offs.
  • Leadership and communication. Demonstrated ability to work independently, lead design decisions across organizational boundaries, mentor engineers, and resolve technical disagreements constructively. Ability to document architectures and communicate options, risks, recommendations, and results to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with CMS Hybrid Cloud, CMS Enterprise Shared Services, CMS Acceptable Risk Safeguards (ARS), and application onboarding or modernization within CMS.
  • Production OCI experience or broader hands-on depth across additional cloud providers.
  • Relevant advanced cloud architecture, DevOps, or security certification, supported by demonstrated production delivery.

What success looks like

Accepted architectures adopted in production; progress against agreed reliability and recovery objectives; reduced delivery risk and operational toil; measurable cost and performance improvements; and effective adoption by ADOs. Targets will be established with program and application owners.

We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

jobs.description:
This role may require in-person interview/s in Austin, Texas

About Osano:

Osano is an innovative B-Corporation built around a simple belief: privacy is a fundamental right. Since day one, we’ve been focused on giving modern enterprises the ability to innovate quickly, stay competitive, and earn customer trust by respecting data privacy and complying with consent guidelines. Our products help organizations operate confidently in a rapidly evolving regulatory and technological landscape.

About The Role:

We're looking for a product-minded Senior Software Engineer to own meaningful parts of the Osano platform end to end, from shaping a problem with Product to running the result in production.

This role is for an engineer who treats AI tooling as a real force multiplier. You use coding agents and AI-assisted workflows to explore unfamiliar code faster, ship more and remove repetitive work. You also have the judgment to verify everything that goes out under your name. We want someone whose impact goes beyond what they write by hand, and who helps the engineers around them do the same.

You'll work across our React front end, Node.js services, PostgreSQL data stores and AWS infrastructure. You'll partner closely with Product, Design, QA and Security.

This is a remote role. You must be based in, and authorized to work in, the United States.

What you'll do:

Build and ship product, end to end

  • Lead multi-sprint projects from design through rollout: turn a loosely defined problem into a plan, break it into work that you and others can action, and deliver close to estimate.
  • Design systems that hold up, and write design docs and decision records that weigh the alternatives.
  • Partner with Product on scope: propose MVP cuts, phasing and tradeoffs, and measure whether what we shipped actually helped customers.

Engineer with AI to multiply your impact

  • Use AI coding agents and assistants across the whole development lifecycle: exploring codebases, scaffolding, writing tests, debugging, refactoring, migrations and code review.
  • Stay accountable for every line you ship. You understand and can explain AI-generated code, and you know where AI shouldn't be trusted.
  • Turn repetitive engineering work into automation: scripts, agent workflows, and checks that save your team time every week.
  • Share what works: help define how our teams use AI tools, and how we review and verify AI-assisted work.
  • Use AI responsibly. Customer and personal data stays out of AI tools except through approved, privacy-safe paths. This is non-negotiable at a privacy company.

Own what you ship in production

  • Build observability, feature flags and rollback paths into your work from the start.
  • Take turns on our triage and on-call rotation. Lead incident response for your team's systems, and see postmortem follow-ups through to completion.
  • Identify tech debt, size it, and make the case to get it into the plan.

Build with privacy and security by design

  • Apply data minimization, residency, retention and access controls to the systems you design, especially those that handle customer and personal data.
  • Write secure code and fix vulnerabilities in your area as part of normal work.

Raise the bar and grow others

  • Give code and design reviews that change outcomes, not just approvals.
  • Mentor engineers earlier in their careers, and make your team better at testing, reviewing and operating software.
  • Interview candidates and help us hire well.

About you:

  • Delightful Experience. You care about the customer problem, not just the ticket, and you push for what actually helps.
  • Own Your Impact. You take full responsibility for outcomes, from the first design doc to how the feature behaves in production at 2 a.m.
  • Stronger Together. You put team success ahead of individual wins, give direct and kind feedback, and treat documentation and async communication as first-class work.
  • Growth Mindset. You're curious and keep learning, especially as AI changes how software gets built. You're excited about what it can do without overselling it or ignoring its limits.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and create clarity for others through good design and clear writing.

Must-haves:

  • Typically 5+ years building and shipping production software. We care more about what you've owned than the number of years.
  • A track record of leading multi-sprint projects from design to production in a team setting.
  • Strong JavaScript/Node.js and React experience, and solid relational database skills (PostgreSQL preferred).
  • Strong system design fundamentals: data modeling, API design, and naming the tradeoffs.
  • Experience owning production systems: on-call, incident response, observability.
  • Hands-on, day-to-day use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot, with concrete examples of how they made you or your team more effective, and how you verify their output.
  • Experience mentoring other engineers.
  • Strong written communication in a remote, async environment.

Nice-to-haves:

  • AWS experience (ECS/Fargate, Lambda, S3, RDS), especially multi-region or data-residency work.
  • Privacy, security or compliance-sensitive B2B SaaS (GDPR, CCPA, SOC 2).
  • Building AI-powered automations, agent workflows or LLM-based product features.
  • Data and analytics tooling (Redshift, Athena) or event-driven architectures.
  • CI/CD, preview/ephemeral environments, end-to-end testing (Cypress).

How we work:

  • Fully remote, with at least four hours of overlap each day with your team's core hours.
  • Collaborative and video-on for meetings, and async-first for everything else. Bring people in when they are needed and share what you’re working on with the team.
  • Regular 1:1 checkins with your manager, with a focus on growth conversations.

Why Us:

  • We're a welcoming team that's dependable, curious, moves fast, and full of talented people
  • We're a B-corporation with a mission that matters, in a high-growth space with significant potential
  • You'll have access to our training program, well-defined career paths, and a leadership team that values professional development

Benefits:

  • Competitive-pay compensation and ownership interest/equity
  • Unlimited paid time off, plus a requirement to take at least two weeks off per year
  • We're a Best Place for Working Parents and offer paid parental leave for all new parents
  • Osano sponsors individual premiums on base plans at 100% and dependent premiums at 50% for Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance via Aetna
  • A fully and permanently remote company, so you can work from anywhere in the U.S.
  • Receive a MacBook and $600 to craft your home workspace
  • Annual company trip designed to foster connection, creativity, and fun
  • Mental health benefits with free memberships to mindfulness and talk therapy services

A Bit More About Osano:

Osano is a leading data privacy platform that helps organizations quickly and confidently comply with laws like GDPR, CCPA, and other global privacy regulations. From consent management to vendor risk monitoring, Osano makes complex privacy tasks refreshingly simple, so companies can focus on what they do best, while we handle the rest.

We’re backed by top-tier investors, including Baird Capital, Jump Capital, and LiveOak, and we’re scaling fast with a multi-year runway and ambitious growth plans.
