The manager oversees project planning, agile execution, DevSecOps, and CI/CD pipelines, and guides developers in effective AI‑assisted delivery using tools such as Kiro, Claude Code, and OpenAI‑based solutions. They ensure governance and guardrails for AI, maintain compliance, and partner with cross‑functional stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable, and efficient applications.


Key Responsibilities


The manager provides end‑to‑end leadership for software development teams working across Java/Spring, React, Python, SQL, AWS, and Kubernetes. Responsibilities include:

  • Development Team Leadership: Direct and support a geographically distributed team working on legacy, modernized, and cloud‑native applications, ensuring clear priorities, coordination across workstreams, and consistent engineering practices.
  • Delivery Management: Own project planning, scheduling, resourcing, and risk management to ensure successful delivery against scope, schedule, and budget. Oversee contract obligations and ensure commitments are met.
  • Agile/Scrum Execution: Run agile ceremonies; manage product and team backlogs; lead sprint planning, review, and retrospectives; and oversee release planning and tracking using Jira, Confluence, and related tools.
  • Engineering Standards: Define, implement, and enforce standards for coding, architecture, testing, documentation, and code reviews. Promote best practices that improve maintainability, reliability, and performance.
  • DevSecOps and CI/CD: Ensure secure development and automated testing and deployment pipelines across relevant tech stacks. Drive the adoption of DevSecOps practices, infrastructure‑as‑code, automated quality checks, and continuous delivery into AWS and Kubernetes environments.
  • AI‑Assisted Development: Enable the team to use AI tools effectively for solution design, coding, testing, debugging, documentation, and troubleshooting. Promote agentic workflows and AI teaming to increase velocity and quality.
  • AI Guardrails and Governance: Define and enforce human‑in‑the‑loop controls for AI‑generated outputs. Protect security, privacy, and sensitive data, and ensure traceability and accountability for AI‑assisted work.
  • Compliance and Review: Apply working knowledge of compliance, security, and contractual requirements. Implement structured code, peer, and release reviews so all changes are validated before production.
  • Cross‑Functional Collaboration: Partner with customers, product owners, architects, security, infrastructure, and other stakeholders. Communicate decisions, progress, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non‑technical audiences.
  • Continuous Improvement and Modernization: Use delivery, quality, and cycle‑time metrics to evaluate both traditional and AI‑assisted approaches. Drive modernization of legacy systems, cloud migration, and process improvements that increase efficiency, resiliency, and scalability.

People Management


The manager is also accountable for building and developing a strong, engaged team:

  • Mentoring and Coaching: Provide technical and professional coaching to developers and other team members, supporting ongoing learning, AI upskilling, and career growth.
  • Workload Prioritization: Set clear goals and expectations, ensure work is aligned to priorities, and balance capacity across individuals and squads to avoid bottlenecks and burnout.
  • Performance Management: Deliver timely, constructive feedback; conduct performance reviews; recognize strong performance; and address performance concerns with clarity and fairness.
  • Team Culture and Engagement: Create an inclusive, respectful, and high‑trust culture across remote and geographically dispersed team members. Foster collaboration, transparency, and psychological safety.
  • Talent Development: Support hiring, onboarding, retention, and succession planning. Build a resilient team with the right mix of skills for legacy maintenance, modernization, and cloud‑native development.

Required Technical and Management Qualifications

  • A Bachelor's Degree with 5 + years of documented management or leadership experience (e.g., product management, project management, software development management, or team leadership).
  • At least 5 years of experience across the full software development lifecycle, including agile delivery.
  • Proven experience leading senior developers and/or multidisciplinary application teams, including remote or distributed teams.
  • Demonstrated strength in organizational skills, prioritization, communication, stakeholder management, and problem solving, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives.
  • Hands‑on experience with modern application technologies such as Java, Spring, Hibernate, SQL, React, Python, AWS cloud services, Kubernetes, and associated integration patterns.
  • Experience using AI‑assisted development tools across the lifecycle (design, implementation, testing, code review, documentation, troubleshooting).
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD, DevSecOps, cloud‑native architectures, APIs, containers, automated testing, and secure development practices.
  • Ability to articulate architecture, tradeoffs, status, risks, and recommendations to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Required Certification


  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate (required).

Preferred Certifications


  • Project Management Professional (PMP) and/or Certified ScrumMaster (CSM).
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional.
  • AWS Certified DevOps Engineer.
  • Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD).
  • Certified SAFe Agilist or SAFe Practice Consultant, particularly for scaled agile environments.
  • AWS Certified AI Practitioner, as a foundation for AI/ML and generative AI services on AWS.

Additional Desired Skills


  • Familiarity with refugee and immigrant populations and related social programs.
  • Knowledge of federal procurement and acquisition processes.
  • Experience working as a consultant or contractor within the federal government.
  • Background in technology modernization, legacy transformation, cloud migration, or organizational change initiatives.

Other Requirements


  • U.S. citizenship.
  • Ability to successfully complete a Public Trust background investigation.
  • Remote work location.
The likely salary range for this position is $147,050 - $198,950. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.

jobs.description:
Role : Technical Account Manager, Zephr

Location, Sofia, Bulgaria / Italy - Bari or Naples

Company Overview

At Zuora, we do Modern Business. We help companies subscribe to new ways of doing business that are better for people, companies, and ultimately the planet. Through our leading expertise and multi-product suite, including Zuora Billing, Revenue, Collect, and Zephr, we help the world's most innovative companies monetize new business models, nurture subscriber relationships, and optimize digital experiences.

Zephr, Zuora's subscription experience platform, helps digital businesses create, personalize, and monetize subscriber journeys across websites, apps, identity flows, paywalls, and connected commerce experiences.

The Team & Role

We are looking for a Technical Account Manager, Zephr to join our Technical Account Management team.

As a Senior Zephr TAM, you will act as a trusted technical advisor to strategic customers using Zephr to power digital subscription, registration, identity, entitlement, and paywall experiences. You will provide ongoing architecture guidance, best-practice recommendations, technical design reviews, and proactive advisory support to help customers increase value from their Zephr investment.

This is a senior, customer-facing role for someone who can combine deep Zephr product expertise, strong web technology knowledge, and commercial awareness. You will work with customer product, marketing, engineering, architecture, and operations teams to understand business objectives, assess technical design choices, identify risks, and recommend scalable paths forward.

You will also partner closely with Zuora Customer Success, Support, Product, Engineering, and Professional Services teams to ensure customers receive coordinated guidance and clear next steps.

This is a Sofia-based role with flexible work arrangements. The role requires availability across EMEA business hours and regular overlap with US-based stakeholders, customers, and internal teams.

What you'll do

  • Serve as the senior technical advisor for Zephr customers, helping them optimize their implementation and align Zephr capabilities to business goals.
  • Lead regular customer office hours, technical reviews, design discussions, roadmap alignment sessions, and executive-friendly technical readouts.
  • Advise customers on Zephr architecture, configuration, identity flows, access rules, paywalls, registration journeys, personalization, and integrations.
  • Review customer designs and implementation approaches to identify scalability, maintainability, performance, or operational risks.
  • Guide customers on adoption of new Zephr and Billing capabilities that improve digital subscription growth, operational efficiency, and subscriber experience.
  • Maintain or guide the creation of architecture documentation, implementation notes, runbooks, and technical decision records.
  • Support troubleshooting of complex customer issues involving Zephr configuration, integrations, browser behavior, APIs, webhooks, and data flows.
  • Partner with Support and Product teams to provide customer context, escalate issues appropriately, and advocate for product improvements.
  • Translate customer business priorities into practical technical recommendations and phased action plans.
  • Mentor and support internal teams by sharing Zephr best practices, reusable guidance, and customer implementation patterns.

Your experience

  • 5+ years of experience in Technical Account Management, Solution Consulting, Technical Consulting, Solution Architecture, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
  • Hands-on experience with Zephr preferred, including customer implementations, configuration, integrations, or ongoing technical advisory.
  • Strong experience working with enterprise SaaS customers, ideally in digital subscriptions, media, publishing, e-commerce, identity, martech, or customer engagement platforms.
  • Solid understanding of modern web technologies, including JavaScript, HTML, REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and browser-based application behavior.
  • Familiarity with technologies commonly used in Zephr ecosystems, such as CMS platforms, CDNs, CDPs, identity providers, React, GraphQL, and tag management tools.
  • Ability to analyze customer requirements, separate critical needs from nice-to-haves, and recommend practical technical designs.
  • Experience facilitating technical workshops, design reviews, customer training, and senior stakeholder readouts.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple strategic customers and priorities while maintaining clear ownership, follow-through, and documentation.
  • Experience working across EMEA and US time zones.
  • Experience with Zuora Billing, subscription monetization, entitlement management, or quote-to-cash processes is a plus.
  • Media, publishing, or digital subscription industry experience is a strong plus.

What success looks like

  • Customers view you as a trusted senior advisor for Zephr architecture, adoption, and optimization.
  • Customer teams have clearer architecture, stronger documentation, and fewer avoidable implementation risks.
  • Customers adopt relevant Zephr and Zuora capabilities with confidence.
  • Complex customer issues are better contextualized, prioritized, and coordinated across Zuora teams.
  • Product and Support teams receive actionable customer feedback grounded in real implementation needs.
  • Zephr customers see stronger value realization from their ongoing partnership with Zuora.

#ZEOLife at Zuora

As an industry pioneer, our work is constantly evolving and challenging us in new ways. Our people, whom we call ZEOs, are empowered to take ownership and make a bigger impact. We collaborate deeply, exchange ideas openly, and together we make what's next possible for our customers, community, and the world.

Bulgaria Benefits

  • Supplemental Medical Insurance
  • Life and Accidental Death Insurance
  • Food Vouchers
  • MultiSport Card

Location & Work Arrangements

Organizations and teams at Zuora are empowered to design efficient and flexible ways of working, being intentional about scheduling, communication, and collaboration strategies that help us achieve our best results. For this role, the successful candidate will be based in Bulgaria and able to support EMEA business hours with regular overlap for US-based stakeholders, customers, and internal teams.

Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace

Think, be, and do you. At Zuora, different perspectives, experiences, and contributions matter. Everyone counts. Zuora is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all.

Zuora does not discriminate on the basis of, and considers individuals seeking employment with Zuora without regards to, race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us by sending an email to assistance(at)zuora.com.

Project – the aim you’ll have
This project is for a global leader in medical and travel security risk services, helping organisations protect their people wherever they work and travel. You’ll join a dedicated mobile team rebuilding the client’s traveller-facing apps, part of the Subscriber Portal, as fully native iOS and Android applications to replace the existing React Native versions. Travellers and expatriates use these apps to receive location-based medical and security alerts, access country risk information, check in, and contact 24/7 assistance centres with a single tap. The backend is already in place, allowing the team to focus on building a fast, secure and accessible native experience. When someone faces a crisis abroad, the app needs to work reliably when it matters most.

Role – how you’ll contribute​​​​​​​

  • Develop and maintain the native iOS application using the latest Swift and SwiftUI. Write clean, scalable, and well-documented code;
  • Collaborate with product managers, backend developers, designers, and other stakeholders on requirements review, suggest solutions and estimate efforts to build user-friendly applications;
  • Ensure that the mobile application is user friendly, efficient, and adaptive to different screen sizes and device models;
  • Optimise the application for maximum speed, stability and scalability;
  • Implement authentication, session management and secure data storage to enterprise security standards;
  • Implement location-based features and location-triggered push notifications;
  • Investigate and resolve production issues, including crash analysis, root cause analysis and hotfixes
  • Implement app monitoring and analytics;
  • Implement app localisation in multiple languages and accessibility support;
  • Write and maintain unit and UI test cases, and contribute to CI/CD pipelines;
  • Take ownership of features and modules end to end, review peers' code against team standards, and contribute to technical design discussions;
  • Update internal knowledge base and operational documentation.

Expectations – the experience you need

  • 5+ years of experience in native iOS development using Swift and SwiftUI;
  • Solid understanding of Swift concurrency, including async/await, actors and data race prevention;
  • Experience implementing location services and push notifications;
  • Experience with OAuth 2.0/OIDC, session management and secure credential storage;
  • Experience integrating third-party frameworks;
  • Hands-on experience writing and maintaining unit and UI tests;
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines;
  • Proven ability to own features end to end, support production applications and resolve incidents;
  • Experience working closely with architects and reviewing other engineers’ code;
  • Familiarity with Scrum, Jira and Confluence;
  • Strong attention to detail, communication and problem-solving skills, with a commitment to continuous learning;

jobs.excerpt: About A1MA1M Solutions is a woman-owned small business driven by the aspiration to provide value to our customers, employees, partners, and community while remaining aligned to our guiding principles of foundational values, deliberate focus, and empathetic connection.
jobs.description:
About A1M

A1M Solutions is a woman-owned small business driven by the aspiration to provide value to our customers, employees, partners, and community while remaining aligned to our guiding principles of foundational values, deliberate focus, and empathetic connection.

A1M’s mission is to preserve and improve government healthcare programs that are lifelines for underserved people in the United States, including people in poverty, elderly people, members of ethnic and racial minorities, immigrants, and refugees. We look for projects with nation-wide impact at the intersection of policy, data, and user experience design.

Besides building useful and usable digital services, A1M helps teams improve their agile, user-centered design practices – or helps them get started. Our goal is not just to build sustainable public services, but also to leave our teaming partners and customers more skilled and more confident in the future.

Technology Delivery at A1M

A1M Technology Delivery Practice staff meet client and user needs by planning, building, and maintaining solutions that involve programming and scripting. Our practice includes product managers, software engineers, and data analysts. We analyze government client challenges and identify how best to help the client meet their goals, which may involve custom code, low code, and no code approaches.

Technology Delivery Practice staff work in cross-functional, cross-organizational teams with designers and policy subject matter experts. We approach challenges with flexibility, patience, thoughtful communication, and solid best practices in agile product management and development. We value high-trust teams.

About this Role

As an A1M Senior Software Engineer, you work with minimal guidance to design and implement complex, scalable systems. You collaborate with the team to break down ambiguous or complex goals into concrete, feasible steps that align with and inform wider system strategy. Senior engineers do not always have formal management or lead responsibilities, but an interest in teaching and coaching is essential.

Skills and Responsibilities

Technical capabilities

  • Build and maintain complex, scalable systems across application and/or infrastructure layers, and multiple components or services, using languages and frameworks such as TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, and Django.
  • Own components or services from development through deployment, monitoring, and production support
  • Deploy and manage systems in cloud environments, including AWS services, using CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and infrastructure as code where appropriate.
  • Design, build, and integrate APIs and data flows, working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL and cloud-based data services as needed.
  • Shape system design and contribute to architectural decisions, including writing decision documents and creating diagrams
  • Drive improvements in code quality, automated testing, linting, and development standards using appropriate tools and practices for the stack.
  • Contribute to robust DevOps practices, including deployment, monitoring, and incident response
  • Mentor engineers, review code and technical designs, and contribute to team growth and technical direction
  • Collaborate to break down ambiguous or complex goals into concrete, feasible steps
  • Seek out and share new technologies and skills that support project goals
  • Participate in discussions with internal and external stakeholders

Universal Categories for all A1M Senior Practitioners

Communication and collaboration

  • Build connections and relationships between people, teams/projects, and A1M and clients in ways that prevent and break down silos, enabling new opportunities for improved delivery.
  • Get buy-in from relevant parties (teammates, team leads, government stakeholders, etc.) to make sure necessary work happens.
  • Proactively recognize risks and conflicts within the team and clients, help identify approaches, and take action – manage up (understanding timing, context and other pressures, etc.) and escalate when appropriate.
  • Evaluate your own skills and deliverables and take action based on self-assessment. This might include proactively reaching out to other team members for help upskilling in skill gap areas.

Cross-domain understanding

  • Initiate and drive projects that require working with multiple people in other disciplines and practices on challenging problems.
  • Coach and mentor people not just within your own practice or discipline, but across practice areas – for example, designers coaching engineers.
  • Anticipate and proactively provide information needed by other practices and disciplines.

Government domain acumen

  • Proactively identify and respond to government requirements or policy that may impact project work, such as accessibility, PRA, FOIA, acquisition regulations, and security compliance.
  • Sufficient government understanding to anticipate needs of government partners and users, and be prepared to speak to them proactively.
  • Trusted to represent the company and team to clients, including in challenging situations.

Qualifications

8 years of relevant professional experience.

Your resume or portfolio should demonstrate:

  • Ability to write high-quality, tested, maintainable, and reusable code in production software systems
  • Advanced proficiency in one or more modern programming languages, with professional experience in technologies relevant to our stack, such as TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, or Go
  • Expertise in how to build secure, compliant software and minimize risk of vulnerabilities
  • Expertise in one or more adjacent specializations, such as data engineering, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, or application security, and the ability to flex skills as needed
  • Capable of operating as a self-starter in ambiguous environments, identifying high-impact work independently and executing on it
  • Proven ability to communicate technical results clearly and effectively to diverse stakeholders
  • Experience working in government consulting engagements

Preferred:

  • Experience building or maintaining production applications using technologies such as Django, PostgreSQL, or AWS services.
  • Experience working with a social impact-focused product team or in civic tech
  • Experience working with distributed, cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, engineers, and subject matter experts
  • Personal experience with government health and human services programs
  • Working knowledge of Medicare, the ACA, MACRA, Medicaid, or CHIP
  • Familiarity with SAFe and agile methodologies
  • Experience integrating modern applications with existing systems, APIs, or legacy platforms
  • Experience working on large-scale applications and systems

Applicant Requirements

  • Our contracts require employees to work from the United States. That includes all 50 US states, the District of Columbia, and all US territories.
  • A1M employees must have been residents in the United States for 3 of the past 5 years.
  • Due to tax reasons, A1M employees cannot reside in New York state.
  • You must already have legal authorization to work within the US and not require ongoing visa sponsorship to maintain legal authorization to work.
  • You must be a permanent US resident.
  • Because A1M employees have access to government data and systems, new hires will need to complete a Public Trust form. Public Trust is a type of background investigation, but it is not a security clearance. Depending on the role, you must complete either the Standard Form 85 (SF85) or 85P (SF85P) questionnaire. You will at the very least get asked questions about where you’ve lived, worked, went to school, military history, police records, and substance use. You’ll also need to have your fingerprints taken.
  • Our partners primarily work on Eastern Standard Time (EST), and will require flexibility in your hours if you reside outside of EST. We do offer flexibility for non-work-related life responsibilities during the day.
  • Active participation in client virtual meetings, including being on camera, is an essential function that helps strengthen trust and open communication. Employees who are unable to meet this expectation due to a disability, medical condition, religious practice, or other protected reason may request reasonable accommodations by contacting People Operations.

Compensation and benefits

This is a fully remote full-time, permanent position. The salary range for this role is $125,000 – $155,000. This range is set by our contracts and reflects the full range for someone in this position over time, so you may not start at the top of the range.

A1M offers a benefits package that includes:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Life insurance, short-term disability, and optional voluntary benefits
  • 401(k) retirement benefits with employer matching
  • Four weeks of paid time off, seven company holidays, two personal days, and your birthday off
  • Paid volunteer time
  • Wellness reimbursements
  • Budgets to support training, development, travel, and office supply needs
  • Donations to a nonprofit of your choice upon hire and a few times throughout each year

Interview process

We typically have five rounds of conversations to help ensure every employee we hire is the right addition for us and that we’re the right fit for them. Each interview is about 45–60 minutes long.

  1. A1M Overview - We like to start off by getting to know more about you, how you work, what you are looking for in your next role, and what you’re passionate about. This is your opportunity to ask questions and get a feel for us as A1M. We’ll talk about our mission and vision, and what we hope to accomplish through the business. We’ll also cover some particulars about federal contracting that may affect the timelines of when folks can expect to start. We talk about the type of contracts we have, and how our team tends to work.
  2. Technical Assessment - If our work at A1M broadly matches what you’re looking for, we’ll set up time to get into the nitty-gritty of your technical skills. In this conversation, you’ll meet with one of our managers to walk through one or two projects in-depth that you feel are most relevant to A1M’s work so that we can get an in-depth understanding of your skill set and interests. Please be prepared to speak about one or two projects you feel are most relevant to the work of A1M.
  3. Values Interview - After the technical assessment, we’ll schedule a conversation focused on A1M’s core values. This interview helps us understand how you approach your work, collaborate with others, and align with the way we operate as an organization, including areas like impact, collaboration, relationship management, curiosity, and active listening.
  4. Project Overview - Based on what we’ve learned in our prior conversations, we will match your unique background and goals with the right opportunity. Members of the project team will share the day-to-day of the project to outline its vision, objectives, and team dynamics. This conversation ensures the specific position aligns with your career goals as well as ensuring you’ll be successful on the team.
  5. Offer - At this point, you’ve made it! You'll meet with our leadership to go over the offer letter and have a chance to ask any remaining questions.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Who we are:

BigID is an innovative tech startup that focuses on solutions for data security, compliance, privacy, and AI data management. We're leading the market in all things data: helping our customers reduce risk, drive business innovation, achieve compliance, build customer trust, make better decisions, and get more value from their data.

We are building a global team passionate about innovation and next-gen technology. BigID has been recognized for:

  • BigID named one of Forbes America's Best Startup Employers 2026 - ranked #15 overall and #1 in Security
  • BigID named Hot Company in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning at the Global InfoSec Awards
  • Citizens JMP Cyber 66 List of Hottest Privately Held Cybersecurity Companies
  • CRN 100 list named BigID as one of the 20 Coolest Identity Access Management and Data Protection Companies (3 years running)
  • DUNS 100 Best Tech Companies to Work for
  • Top 3 Big Data and AI Vendors to Watch in the 2023 BigDATAwire Readers and Editors Choice Awards
  • 2024 Inc. 5000 list for the 4th consecutive year!
  • Shortlisted for the 2024 AI Awards in the category of Best Use of AI in Cybersecurity

At BigID, our team is the foundation of our success. Join a people-centric culture that is fast-paced and rewarding: you’ll have the opportunity to work with some of the most talented people in the industry who value innovation, diversity, integrity, and collaboration.

Senior IT Operations Engineer

Location: EST Time Zone
Compensation: $145,000-$165,000 + 13-15% bonus
Reports to: VP of IT

About the Role

BigID is hiring a Senior IT Operations Engineer to be the person teams turn to when a workflow crosses several tools, and nobody owns the gaps between them. You will build the automation that connects our systems, run the identity layer that controls access, and bring AI tooling to teams across the company.

This is an individual contributor role with a lot of room to lead. You will set your own technical direction, take projects from first request through rollout, and handle both planned project work and service desk escalations, so you will move between long builds and quick fixes.

We run internal IT with a DevOps mindset: systems are defined as code, changes ship through CI/CD, and repetitive work gets automated before it gets done by hand. Part of the global IT team is in Tel Aviv, so you will also be the North American contact for urgent requests, escalations, and production incidents when they are offline.

Most of your work happens with the Security, R&D, People, Support, Engineering, and GTM teams. You will work with them to understand a process that currently depends on someone copying data between tools, design the fix, build it, document it, and keep it running.

Example Projects

  • Connecting Claude to a team’s tools, such as adding an MCP-backed data source to a Slack channel and deciding what access it gets

  • Building an Okta Workflow that applies conditional access to strengthen our security posture

  • Writing an AWS Lambda behind API Gateway to link two systems, defined in Terraform and deployed through GitLab CI/CD

  • Diagnosing a failing Workato recipe caused by a malformed payload

  • Tracing an email bounce to its root cause in Google Workspace

What You’ll Do

Automation and integration. You will own automation in AWS (Lambda, API Gateway) and GCP, defined as code with Terraform and deployed through GitLab CI/CD. You will also own Okta Workflows, our main automation engine, along with Workato, REST APIs, and webhooks. You will write scripts in Python or Go, support the integrations around Salesforce (Auth0, Slack, Jira, and our data warehouse), and set up backups for critical systems such as Jira, GitHub, and Okta Workflows. You will also look across IT processes to find and build new automation.

AI enablement. You will own the Claude rollout, including its connectors and Claude Tag in Slack. You will host and govern MCP servers, including the Cloudflare MCP portal, and support other AI tools teams request, such as Gemini and Copilot. You will review each new connector for security and access scope, and support internal agents.

Identity and access. You will own Okta and Auth0 administration, including Auth0 Actions, SCIM, MFA, device trust, and joiner, mover, and leaver processes. You will also connect Okta to access governance tools such as Entitle or Lumos.

Security and edge. You will own DNS, PKI, WAF, and rate limiting in Cloudflare, along with email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC). You will support the CloudFront sites customers use, coordinate hosting changes with web agencies, and help the security team investigate findings.

Workplace tools and support. You will own Google Workspace, Jira, JSM, Confluence, Slack, and GitLab, and work alongside the owners of Zoom, Microsoft 365, and the wider SaaS stack. You will handle Tier 2 and Tier 3 service desk escalations, troubleshoot Windows and macOS endpoints, and manage vendor support cases. You will also support device-based access policies with the team that manages Iru Kandji and Intune.

Documentation and continuous improvement. You will write runbooks, architecture notes, and handoff documents so no system depends on one person’s memory. You will document and implement processes, maintain an accurate inventory of hardware, software, and resources, and manage IT vendor and contractor relationships. You will also look for weak points in our processes and update infrastructure so it scales, repeats reliably, and stays secure.

What You’ll Bring

  • 7+ years in IT operations, DevOps, cloud engineering, or IAM engineering, including 2+ years automating IT processes. Equivalent experience will be considered.

  • Hands-on Okta administration, including Okta Workflows, and experience with Auth0 custom logic such as Actions or rules

  • Working knowledge of AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, CloudFront, IAM) and GCP (projects, IAM, BigQuery)

  • Experience building integrations with Workato or a similar iPaaS tool

  • Proficiency in at least one automation language (Python, Go, or Node.js) and experience with REST APIs and webhooks

  • Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform or Pulumi) and CI/CD pipelines, ideally GitLab

  • Practical experience with Claude or comparable LLM tools, connectors, and MCP servers, with an understanding of their security implications

  • Experience with Cloudflare (DNS, certificates, Workers) and strong Google Workspace administration

  • A solid understanding of SSO (SAML, OIDC), MFA, SCIM, RBAC, DNS, and email authentication

  • Familiarity with an MDM such as Iru Kandji or Intune, and experience troubleshooting Windows and macOS

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail

  • Excellent written and verbal English, with strong documentation habits

  • Discretion with confidential information

How You Work

You lead without direct reports. You set direction, see projects through to completion, and make decisions. You think about security in every process and treat identity as the front door, so you check what an app or connector can reach before approving it. You start from what a team is trying to accomplish and design automation around that goal. You bring an employee-experience mindset, so you treat every issue, large or small, with empathy and follow through. You are a generalist who enjoys learning new tools, and in a single week you might work across Okta, Auth0, AWS, GCP, Cloudflare, and Google Workspace.

Nice to Have

  • Salesforce Apex and Flow

  • Custom MCP servers or agent frameworks

  • SQL, and experience with BigQuery, Snowflake, or Databricks

  • Azure or other public cloud experience

  • Access governance or SaaS security tools such as Entitle or Lumos

  • SOC 2 or ISO 27001 experience, including vulnerability management

  • HRIS-driven provisioning (for example, HiBob to Okta)

  • Relevant certifications (AWS, GCP, Okta)

We’re committed to creating a culture of inclusion and equality – across race, gender, sexuality, and disability – where innovation and growth thrive, every voice is heard, and everybody belongs. Learn more about us here.

Job Candidate Privacy Notice

Must be able to exercise independent judgment with little or no oversight.

jobs.description:
ABOUT NYMBUS:

Nymbus is a high-growth fintech company, ‘Built to Move,’ empowering banks and financial institutions to transform faster, compete smarter, and deliver greater value in today’s digital marketplace. At Nymbus, we’re revolutionizing banking technology. Our award-winning modern core platform and cloud-based solutions help financial institutions modernize, scale, and succeed. As part of our team, you won’t just be part of a tech revolution; you’ll be at the forefront of it, driving innovation and delivering exceptional client experiences.

Nymbus is building the next generation of fintech platforms, and that takes people who are ready to challenge convention, move with purpose, and reimagine what’s possible. We operate with an AI-first mindset across our business, continuously improving how we work, and the value we deliver to our clients.

We want our partners to be thrilled about the possibilities we are creating together and the lasting impact our collaboration will bring to the industry and consumers. The journey to growth begins with doing something different. And that journey starts with the great people who make Nymbus.

We challenge the status quo, question assumptions, and work together to turn bold ideas into meaningful progress.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

At Nymbus, the Product Operations (Shipper) role is the delivery and quality owner in our squad triad model.

You are responsible for ensuring working software reaches production reliably and meets the quality bar. Working within a dedicated squad alongside a Builder (who owns product intent, specification, and implementation) and an Architect (who owns system design and technical integrity), you own the ship — from validation through release. You operate with an AI-first mindset, leveraging tools like Kiro and Claude to accelerate testing, quality assurance, and deployment workflows.

This is not a traditional QA or release manager role. You are a full-stack delivery professional who defines acceptance criteria, automates validation, manages releases, monitors production health, and drives operational excellence using AI-assisted workflows. You own the "how it gets to production" and the "how we know it works."

The Squad Triad Model:

You operate as one-third of a high-autonomy squad:

Product Operations - Shipper (This Role): Owns delivery, quality assurance, release management, and operational readiness. You are the person who ensures what gets built meets quality standards, passes validation, and reaches production reliably.

Technical Product Manager - Builder (Your Partner): Owns product intent, specification, and implementation. The Builder is the primary creator — designing system behavior, authoring specs, and iterating with AI tools to produce working software. You collaborate daily on acceptance criteria, testability, and definition of done.

Architect (Your Partner): Owns system design, technical integrity, and cross-squad consistency. The Architect ensures solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with platform architecture. You collaborate on deployment strategy, observability, and operational requirements.

Together, the triad owns outcomes end-to-end — from problem definition through production operation.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN:

Quality Assurance and Validation

  • Use AI tools (Kiro, Claude) to rapidly generate test cases, edge case scenarios, and validation suites
  • Define and own acceptance criteria in partnership with the Builder and Architect
  • Design and implement test strategies — automated, property-based, integration, and end-to-end
  • Own the quality gate — nothing ships that does not meet the published standard
  • Drive test automation as the default — manual testing is the exception, not the norm

Release Management and Deployment

  • Own the release process from build artifact through production deployment
  • Manage deployment cadence, release coordination, and rollback procedures
  • Define and enforce release readiness criteria across the squad
  • Monitor deployment health and drive rapid resolution when releases do not perform as expected
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate deployment automation, incident analysis, and release coordination

Squad Collaboration

  • Partner daily with the Builder on acceptance criteria, testability, and definition of done
  • Coordinate with the Architect on deployment architecture, observability, and operational concerns
  • Participate directly in technical design discussions with focus on testability and operability
  • Surface blockers, risks, and dependencies to the squad early and proactively
  • Maintain shared context with squad partners through dashboards, release notes, and quality metrics

The Commercial Analytics Leader serves as the primary strategic interface between commercial leadership and the organization's data, analytics, and data-science capabilities. The Leader makes accurate commercial intelligence continuously available, understandable, and actionable across core and expansion sales motions.

jobs.title: Quantitative Analyst  - Flex Optimisation
jobs.excerpt: About YUSOYUSO is an innovative participant in the energy market.
jobs.description:
About YUSO

YUSO is an innovative participant in the energy market. We supply 100% green energy and offer battery storage solutions to our customers in order to boost the energy transition. We integrate renewable energy sources such as wind and solar into the existing energy markets and assist in maintaining the balance of the electricity grid at the same time.

YUSO’s expertise is centered around battery storage projects, power markets, and dynamic supply solutions intended to accelerate the transition to a decarbonized energy system. Our expertise is allocated to our clients for the full 100%, 24 hours a day.

YUSO fully focuses on innovation and automation in its activities. We always seek the most efficient, durable and effective solutions, transparency being our most important criterion. To support our strong growth, we are currently looking for a Quantitative Analyst.

Quantitative Analyst — Flex Optimisation

YUSO is looking to recruit an additional team member who is looking for an opportunity to leverage their mathematical intellect and analytical mindset to accelerate the energy transition. You will help YUSO by integrating renewable energy and large-scale battery systems into the power markets using mathematical modelling in all its forms; ranging from conventional optimization techniques towards more sophisticated Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence. YUSO encourages you to think outside of the box and bring your own expertise to a very wide range of modelling problems that exist within the world of energy.

For this role you will join YUSO’s (flex) quant team: the team that researches, builds and operates the algorithmic trading stack behind our asset-backed trading activities. The focus is on large, utility-scale battery energy storage systems (BESS) and other sources of flexibility. YUSO operates an active and growing flex portfolio in Belgium, the Netherlands, Great Britain and the Baltics, and is expanding into new market areas as well as ramping up existing activities. As the markets get increasingly complex and competitive, you will research, develop and continuously improve asset-backed trading strategies. This also includes implementing them yourself, which brings you into direct contact with the markets. You will work closely with the other quants and have strong interaction with the Trading & Portfolio Management (TPM) team.

Responsibilities

  • Research & develop asset-backed trading strategies. This constitutes optimization of dynamical systems (batteries and other flexible assets) under complex physical constraints.
  • Optimize batteries across multiple markets and stacked revenue streams: ancillary services (FCR, aFRR, mFRR), wholesale markets (day-ahead, intraday auctions and continuous intraday) and the imbalance mechanism
  • Gain a deep understanding of our in-house algorithmic trading framework (Python on AWS, running 24/7) to enable the development, implementation and maintenance of operational trading strategies and energy management systems.
  • Build and run backtesting and parameter-optimization pipelines to tune strategies per asset, per market and per market condition.
  • Support business development with revenue simulations and financial modelling of large-scale battery and hybrid, renewables+battery, projects.
  • Benchmark and improve asset performance once projects become operational, working closely with the TPM team to maximize performance against market benchmarks.
  • Have a good understanding of relevant existing proprietary algorithms within YUSO so you can apply and adapt them in new markets and environments.
  • Leverage your knowledge of mathematics, statistical methods, Machine Learning and/or AI to improve YUSO’s in-house forecasting models, ranging from predicting what happens to our own portfolio to predicting the behaviour and dynamics of the entire energy market.
  • Monitor, manage and improve existing models by fine-tuning them to new markets or changing market conditions.
  • Analyse time series data across a range of energy markets using a variety of statistical and applied mathematical methods.
  • Write internal reports and give presentations summarising methods, results and performance, with focus on the latter.
  • Maintain a self-critical yet convincing attitude towards your colleagues and clients.

Requirements

  • Master’s degree in mathematics, physics, computer science, engineering or an equivalent scientific / statistical / econometric discipline.
  • Comfortable with mathematical modelling and computational techniques, ranging from conventional optimization (e.g. linear and mixed-integer programming) to more sophisticated Machine Learning models.
  • Knowledge of and/or interest in trading or optimization in power or financial markets.
  • Experience in statistical or mathematical modelling and data analysis.
  • Experience with Python is a must. Knowledge of NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-Learn and other ML libraries is a plus. Knowledge of other languages is a plus.
  • Experience with SQL/MySQL, Git and AWS (or another cloud platform) is a plus, our production stack runs on them.
  • Experience in energy markets through your education or past employment is a plus; knowledge of battery storage or ancillary services is a strong plus.
  • Interest in leveraging AI applications to make your workflow more efficient.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and persuade.
  • Working proficiency in English is required.
  • Team player with a self-driven, research-oriented mindset.

Our offering

You will join a team of dynamic and young professionals, passionate about the integration of renewable energy flows into the energy markets YUSO is active in. This job opening includes remote work and/or working from the YUSO offices in Waregem, Belgium. Our office space is one of the best equipped working environments for energy market activities, offering a multitude of multimedia to connect with other colleagues remotely. As a company, YUSO focuses on the well-being of its employees and the team-spirit as a whole!

Our remuneration is market competitive and offers extra benefits like group- and health-insurance, meal and eco vouchers, IT-equipment supporting remote work, home-office compensation and a mobile plan. It also includes a variable part linked to the performance of the team.

Interested? Apply via the form below!

jobs.description:
We aren’t just looking for someone to manage a backlog; we’re looking for the founding architect of our customer-facing data and AI strategy.

As a TechnicalProduct Manager (Data & AI), you will sit at the high-impact intersection of cutting-edge Data Science, modern Engineering, and customer-facing value. This is a highly visible, strategic role where you’ll partner directly with executive-level clients to co-develop the predictive models, analytical features, and SaaS data products that will define our industry.

If you want to move away from internal tooling and actually ship AI/ML features that drive massive, quantifiable ARR, this is your playground.

This job is remote in the US

Please note: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. The company does not currently or in the future provide sponsorship for employment visa status.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

    Shape the AI & Data Vision

  • Own the Predictive Roadmap: Drive the vision and strategy for our external AI/ML models, advanced analytics features, and data products.

  • Co-Innovate with Clients: Embed deeply with strategic customers and design partners to validate ideas, uncover raw user needs, and co-develop next-gen features.

  • Tell the Story of Data: Partner with UX and Data Science to turn complex backend algorithms into beautiful, intuitive data visualizations and high-impact product demos.

    • Execute & Ship with Impact

  • Translate Complexity: Act as the ultimate bridge. Translate messy customer business problems into precise technical specs, transformation logic, and data requirements for our engineers and data scientists.

  • Own the GTM: Collaborate with Product Marketing and Sales to launch features that aren't just technically impressive, but actually move the needle on SaaS metrics (Adoption, Retention, ARR expansion).

  • Hypothesize & Validate: Use your analytical skills to dive into data assets, validate assumptions, and prove (or disprove) product hypotheses before writing code.

    • What You’ll Bring to the Table

  • 3+ years of relevant experience across Product Management, Data Analytics, or Data Engineering.

  • SQL Fluency: You are comfortable writing joins and aggregations to explore data yourself. (We care about your analytical problem-solving, not whether you memorized advanced syntax).

  • Data Visualization Chops: Experience with a modern BI platform (e.g., Sigma, Tableau, Looker) and a strong sense of how to present data clearly.

  • The "Translator" Superpower: Elite communication skills. You can pitch a vision to an executive client, align a sales team, and debate data modeling with an engineer.

WHO YOU ARE:

  • Great product minds don’t all follow the same blueprint. You likely fall into one of these buckets:

  • The Seasoned Data PM: You already build data products but want a more visible, customer-facing role where you can co-develop directly with clients on a modern stack.

  • The Data-Obsessed SaaS PM: You manage a standard SaaS product, but you secretly spend all your time in SQL, building dashboards, and lurking in the analytics team's Slack channels. You're ready to make Data/AI your full-time focus.

  • The Product-Minded Analyst: You're a Senior Data Analyst or BI Developer who doesn't just answer "what happened?" but actively tells stakeholders "what's next." You’ve been "unofficially" product-managing your work for a while and are ready to make it official.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • 3+ years of relevant experience across Product Management, Data Analytics, or Data Engineering.

  • Strong Business & Product Acumen: The ability to look at a complex technical feature and immediately see how it connects to customer ROI.

  • SQL Fluency: You are comfortable writing joins and aggregations to explore data yourself. (We care about your analytical problem-solving, not whether you memorized advanced syntax).

  • Data Visualization Chops: Experience with a modern BI platform (e.g., Sigma, Tableau, Looker) and a strong sense of how to present data clearly.

  • The "Translator" Superpower: Elite communication skills. You can pitch a vision to an executive client, align a sales team, and debate data modeling with an engineer.

WHAT WOULD ALSO BE AWESOME:

  • Our Stack: Experience with (or a burning desire to learn) our modern data stack: Snowflake, DBT, Fivetran, and Sigma.

  • Industry Context: Experience in complex B2B SaaS verticals—especially physical operations like Field Services (logistics, routing, dispatch) or Building Services—is a massive plus. These industries are sitting on massive, unoptimized datasets ripe for AI disruption.

  • Coding Lite: Familiarity with Python or R for lightweight data analysis.

  • AI/ML Exposure: Experience working around the machine learning lifecycle or productionized models.

WHAT YOU SHOULD KNOW ABOUT US:

• We are laid back but buttoned up. We offer a casual work environment and remote work flexibility and have a passion for developing creative, innovative best in class solutions that directly contribute to the success of our customers
• We care deeply and deliver service and solutions that make a real difference in the lives of our clients and their businesses

LOVE WHAT YOU DO, NO MATTER WHERE YOU DO IT:

No matter what stage of your career or where you live, WorkWave is your place to be part of a global company with a startup feel, where your ideas matter and your growth is a priority.

A GLOBAL COMPANY WITH A LOCAL PRESENCE:
